blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-grained visual perception requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to locate and interpret subtle evidence within complex scenes. Constructing supervision for this ability is challenging: questions must have correct, unambiguous answers that depend on actual fine-grained visual details rather than coarse cues or language priors. Verifying these properties makes manual annotation labor-intensive and automatic generation difficult for models that themselves struggle with fine-grained perception. Yet the same models can often recognize such details once the region is zoomed in. We exploit this global-to-zoom perception gap and introduce ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that constructs questions about the full image from visual information gained only by zooming in. It verifies each answer on the zoomed view with multiple models, ensures that each question remains unambiguous in the full image and cannot be answered from language priors, and specifically generates high-quality distractors for multiple-choice questions. With this pipeline and human-only screening (no manual QA editing), we build ZoomGainBench, a 1,000-question bilingual benchmark on which the best of 28 VLMs achieves only 61.08. Failure analysis reveals that models favor a particular type of distractor when answering multiple-choice questions incorrectly. Beyond evaluation, training on just 9K ZoomGain samples substantially improves the visual perception capabilities of our 4B/9B models, enabling them to outperform several hundred-billion-parameter models across various perception benchmarks. The trained 9B model achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, such as 90.25 on HR-Bench 4K. These results establish global-to-zoom perception gaps as a practical basis for scaling fine-grained visual supervision for both evaluation and training. Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain.
blocks.zh: 精致的视觉感知需要Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)在复杂的场景中定位并解释微妙的证据. 为这种能力构建监督是具有挑战性的:问题必须有正确、毫不含糊的答案,这些答案取决于实际细微的视觉细节,而不是粗糙的提示或语言前缀。 验证这些属性使得人工注解劳动密集型和自动生成对于那些本身与精细感知相抗衡的模型来说是困难的. 然而,一旦区域扩大,同样的模型往往能够识别出这些细节。 我们利用这个从全球到分区的认知差距,引入了ZoomGain, 一个数据构建管道, 构建关于从视觉信息中获取的全部图像的问题, 它用多种模型验证放大视图上的每个答案,确保每个问题在完整图像中保持清晰,无法从语言前缀中解答,并特别为多选题产生高质量的分心器. 有了这种管道和人独有的筛选(没有手工的QA编辑),我们建立了ZoomGain Bench,一个1000个问题双语基准,28个VLM中最好的一个只能达到61.08. 失败分析显示,模型在错误地回答多选题时倾向于某种特定的分心器. 除了评价外,关于9K ZoomGain样本的培训极大地提高了我们4B/9B模型的视觉感知能力,使它们能够超越各种感知基准的上百亿参数模型。 训练有素的9B模型在几个基准上实现了SoTA的性能,例如HR-Bench 4K上的90.25. 这些结果确立了从全球到分区的认识差距,作为扩大评价和培训的精细视觉监督的实际基础。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/inclucionAI/ZoomGain查阅。

blocks.en:
Fine-grained visual perception is essential in many practical applications,
from detecting small vehicles in aerial imagery Xia et al. (2018) and
identifying subtle defects in industrial inspection Bergmann et al. (2019) to reading product labels for people with visual impairments Gurari et al. (2018) .
Addressing such tasks with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) Team (2026) ; Bai et al. (2025) ; Zhu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2023) requires locating and interpreting
small details that are easily overlooked in the full image.
To develop and benchmark such fine-grained capabilities, high-quality supervision is essential:
answers must be correct and unambiguous,
and questions must genuinely require fine-grained visual evidence.

为了发展和衡量这种精细能力,高质量的监督至关重要:
答案必须正确和明确,
问题必须真正需要精细的视觉证据。

blocks.en:
Constructing such supervision at scale is challenging.
Manual annotation is labor-intensive,
as annotators must inspect small regions and verify each of these properties.
Automatic generation Wang et al. (2025a) ; Wei et al. (2026) faces a related difficulty:
the models used to generate questions may themselves struggle to perceive the relevant details in the full image.
As a result, they may produce incorrect answers, ambiguous references, or questions that do not actually require fine-grained perception.
Motivated by this, the key challenge is to obtain reliable supervision on visual details that models fail to perceive in full scenes.

自动生成 王等人 (2025a) ; 陈.. 魏等人(2026年)面临相关困难:

因此,它们可能会产生错误的答案,模棱两可的引用,或者实际上不需要细微的感知的问题.
以此为动机,关键的挑战在于获得对模型在全场无法察觉的视觉细节的可靠监督.

blocks.en:
Zooming in has long been used to recover such details,
either at inference time through visual search Wu and Xie (2023) ; Lai et al. (2025) ; Shen et al. (2025) and agentic VLMs with cropping tools Zheng et al. (2026) ; Hong et al. (2026) ,
or during training through region-to-image distillation Wei et al. (2026) ; Yuan et al. (2026) ,
since details a model fails to resolve in the full image often become recognizable
once the region is zoomed in.
We specifically use this global-to-zoom perception gap to construct the supervision itself
(Fig. 1 (a)):
contrasting the two views locates details that are hard to perceive in the full image.

blocks.en:
Based on this idea, we introduce ZoomGain , an automated data construction pipeline
that converts visual information, which are gain ed only by zoom ing,
into challenging questions about the full image ( Contribution #1 ).
ZoomGain (1) builds questions exclusively from details described in the zoomed view
but unclear or absent in the full-image description, so that answering requires the fine detail itself;
(2) keeps an answer only when multiple models agree on it in the zoomed view,
and discards questions with ambiguous full-image references or answerable without images;
and (3) generates various multiple-choice distractors that could mislead the queried VLMs.

(2) 只有当多个模型在放大视图中就答案达成一致时,才保留答案,
并抛弃带有模糊的全图像参考或没有图像的答案的问题;
和(3)产生各种多重选择的分散注意力,可能误导被询问的VLM.

blocks.en:
Using ZoomGain, we curate ZoomGainBench , a bilingual benchmark of 1,000 questions
on attribute recognition, counting, and OCR, whose questions and answers are entirely model-authored:
two human reviewers only accept/reject candidates ( Contribution #2 ).
Among 28 evaluated VLMs, the best model, GPT-5.6-Sol, scores only 61.08,
and only five exceed 50 (Fig. 1 (b)).
Error analysis further reveals that incorrect choices concentrate on distractors
mined from full-image mispredictions during construction (Sec. 3.3 ).
This indicates that when details are unresolved,
models tend to fill the information gap with similar scene-plausible guesses,
suggesting that the global-to-zoom perception gap is a common weakness across current VLMs,
rather than an issue to specific models.

blocks.en:
Beyond evaluation, ZoomGain data also serves as effective training supervision ( Contribution #3 ).
With identical source images and training settings,
we train Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B Team (2026) on 9K ZoomGain and ZwZ (ICML’26 Wei et al. (2026) ) QA pairs.
ZoomGain-trained models consistently outperform ZwZ across all 14 evaluated benchmarks (Fig. 1 (c)).
The gains extend beyond fine-grained perception to general perception
and difficult perception-and-reasoning tasks,
e.g., 11.01 points boost on O3-Bench Li et al. (2026a) for the 9B model.
Notably, our fine-tuned 9B model is on par with GLM-5.3-Flash GLM-5-Team et al. (2026) and 4B model surpasses Qwen3.5-122B-A10B.
Ablations show that removing either incremental evidence or multi-source distractors
substantially reduces these gains,
confirming that both designs rooted in the global-to-zoom perception gap are essential.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A variety of benchmarks specifically evaluate fine-grained perception in high-resolution images,
including Wu and Xie (2023) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Gavrikov et al. (2026) ; Lai et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026b) ; Wei et al. (2026) ;
O3-Bench Li et al. (2026a) further requires multi-step reasoning beyond perception.
However, questions in these benchmarks are typically annotated manually or generated by models with extensive manual editing (Table 1 ), making scalable cruation costly.
Moreover, existing benchmarks rarely filter out language-prior shortcuts Cadene et al. (2019) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Yue et al. (2025) or design targeted distractors. In contrast, ZoomGain fully automates QA authoring with zoom-view verification,
blind shortcut filtering, and distractor mining from model errors.

包括吴和谢(2023); 王等人(2025b) ; 陈.. 张等人(2024年);王等人(2025年a),加夫里科夫等人(2026年),莱等人(2025年). 张等人(2026年b). Wei等人(2026年);

然而,这些基准中的问题一般是人工说明或由大量手工编辑的模型生成(表1),使可伸缩的钉钉代价高昂。
此外,现有基准很少过滤出语言前的快捷键 Cadene等人(2019年);Chen等人(2024年);Yue等人(2025年)或设计目标分散器。 相比之下,ZoomGain将QA的作者完全自动化,并进行缩放视图验证,
盲目快捷键过滤, 和分散对模型错误的挖掘 。

blocks.en:
Zooming has been widely adopted to enhance fine-grained perception,
either at inference time via visual search Wu and Xie (2023) ; Shen et al. (2025) ; Lai et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026a) ; Wang et al. () and agentic cropping tools Zheng et al. (2026) ; Hong et al. (2026) ; Su et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ,
or during training through zoomed-to-global distillation Wei et al. (2026) ; Yuan et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2026b) ; Zhang et al. (2026a) .
Unlike prior works that focus on inference procedures or training objectives,
ZoomGain targets data construction itself:
it leverages the global-to-zoom perception gap to identify what to ask (strictly on zoom-revealed details)
and reliably verify ground truth, making it complementary to existing approaches.

blocks.en: 3 ZoomGain Data Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3 缩放 数据构建 管道

blocks.en:
ZoomGain exploits the perception gap between global and zoomed-in views:
fine-grained details that are difficult to discern in the full image
may become clear once the target region is zoomed in.
As illustrated in Figure 2 ,
ZoomGain first discovers and grounds target anchors (Sec. 3.1 ),
then constructs questions and answers from details newly revealed by zooming (Sec. 3.2 ),
and finally verifies answer reliability and visual dependence
and builds multi-source distractors that capture plausible model errors (Sec.n 3.3 ).
The complete algorithm and additional implementation details are provided in
Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.1 Anchor Discovery and Grounding
blocks.zh: 3.1 发现和搁浅

blocks.en:
Given an input image, denoted as the global view V g V_{g} ,
we first use a VLM to generate a global scene caption C g C_{g} .
A text-only LLM then takes C g C_{g} as its sole input
and proposes a set of candidate anchors.
Each anchor i i is represented by a referring expression e i e_{i} that describes the target’s appearance, spatial location, or relations to other objects.
To ensure that e i e_{i} can identify a localizable instance unambiguously in the full image,
three VLMs independently ground e i e_{i} in V g V_{g} .
We retain e i e_{i} only if each model returns exactly one valid bounding box,
since a missing box or multiple boxes indicate that the referent cannot be found or may be ambiguous,
and all pairwise box IoUs are at least 0.5 0.5 ,
which provides cross-model evidence that e i e_{i} refers to a consistent region.
For each retained anchor, we take the coordinate-wise median of the predicted boxes,
expand the resulting region to include more surrounding context,
yielding the crop box b i b_{i} , and crop V g V_{g} using b i b_{i} to obtain a zoomed view V z i V_{z}^{i} .
The quadruples ( V g , V z i , b i , e i ) (V_{g},V_{z}^{i},b_{i},e_{i}) serve as inputs to the subsequent question construction stage.

blocks.en: 3.2 Global-to-Zoom Evidence and QA Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 全球至Zoom证据和质量保证建设

blocks.en:
For each retained anchor i i , we use a strong VLM M cap M_{\mathrm{cap}} to describe the target region from both views.
Specifically, we draw a red bounding box at b i b_{i} in V g V_{g} to obtain an annotated global view V g i V_{g}^{i} .
Figure 1 (a) illustrates the paired views ( V g i , V z i ) (V_{g}^{i},V_{z}^{i}) .
We feed V g i V_{g}^{i} into M cap M_{\mathrm{cap}} and prompt it to describe
only the contents of the red box in as much detail as possible,
yielding the global-view caption C g i C_{g}^{i} .
In a separate, independent call,
we provide the zoomed view V z i V_{z}^{i} and request a detailed caption C z i C_{z}^{i} .
This produces two descriptions of the same region b i b_{i} at different viewing scales.
We then use an LLM to compare C g i C_{g}^{i} and C z i C_{z}^{i} ,
extracting details that are explicitly described in C z i C_{z}^{i} but remain unclear or unmentioned in C g i C_{g}^{i} .
These details form a candidate fact set Δ i \Delta_{i} .
For example, in Figure 2 (b),
the runner’s shoe color is unclear in the global-view caption
but identified as red in the zoomed-view caption,
so it becomes a candidate fact in Δ i \Delta_{i} .

例如,在图2(b)中,
跑者鞋色在全景字幕中并不清楚
在缩放的图像中,
成为候选人的事实。

blocks.en:
We generate three types of questions:
attribute recognition, text recognition (OCR), and counting.
An LLM selects one fact from Δ i \Delta_{i} that supports a definite answer
and generates a local question q local i q_{\mathrm{local}}^{i} and a reference answer a i a_{i} based on this fact.
The local question is phrased for the zoomed view
with a simple reference such as “the runner”,
without specifying the target’s location in the full image.
The LLM then replaces this reference with the global referring expression e i e_{i} and adjusts the wording to produce a global-view question q global i q_{\mathrm{global}}^{i} ,
keeping the queried detail and reference answer unchanged,
so that questions about details revealed by zooming
clearly identify the intended target in the full image.
For example, “What color are the runner’s shoe uppers?”
becomes “What color are the shoe uppers of
the dark-shirted runner on the right yellow line?”
Appendix H illustrates this construction process
with attribute, counting, and OCR examples.
blocks.zh:
我们提出三类问题:
属性识别、文本识别(OCR)和计数。
LLM 从 QQ i\ Delta\i} 中选择一个支持明确答案的事实
并基于此事实生成一个本地问题 q 本地 i q mathrm{ local i}}^{i} 和一个参考答案 i a_{i}。
本地问题用于缩放视图

不在全图像中指定目标位置。

保留所询问的细节和参考答案不变,
以便通过缩放揭示的细节问题
以完整的形象明确确定预定目标。
例如, " 跑腿的鞋盖是什么颜色? “
变成 " 鞋顶是什么颜色?
右黄线的黑衫跑者? “

blocks.en: 3.3 Quality Verification and Multi-Source Distractors
blocks.zh: 3.3 质量核查和多来源干扰

blocks.en:
We verify each candidate QA pair in two ways.
(1) For crop-based verification , we provide several VLMs
with q local i q_{\mathrm{local}}^{i} and the zoomed view V z i V_{z}^{i} ,
and sample multiple answers from each model.
We retain the QA pair only if all models meet a predefined accuracy threshold on their sampled answers.
Checking agreement among multiple models answering based on the zoomed-view helps ensure answer correctness,
thereby avoiding sole reliance on a single model’s caption for answer annotation, which may contain hallucinations Rohrbach et al. (2018) ; Li et al. (2023) ; Jing et al. (2024) .
(2) For blind verification , models are asked to answer q global i q_{\mathrm{global}}^{i} without an image.
We discard a QA if all blind models exceed a prescribed correct-answer threshold.
This step effectively filters out questions that can be answered through language priors alone rather than actual image content Cadene et al. (2019) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Yue et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
我们以两种方式验证每个候选人的QA对.
(1) 关于以作物为基础的核查,我们提供若干VLM。
与 q local i q_{\mathrm{local}}^{i} 和放大视图 V z i V_{z}^{i} ,
并取样每个模型的多个答案。
只有当所有模型都在其抽样答案上达到预先确定的精确阈值时,我们才保留QA对.
根据放大视图检查多个模型之间的协议有助于确保答案正确,
从而避免仅仅依赖单一模型的解答标题,其中可能包含幻觉 Rohrbach等人(2018年);Li等人(2023年);Jing等人(2024年).
(2) 对于盲目核查,请模型在没有图像的情况下回答 q global i q_{\ mathrm{ global}}^{i} 。
如果所有失明模型都超过规定的正确答案阈值,我们就会放弃质量保证。
这一步骤有效地过滤出仅通过语言前传而不是实际图像内容Cadene等人(2019年);Chen等人(2024年);Yue等人(2025年)。

blocks.en:
For verified QA pairs suited to multiple-choice evaluation,
we construct distractors from three complementary sources.
(1) Visual evidence supplies plausible alternatives from image content,
such as the neon-green shoes of another runner in Figure 2 (c),
which can expose errors in target selection or attribute binding.
(2) Blind guesses provide incorrect answers produced without the image,
capturing language priors.
(3) Global-view errors provide incorrect answers produced from the full image,
capturing confusions when local details are difficult to discern.
We remove candidates equivalent to the reference answer or also valid for the question,
merge semantically redundant candidates,
and normalize their wording to form distinct answer options.
blocks.zh:
对于适合多重选择评价的经核实的质量保证配对,
我们从三个互补来源构筑分心器。
(1) 视觉证据为图像内容提供了可行的替代物,
例如图2(c)中另一名跑者的霓虹绿鞋,
它可以暴露目标选择或属性绑定中的错误。
(2)盲猜提供了没有图像产生的错误答案,
抓取语言前缀 。
(3) 全球视图错误提供了从完整图像得出的错误答案,
当当地细节难以辨识时,
我们删除相当于参考答案或对问题有效的候选人,
合并大量多余的候选人,
并使其措辞正常化,形成不同的答案选项。

blocks.en:
We combine the reference answer with the selected distractors
and recheck the resulting MCQ using the zoomed view.
This final check tests whether the reference answer remains reliably distinguishable
after competing options are introduced.
If the per-model agreement thresholds are not met,
we replace or remove problematic distractors.
OCR and counting questions retain an open-ended format
and bypass distractor construction and MCQ rechecking.
Appendix I provides examples of candidate QA pairs
rejected by crop-based and blind verification.
blocks.zh:
我们把参考答案和选定的分心器结合起来
并使用缩放视图重新检查所产生的 MCQ 。
最终检查测试参考答案是否仍然可靠可辨
在引入相互竞争的选项后。
如果未达到每模式协议的阈值,
我们替换或移除有问题的分心器。
OCR和计票问题保留开放式格式
并绕过分散器构造和MCQ重新检查.
附 录 我提供候选人QA对的例子
被基于作物的盲目核查拒绝。

blocks.en: 4 Implementation Details and Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 4 实施细节和数据准备

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-397B-A17B Team (2026) as M cap M_{\mathrm{cap}} and the initial global scene captioner.
GLM-5.2 GLM-5-Team et al. (2026) performs incremental fact extraction and QA generation.
Global-view error distractors are mined from incorrect answers produced by
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) ,
and Kimi-K2.6 Team et al. (2026b) to the global question on the full image,
with 10 answers sampled per model (30 in total).
All verification stages likewise sample 10 answers per model and apply per-model accuracy thresholds.
Complete model assignments, verification thresholds, and distractor repair settings are provided in
Appendix B .

We randomly sample 12K images from ZwZ Wei et al. (2026) ,
which collects high-resolution images from several sources Kirillov et al. (2023) ; Chuang et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2022) ; Changpinyo et al. (2021) ; Krishna et al. (2017) ; Schuhmann et al. (2022) ,
and generate a pool of 23,610 QA pairs with ZoomGain.
GLM-5.2 jointly generates Chinese and English versions of both the local and global questions,
and the two language versions of a question are counted as one QA pair.
From this pool, two human reviewers select 1,000 questions for the benchmark
without writing or editing any questions or answers.
blocks.zh:
我们随机抽取来自ZwZ Wei等人(2026年)的12K图像,
收集高分辨率图像的来源有:Kirillov等人(2023年)、Chuang等人(2025年)、Chen等人(2022年)、Champinyo等人(2021年)、Krishna等人(2017年)、Shuhmann等人(2022年),

blocks.en:
Excluding the 1,000 benchmark items, the remaining QAs form the training pool.
For a fair comparison with ZwZ, for each image, we take the smaller number of available unique questions
between the two sides and sample that many from each side without replacement,
yielding 8,746 image-matched QA pairs.
We then duplicate 254 randomly chosen pairs on both sides to reach 9,000 samples per dataset.
Both training sets thus use identical source images (ZwZ retains its bounding-box overlays)
and differ solely in the questions.

除1 000个基准项目外,其余的质量保证构成培训人才库。
为了与ZwZ进行公平的比较,每个图像,我们都会处理数量较少的独特问题。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments on ZoomGain Bench
blocks.zh: 5次ZoomGain座椅实验

blocks.en:
To examine whether questions mined from global-to-zoom perception gaps
pose a genuine challenge to current VLMs,
we evaluate 28 widely-used VLMs on ZoomGainBench,
spanning closed-source frontier, agentic, fine-grained enhanced single-forward,
and open-source general VLMs (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
研究是否从全球到分区的认识差距中挖掘出的问题
给目前的自愿多数人构成真正的挑战,
我们评价了28个在ZoomGain Bench上被广泛使用的VLM,
跨越封闭源代码, 代理,精细强化单向,
和开源普通VLM(表2).

blocks.en:
ZoomGainBench contains 1,000 questions over 941 images:
472 attribute recognition, 94 counting, and 434 OCR questions.
Attribute questions have 4 to 6 answer options; counting and OCR questions are open-ended.
Each question has English and Chinese versions (2,000 evaluation instances in total)
and an automatically obtained evidence region specified by its crop box.
Appendix C shows examples of all three question categories.
Table 1 compares ZoomGainBench with existing benchmarks:
it is the only one that combines fully model-authored QAs, automated verification,
and dedicated distractor construction,
and Section 5.2 shows how these distractors reveal errors shared across models.
blocks.zh:
ZoomGain Bench包含超过941幅图像的1000个问题:
472个属性识别,94个计数,以及434个OCR问题.
属性问题有4至6个答案选项;计数和OCR问题没有限制.
每个问题都有英文版和中文版(共计2 000个评价实例)
并自动获得其作物盒指定的证据区域。
附 录 C显示了所有三个问题类别的例子。
表1 比较 带有现有基准的 ZoomGain Bench :
只有它结合了完全模型化的QAs,自动化的验证,
和能分心的建筑,
第5.2节显示了这些分散注意力者如何揭示各模型共有的错误。

Each language-specific Overall is weighted by the number of questions in each category. Bold and underlined scores indicate the best and second-best results
across all models in each column, respectively.

表2:ZoomGain Bench的评价结果。 英文和中文问题分数按百分比报告。
每种语文 总体而言,每个类别中的问题数量加权计算。 粗体和下划线分数显示最佳和次佳成绩

Multiple-choice questions are scored by exact match on the selected option,
and counting questions by exact match on the predicted integer.
OCR questions receive their ANLS score if it is at least 0.7 0.7 ,
and zero otherwise.
Prompts, decoding temperature, and thinking-mode settings
for each model are provided in Appendix F .

并按预测整数的精确匹配来计算问题。

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmark results.
blocks.zh: 5.1 基准结果。

blocks.en:
ZoomGain challenges even frontier VLMs. The strongest model, GPT-5.6-Sol, reaches an overall score of only 61.08 (Table 2 ), and only five models exceed 50.
All four closed-source models outperform every open-source general VLM:
even GPT-5.5 (56.79) surpasses Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (55.05),
the best open-source general model.
blocks.zh:
ZoomGain甚至挑战前沿甚高频。 最强型号为GPT-5.6-Sol,总体得分仅为61.08(表2),只有五个型号超过50.
所有四个闭源模型都超越了每一个开源普通VLM:
甚至GPT-5.5(56.79)也超过了Qune3.8-Flash-Next(55.05),
最佳开源一般模式.

blocks.en:
Fine-grained enhanced VLMs are highly competitive. ZwZ-8B and Vision-OPD-9B improve over their respective base models,
Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, by 18.47 and 14.00 points.
Despite its smaller size, ZwZ-8B (47.85) also surpasses Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (45.16).
blocks.zh:
精细强化的VLM具有很高的竞争力. ZwZ-8B和Vision-OPD-9B改进了各自的基础模型,
Quen3-VL-8B和Quen3.5-9B,以18.47和14.00的分数获得.
尽管尺寸较小,ZwZ-8B(47.85)也超过了Quen3.5-397B-A17B(45.16).

blocks.en:
Attribute recognition is the most difficult category. Attribute recognition yields the lowest score averaged over both languages for 23 of 28 models,
despite being the only multiple-choice category, with a uniform-guessing accuracy of about 21.5%.
Qwen3-VL-8B, for example, falls below this level in both languages (15.89 in English and 19.92 in Chinese),
motivating an analysis of which distractors attract incorrect choices.
blocks.zh:
属性识别是最难的类别. 在28种模式中的23种模式中,属性识别得到两种语言的平均最低分,
尽管是唯一的多选择类别,但统一判断的准确度约为21.5%。
例如,Qune3-VL-8B在两种语言中都低于这一水平(英语为15.89,中文为19.92),
促使分析哪些分散注意力者吸引错误的选择。

blocks.en: 5.2 Error analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 错误分析

Values above 1 indicate over-selection. Global-view error + blind guess denotes distractors produced both as incorrect answers
when models view the full image and as guesses based on language priors without an image.
(b) How often the 26 models not used in construction
(all evaluated models except Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct)
choose global-view errors, grouped by each error’s frequency
in the 30 full-image answers collected during construction.
(c) Accuracy by quartile of the anchor’s area in the full image.

比较随机基线,只考虑不正确的答案。
1以上值表示超选. Global-view 错误 + 盲猜 表示生成的分光器都是错误的答案
当模型查看完整图像,并作为基于没有图像的语言前缀的猜测时.

(除Quen3.5-397B-A17B和Quen3-VL-235B-A22B-指令外,所有评价模型)
选择全局视图错误, 按每次错误的频率分组
在建筑过程中收集的30个完整图像答案中。
(c) 以四分法精确地描述锚区。

blocks.en:
Since every distractor retains its source from construction
(Section 3.3 ),
we can trace where incorrect choices go.
Across all 28 models, global-view-error distractors
receive 71.7% of incorrect choices, exceeding the random baseline of 54.5%, 1 1 1 The baseline assumes that whenever a model answers incorrectly,
it selects uniformly at random among that question’s distractors. whereas blind guesses and visual evidence receive only 0.54 and 0.59 times their random-baseline
(Figure 3 (a)).
This over-selection holds for every model, including those not involved in construction
Moreover, wrong answers that appear more often during construction are also chosen more often by other models.
Among the 26 models not used in construction,
errors that appeared 1–2 times in the 30 full-image answers are chosen 17.7% of the time,
versus 46.0% for those that appeared more than 10 times
(Figure 3 (b)).
That is, models reproduce the global-view confusions observed during construction,
guessing a scene-plausible answer instead of resolving the queried detail,
such as naming a hockey equipment brand for the logo on a hockey player’s pants
(shown in Figure 8 (a) in Appendix E ). In other words, distractors mined from global-view errors capture confusions shared across models,
rather than idiosyncrasies of the models used in construction.
blocks.zh:
因为每一个分散注意力者都保留着建筑的源头
(第3.3节),
我们可以追踪错误的选择
在所有28种模型中,全局-反光干扰器
获得71.7%的不正确的选择,超过了54.5%的随机基准,1.1 1 基准假设,每当模型错误地回答时,
它在这个问题的分散注意力者中随机统一选择。 而盲猜和视觉证据只收到其随机基线的0.54和0.59倍
(图3(a))。
包括那些没有参与建筑施工的模特儿
此外,在建筑过程中更经常出现的错误答案也更经常地被其他模型所选择.
在未用于建筑的26种模型中,
30个全图像解答中出现1–2次的错误,选择了17.7%的时间,
10次以上者为46.0%
(图3(b))。
也就是说,模型复制了在建筑过程中观察到的全局视野混乱,
猜测一个场景可信的答案 而不是解决询问的细节,
例如为冰球运动员裤子上的标志命名冰球设备品牌
(见附录E图8(a))。 换句话说,从全局视野错误中挖掘的分光器能够捕捉到各模型共享的混淆,
而不是建筑中所用的模型的特异性。

blocks.en:
Accuracy rises with the fraction of the image occupied by the anchor for every model group
(Figure 3 (c)):
averaged over all models, it increases from 28.9% on the smallest quartile,
where anchors occupy less than 0.4% of the image, to 55.2% on the largest.
blocks.zh:
准确度随着每个模型组主播占据的图像比例上升
(图3(c)):
在所有模型中,平均从28.9%增长到最小的四分位数,
其中锚占图像的不到0.4%,在最大比例为55.2%。

blocks.en:
Appendix D further reports the error analysis regarding open-ended questions,
including how incorrect counts differ from the ground truth,
as well as common OCR error patterns.
blocks.zh:
附 录 D还报告了关于开放式问题的错误分析,
包括不正确的数字与事实有何不同,
以及常见的 OCR 错误模式。

blocks.en: 6 Experiments on ZoomGain Training Data
blocks.zh: 6 关于ZoomGain培训数据的实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
We conduct the experiment on the image-matched ZoomGain and ZwZ sets described in Section 4 ,
each with 9,000 samples.
We select Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B Team (2026) as our base models,
applying RL with GRPO Shao et al. (2024) using each set under identical settings
(batch size 64, 8 rollouts per question; other details are shown in Appendix G ).
We evaluate on four groups of benchmarks. Held-in : ZoomGain Bench. Held-out fine-grained perception : ZoomBench Wei et al. (2026) , V* Bench Wu and Xie (2023) ,
HR-Bench 4K and 8K Wang et al. (2025b) , MME-RealWorld-Lite Zhang et al. (2024) ,
TreeBench Wang et al. (2025a) , and VisualProbe Lai et al. (2025) . General perception : CV-Bench Tong et al. (2024a) , MMStar Chen et al. (2024) , and MMVP Tong et al. (2024b) . Difficult perception and reasoning : BabyVision Chen et al. (2026) ,
PerceptionBench Lin et al. (2026) ,
and O3-Bench Li et al. (2026a) .
We also compare with some large parameter VLMs, including open-source and closed-source Google DeepMind (2025) ; OpenAI () .
We report the average score over the 13 held-out benchmarks, excluding ZoomGain Bench.
Because ZoomGain Bench and the ZoomGain training data are generated by the same generation pipeline,
including it could favor ZoomGain model.
blocks.zh:
我们对第4节描述的图像匹配的ZomGain和ZwZ集进行实验,
每个样本9 000个。
我们选择了 Quen3.5-4B 和 Quen3.5-9B 团队(2026年)作为我们的基地模式,
用 GRPO 应用 RL Shao等人(2024年)在相同的设置下使用每套设备
(批次尺寸64,每题8卷;其他细节见附录G.).
我们评价四组基准。 (原始内容存档于2018-10-21). Held-in: ZomoGain eachin. 被搁置的精细感知: Zomo Bench Wei等人(2026年),V* 吴和谢(2023年),
HR-Bench 4K和8K Wang等人(2025b),MME-Real World-Lite 张等 (2024),.
Tree Bench Wang et al. (2025a),以及Visual Probe Lai et al. (2025). 一般看法: CV-Bench Tong等人(2024a),MMStar Chen等人(2024年),以及MMVP Tong等人(2024年b). 难以理解和推理:婴儿视觉 陈等 (2026),.
Bench Lin 等人(2026年)的看法,
以及O3-Bench Li等人(2026a) .
我们还与一些大型参数VLM进行比较,包括开源和闭源Google DeepMind(2025);OpenAI ().
我们报告平均得分超过13个搁置基准,不包括ZoomGain法官。
因为ZoomGain座椅和ZoomGain训练数据 是由同代管道生成的,
包括它可以支持ZoomGain模型。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 3 ,
models trained on ZoomGain data consistently outperform their ZwZ-trained counterparts on all 14 benchmarks.
Since the two training sets differ solely in the questions,
these gains can be attributed to the questions constructed by ZoomGain.
Moreover, the improvements brought by ZoomGain extend across all benchmark groups.
Compared with the base models, the gains of ZwZ are mainly concentrated on fine-grained perception.
In contrast, ZoomGain improves all three groups.
The advantage of ZoomGain over ZwZ is most pronounced on difficult perception and reasoning,
where the 9B model gains 11.01 points on O3-Bench and the 4B model gains 10.31 points on BabyVision.
These results indicate that ZoomGain data
enables models to acquire transferable fine-grained perception capabilities.
blocks.zh:
如表3所示,
在ZoomGain数据方面接受过培训的模型在所有14个基准方面一直比受ZwZ培训的同行表现好。
由于这两组培训在问题上各有不同,
这些收益可归因于ZoomGain构建的问题。
此外,ZoomGain带来的改进涉及所有基准组别。
与基础模型相比,ZwZ的增益主要集中于精细的感知.
相反,ZoomGain改进了所有三个组别.
ZoomGain在ZwZ的优势 在难以理解和推理上最为突出
其中9B模型在O3-Bench上获得11.01分,4B模型在Baby Vision上获得10.31分.
这些结果表明,ZoomGain数据
使模型能够获得可转移的精致感知能力。

blocks.en:
Remarkably, with only 9K training samples,
the 9B model achieves an average score of 66.10,
surpassing Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (65.55) and performing on par with GLM-5.3-Flash (66.07),
while the 4B model (63.96) also surpasses Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and the ZwZ-trained 9B model.
Moreover, ZoomGain-trained models achieve the best results among all compared models on 6 of 7 fine-grained perception benchmarks.
However, we also notice that the strongest large models still lead on
general perception and difficult perception and reasoning,
suggesting that these tasks still rely heavily on model scale and reasoning capability.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,只有9K训练样本,
9B模式实现平均分66.10分.
超过Qwen3.5-397B-A17B(65.55),与GLM-5.3-Flash(66.07)等效,
而4B型机车(63.96)也超过了Quen3.5-122B-A10B和ZwZ训练的9B型机车.
此外,ZoomGain培训的模型在7个精细感知基准中的6个模型中取得了最佳效果。
然而,我们也注意到,最强大的大型型号仍然领先于
一般看法和困难的看法和推理,
说明这些任务仍然严重依赖模型规模和推理能力。

blocks.en: 6.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.2 读取研究

blocks.en:
We ablate two core designs of ZoomGain on Qwen3.5-4B.
All variants use 9K training samples,
with the same RL settings and evaluation protocol
as in Table 3 . (1) Remove incremental evidence:
instead of requiring questions to be based on incremental information
that appears only in the zoomed-view caption,
we generate questions directly from the zoomed-view caption.
The source images, candidate QA pool size, and 9K sample selection procedure
are otherwise identical to those of the full version. (2) Remove dedicated distractors:
we keep each question, its answer, the correct option’s position,
and the number of options unchanged,
and replace only the distractors of each multiple-choice question
with correct answers from other training questions in the same answer category
(e.g., color or material).
OCR and counting questions are open-ended and are unaffected by this ablation.
blocks.zh:
我们放弃了ZoomGain在Quen3.5-4B上的两个核心设计.
所有变种都使用9K训练样本,
使用相同的 RL 设置和评价协议
如表3所示。 (1) 删除增量证据:
而不是要求问题以增量信息为基础
仅出现在缩放的视图字幕中,
我们直接从放大视图字幕中生成问题。
源图像、 候选 QA 池大小和 9K 样本选择程序
在其他方面与全文相同。 (2) 删除专用的分散器:
我们保留每个问题 答案 正确选择的立场
和选项数目不变,
并只替换每个多选题的分心器
对同一类别其他培训问题的正确答复
(如颜色或材料).
OCR和计票问题没有限制,也不会受到这种破坏的影响。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of incremental evidence and dedicated distractors. Avg. is computed over the 10 held-out benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表4:增量证据和专用分散注意力者。 Avg.是按10个搁置基准计算的。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 4 , the results demonstrate that both designs contribute to training performance.
The full ZoomGain pipeline achieves the highest average score across the 10 held-out benchmarks.
Removing any component incude the performance losses on almost all benchmarks. Both ablations incur the largest losses in the difficult perception and reasoning group.
The full version improves over the base model by an average of 6.19 points
across these three benchmarks,
while each ablation retains only about half of this gain.
This indicates that the two designs mainly improve the capability of perception
and reasoning that transfer beyond the training distribution.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,结果显示,这两种设计都有助于培训工作。
完整的ZoomGain管道在10个搁置基准中实现了最高的平均得分。
删除任何组件,使几乎所有基准的性能损失明显增加。 两者都造成了困难的认知和推理组的最大损失。
整个版本比基准模型改进平均6.19分
跨越这三个基准,
而每次衰竭只保留了这一收益的一半左右.
这表明这两个设计主要提高了感知能力.
并解释转移是否超出培训分配范围。

blocks.en:
The effect of incremental evidence is most apparent on fine-grained benchmarks:
removing it reduces scores on ZoomBench and VisualProbe by 3.43 and 4.46 points, respectively.
This indicates that restricting questions to evidence revealed only after zooming
forces the model to learn to locate and recognize details hard to discern.
Meanwhile, removing dedicated distractors causes the largest drop
on the held-in ZoomGainBench, at 8.96 points.
It is expected because the benchmark’s options are constructed using the same pipeline.
Using dedicated distractors introduces harder confusions,
forcing the model to attend more closely to visual details and thereby enhancing its perception capabilities under the same data budget.
blocks.zh:
增量证据对精细基准的影响最为明显:
删除后,Zoom Bench和Visual Probe上的分数分别减少3.43分和4.46分.
这表明,问题仅限于在放大后才披露的证据。
迫使模型 学习定位和识别 细节很难辨识。
与此同时,清除专用的分散注意力器造成最大的下降
以8.96分的成绩
预计这是因为基准的选项是用同一管道建造的。
使用专用的分心器带来更难的混淆,
迫使模型更密切地关注视觉细节,从而增强它在同一数据预算下的感知能力.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
To address the difficulty of constructing reliable fine-grained visual supervision at scale,
we propose ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that exploits the perception gap
between global and zoomed-in views.
ZoomGain turns details revealed only by zooming into questions about the full image,
verifies their answers on the zoomed view with multiple models,
and mines multi-source distractors that could mislead VLMs.
With this pipeline, we construct ZoomGainBench, a challenging benchmark
whose questions and answers are entirely model-authored. Through the analysis of failure cases, we find that different VLMs share similar confusions
when fine details are unresolved in the full image.
Experiments further show the effectiveness of ZoomGain data as training supervision,
which consistently improves VLMs’ capabilities of fine-grained perception,
general perception, and difficult perception and reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了解决大规模建立可靠的精细视觉监督的困难,
我们提出ZoomGain, 一个利用认知差距的数据构建管道
介于全球视图和放大视图之间。
ZoomGain只通过放大到关于完整图像的疑问来将揭示的细节化为现实,
用多种模型验证他们在放大视野上的答案,
和地雷多源分流器,可能误导VLM。
通过这个管道,我们构建了ZoomGain Bench, 一个挑战性的基准
他们的问答完全是模范著作. 通过对失败案例的分析,我们发现不同的 VLM 有着类似的混乱
当细节在完整图像中未解决时。
实验进一步显示ZoomGain数据作为培训监督的有效性,
不断提高甚高频感知能力,
以及困难的认知和推理

blocks.en:
After QA generation, EDGE_REWRITER inspects the crop and the full photograph with b i b_{i} marked,
together with both question forms and the reference answer.
It checks whether answer-bearing text or objects continue beyond the crop,
whether the global referent is unique, and whether both questions admit the same answer.
It returns keep , rewrite , or drop .
A bounded rewrite can add answer-free qualifiers valid in both views while preserving the non-OCR answer.
For OCR, it may narrow the question and answer to a complete text block or specified prefix/suffix
contained in the original answer, but cannot add text read from the full image.
Counting questions whose requested set extends outside the crop are discarded.
Revisions are synchronized across the local/global and English/Chinese questions,
and target and answer constraints are checked again before crop-based verification
(Section 3.3 ).
Both anchor enumeration and this audit use Qwen3.5-397B-A17B.

All verification stages sample 10 answers per model.
Crop-based verification requires at least 6 correct answers from each of its two models,

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 错误分析

blocks.en: This section complements Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 本节补充: 第5.2节

blocks.en:
Every evaluated model over-selects global-view errors:
they receive 65.0–78.2% of each model’s incorrect choices,
against 52.3–57.8% expected under uniform choice among the distractors of each question.
For the four closed-source models, which took no part in constructing the benchmark,
the shares are 75.7% versus 57.4%.
Their selection rate of a global-view error also rises with how consistently it arose during construction,
from 13.4% when given by one or two of the 30 full-image answers
to 35.2% when given more than ten times.
blocks.zh:
每个被评价的模型过度选择全局视图错误 :
他们得到每个模型错误选择的65.0-78.2%,
与52.3-57.8%相比,预计每个问题分散注意力者在统一选择下占52.3-57.8%。
四个封闭源码模型没有参与基准的构建,
比例为75.7%,而57.4%。
其环球视野误差的选取率也随着建造过程中出现的一贯性而上升,
由30个完整图像答案中的1个或2个给出的13.4%
超过10次时为35.2%。

blocks.en:
Models prefer some option positions over others.
Normalizing by the average selection rate of each option position,
global-view errors are still selected 1.34 times as often as expected,
and 1.46 times when they also coincide with blind guesses,
compared with 0.52 and 0.55 times for blind guesses and visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
模型倾向于某些选项位置,而不是其他选项位置。
按每个选项职位的平均甄选率实现正常化,
环球视图错误仍按预期次数选择1.34倍,
和1.46倍,当他们与盲目的猜想同时发生的时候,
与盲猜和视觉证据的0.52和0.55倍相比。

blocks.en:
Only 1.5% of Qwen3-VL-8B’s answers to attribute questions cannot be parsed,
so its below-chance accuracy does not stem from formatting failures.
Instead, 67.5% of its incorrect choices fall on global-view errors, against 54.0% expected.
Its responses typically claim to inspect the target closely
and then state a plausible but incorrect attribute,
for example describing a dark blue backpack as black.
blocks.zh:
Qwen3-VL-8B对属性问题的回答只有1.5%无法解析,
因此,它的下钱精度并不来自于格式化失败.
相反,其错误选择有67.5%落在全局视野错误上,而预期误差为54.0%。
其答复通常声称密切检查目标
然后说出一个合理但错误的属性,
例如描述一个深蓝色的背包为黑色.

blocks.en:
Counting errors are mostly near misses:
71.6% of incorrect numeric answers are off by exactly one,
and 67 of the 94 counting questions have a ground truth of at most three,
so the difficulty lies in resolving a few small instances rather than in enumerating many objects.
For OCR, among transcriptions without full credit,
29.1% remain close to the reference, with a character-level similarity of at least 0.5;
10.1% omit part of the target text or include adjacent text;
and at least 13.4% transcribe other text in the scene instead of the target,
as identified by matching predictions against the scene descriptions generated during construction.
Most of the remaining transcriptions bear little resemblance to the reference.
blocks.zh:
计数错误大多接近错失 :
71.6%的不正确数字解答 完全是一个,
在94个计数问题中,67个问题至少有3个
因此困难在于解决几个小事件,而不是列举许多对象。
对于OCR来说,在没有完全信用的记录中,
29.1%仍接近参考文献,字符级相似度至少为0.5;
10.1% 省略目标文本的一部分,或包括相邻文本;
并且至少13.4%在现场记录其他文字而不是目标,
与施工期间产生的场景描述相匹配。
其余大部分的抄录与参考文献几乎没有任何相似之处.

blocks.zh: 附录E 代表 失败案例

blocks.en: Appendix F ZoomGainBench Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 附录F ZoomGain Bench 评价设置

blocks.en:
All non-agentic models use the same system prompt as ZwZ Wei et al. (2026) ,
which asks the model to reason before placing its final answer within <answer> and </answer> tags.
The user message contains the full image and the question with its options, if applicable.
Counting questions additionally request Arabic numerals, while OCR questions request
only the transcription within the answer tags, preserving capitalization, spacing,
punctuation, and symbols.
The Chinese version replaces the question stem while retaining the options and formatting instructions.
blocks.zh:
所有非剂型号都使用与ZwZ Wei等人(2026年)相同的系统即时,
,它要求模型在将其最后答案放在“回答”和“回答”标记中之前进行解释。
用户信息包含完整图像和问题及其选项,如果适用的话。
计算问题额外请求阿拉伯数字,而OCR问题请求
只有解答标记中的转录,保留资本化,间隔,
点,和符号。
中文版在保留选项和格式化指令的同时,替换了题干.

blocks.en:
Qwen models, ZwZ, and Vision-OPD use a temperature of 0 and a maximum output length
of 2,048 tokens, with native thinking disabled via enable_thinking=false .
MiMo-VL-7B-RL uses the same temperature and output limit, with /no_think appended to the question.
GLM-4.6V and GLM-5.3-Flash use a temperature of 0 and output limits of 4,096 and
8,192 tokens, respectively; their requests also set enable_thinking=false .
Kimi-K3 is evaluated with thinking enabled, a temperature of 0, and an output limit
of 8,192 tokens.
GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6-Sol, Gemini-3.6-Flash, and Claude-Opus-5 use an output limit of
4,096 tokens and retain the provider defaults for temperature and thinking mode.
blocks.zh:
Quen模型, ZwZ, 和 Vision- OPD 使用0 的温度和最大输出长度
包含2,048个代币, 本地思维通过允许_ thinking=false 被禁。
MiMo-VL-7B-RL使用相同的温度和输出限制,问题后附有/no_think.
GLM-4.6V和GLM-5.3-Flash使用温度为0,输出极限为4,096和
分别是8,192个令牌;他们的要求也设置了允许_thinking=false.
Kimi- K3 评估时启用思维, 温度为 0, 输出限制
8,192个代币
GPT-5.5,GPT-5.6-Sol,双子座-3.6-Flash,和Claude-Opus-5使用输出限值为:
4,096个令牌并保留提供商默认温度和思维模式.

blocks.en:
The four agentic models use their native reasoning and tool-use prompts with
multi-turn image interactions, all at a temperature of 0.
The per-turn output limits are 10,240 tokens for DeepEyes and PixelReasoner,
20,480 for DeepEyesV2, and 2,048 for Thyme.
The total output budget is 32,768 tokens per question.
DeepEyes, DeepEyesV2, and PixelReasoner allow up to 11 turns, while Thyme allows 5;
the tool-call limit is 10 for all except PixelReasoner, which allows 4.
Generic answer-format instructions that conflict with the native agentic protocols are removed.
blocks.zh:
这四个代理模型使用其本地推理和工具使用提示
多圆形图像相互作用,均以0.
每回合输出限值为10,240个DeepEyes和PixelReasoner的令牌,
深EyesV2机型20,480架,Thyme机型2,048架.
每个问题的总产出预算为32,768个令牌。
DeepEyes、DeepEyesV2和PixelReasoner允许最多11个转弯,而Thyme允许5个转弯;
工具调用限制为 10, 但 PixelReasoner 除外, 它允许 4个
与本地代理协议冲突的通用答案格式指令被删除。

blocks.en: Appendix G Training and Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 附录G 培训和评价设置

blocks.en:
Both datasets are trained with direct RL using GRPO,
with a batch size of 64, 8 rollouts per question, and one epoch (140 steps),
and the checkpoint at step 140 is evaluated.
For both ZwZ and ZoomGain, we use a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} ,
no KL regularization, and a maximum response length of 2,046 tokens.
ZwZ images retain their native bounding-box overlays, whereas ZoomGain uses the original images.
For ZwZ, we follow the official reward definitions Wei et al. (2026) .
For ZoomGain, rewards follow the ZoomGainBench scoring rules:
multiple-choice and counting questions receive a reward of 1 for an exact match
on the selected option or predicted integer, respectively, and 0 otherwise.
OCR questions receive their ANLS score as the reward if it is at least 0.7 0.7 ,
and 0 otherwise.
blocks.zh:
两个数据集都使用GRPO进行直接RL培训,
批量规模为64个,每题8个,一个时代(140步),
并评估第140步检查站。
对ZwZ和ZomoGain来说,我们使用10 -6 10 -6的学习率,
没有KL规范化,最大响应长度为2,046令牌.
ZwZ图像保留其本土的边框覆盖,而ZoomGain则使用原始图像.
对于ZwZ,我们遵循官方的奖励定义Wei等人(2026年).
对于ZoomGain,奖励遵循ZoomGain Bench评分规则:
多选择和计数问题 获得1的奖励 准确匹配
中,或预测的整数。
OCR问题得到他们的ANLS分数 如果它至少是0.7,
和0 否则。

blocks.en:
For the training experiments, all models are evaluated with chain-of-thought prompting and a temperature of 0.
Within each benchmark, base and trained models share the same prompt profile and output limit:
2,048 new tokens for all benchmarks except BabyVision, PerceptionBench, and O3-Bench,
which use 8,192 tokens and are scored by GPT-5.5 as the answer judge.
MMVP is scored by paired accuracy, CV-Bench by its official balanced score,
and MME-RealWorld on 1,919 questions.
VisualProbe is reported as the question-weighted average of its easy (141), medium (268), and hard (106) splits.
blocks.zh:
就训练实验而言,所有模型都用思维链的提示和0的温度进行评估。
在每个基准中,基础模型和训练有素模型具有相同的即时配置和产出限制:
2,048个新的代币 用于所有基准,除了婴儿视觉, 感知奔奇,和O3-奔奇,
它使用8,192个令牌,由GPT-5.5评分作为答题裁判.
MMVP的得分是成对精度,CV-Bench的得分是官方的平衡分,
和MME-RealWorld的1,919个问题。
据报道,Visual Probe是它的易(141),中(268)和硬(106)的试题加权平均值.

blocks.en: Appendix H Global-to-Zoom Evidence and QA Construction Examples
blocks.zh: 附录H 全球至Zoom证据和质量保证

blocks.en:
Figures 9 – 11 illustrate the construction process in Section 3.2 for the three question types.
Each example shows the paired views and caption excerpts,
selected entries from the original incremental fact list,
and how one fact leads to a local QA pair and then a global QA pair.
Green text marks details newly described in the zoomed-view caption;
purple text highlights the local and global target references.
The zoomed views use the original pipeline crops.
blocks.zh:
图9-11说明了第3.2节中三种问题类型的施工过程。
每个例子都显示对齐的视图和标题节选,
从原始增量事实列表中选定的条目,
而一个事实如何导致一个本地的QA对,然后是全球的QA对.
在缩放视图标题中新描述的绿色文字标记细节;
紫色文本突出本地和全球目标参考.
放大视图使用原始的管道作物.

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Attribute QA construction example. The global-view caption mentions logos on a visor without specifying their shapes.
The zoomed-view caption identifies a small star-shaped logo.
This fact supports a shape question, which is rewritten using the global referring expression
while preserving the answer.
blocks.zh:
图9:属性QA构建实例. 全局视图标题提到一个面罩上的标志,但没有具体说明其形状。
缩放-视图字幕识别一个小星形标志.
此事实支持一个形状问题, 它使用全局引用表达式重写
在保留答案的同时

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Counting QA construction example. The global-view caption describes food images on digital menu boards without giving a count.
The zoomed-view caption identifies eight burger images arranged in two rows of four.
The selected fact yields a counting question with the same answer in both views.
blocks.zh:
图10:计算QA建筑实例. 全球视野字幕在数字菜单板上描述了食物图像,但没有进行计数。
缩放-视图字幕可以识别八幅汉堡画面,排列为两行四组.
选定的事实产生了一个计数问题,在两种观点中答案相同。

blocks.en:
Figure 11: OCR QA construction example. The global-view caption describes a bottle with a blue label without transcribing its text.
The zoomed-view caption reads the Chinese characters on the label.
The selected text fact supports a local OCR question, which is rewritten to identify
the bottle in the full image while retaining the original transcription as the answer.
blocks.zh:
图11:OCR QA构建实例. 全景字幕描述一个带有蓝色标签的瓶子而不翻转其文本.
缩放-视图字幕读取标签上的中文字符.
选定的文本事实支持一个本地 OCR 问题, 这个问题被重写以识别
完整图像中的瓶子,同时保留原抄本作为答案。

blocks.en: Appendix I Quality Verification Examples
blocks.zh: 附录一 质量核查实例

blocks.en:
Figures 12 and 13 show candidate QA pairs rejected by the two verification stages
in Section 3.3 .
Crop-based verification checks whether the image supports the generated reference answer,
while blind verification filters questions whose answers are predictable without an image.
All questions, candidate answers, and vote counts are taken from the original generation records.
blocks.zh:
图12和图13显示两个核查阶段拒绝的候选人质量保证对数
第3.3节。
基于裁剪的校验检查图像是否支持生成的参考答案,
而盲目的校验会过滤那些在没有图像的情况下答案可以预测的问题。
所有的问题,候选人的回答,以及计票,都取自最初的一代记录.

blocks.en:
Figure 12: Examples rejected by crop-based verification. The captions incorrectly describe (A) the race-car digit as “3” instead of “8”
and (B) the door handle as silver instead of white.
Both verification models give the visually supported answer in all 10 samples,
yielding zero matches to the generated reference answer and failing the 6/10 threshold.
The original crop inputs have no red anchor markers;
orange boxes and enlarged details are added only for display.
blocks.zh:
图12:以作物为基础的核查所否定的例子。 这些标题错误地将(A) 赛车数字描述为“3”而不是“8”
门把手为银,而非白。
两个核查模型都给出了所有10个样本中视觉支持的答案,
生成对生成的参考答案的零匹配值,并失败 6/10 阈值。
原始作物投入没有红色锚标;
橙色盒和放大细节仅用于展示。

blocks.en:
Figure 13: Examples rejected by blind verification. The reference answers, (A) drumsticks and (B) steam, are supported by the images,
but are also predictable from the questions alone.
Without images, the three models obtain 30/30 and 29/30 reference matches in total,
respectively, with every model meeting the rejection threshold of at least 3/10 matches.
The images and blue crop boxes are shown only for the reader;
no images are supplied to the blind models.
blocks.zh:
图13:盲目核查所拒绝的例子。 参考答案,(A)鼓棒和(B)蒸汽,由图像支持,
但仅从问题来看也是可预测的。
没有图像,三个模型总共获得30/30和29/30的参考匹配,
每个模型分别达到至少3/10匹配的拒绝门槛。
图像和蓝色作物盒仅供读者使用;
没有向盲模式提供图像 。

blocks.en: Appendix J Prompts Used in Data Construction
blocks.zh: 附录J 提示 用于数据构建

blocks.en:
This section provides the prompts for the roles described in Section 3 ,
plus anchor enumeration, marked/unmarked zoomed-view captioning, and EDGE_REWRITER from Appendix A .
Templates are taken from zoom_inc_pipeline/prompts.py ; view-dependent instruction blocks
are taken from their callers in pipeline.py .
Sample-specific placeholders such as {anchor} , {question} , and {reference} are filled at runtime. JSON braces are shown as literal braces rather than Python string escapes.
A line of the form <<<INSERT: NAME>>> denotes exact insertion of the named block below,
allowing shared instructions to be printed once without omitting their content.
The insertion notation is for presentation only and is not sent to the models.
blocks.zh:
本节说明第3节所述作用的提示。
加上锚点、标记/未标记的缩放视图标题和附录A中的EDGE_REWRITER。
模板取自缩放_inc_pipeline/promts.py; 依赖视图的指令块
取自管道中的呼叫者。 皮尔。
样本特定占位符如{anchor},{issue}和{Reference}在运行时填充. JSON牙套显示为字面牙套而非Python字符串逃生.
表格中的一行 QQINSERT: NAMEQQ 表示准确插入以下命名块,
允许共享指令打印一次而不省略其内容.
插入标记仅用于演示,不发给模型。

blocks.en:
CAPTION1 receives the full image with the crop region marked. CAPTION2 receives an unmarked zoomed view, while CAPTION2_ANCHOR_MARKED prepends marker-specific instructions to the same caption template.
The local anchor rule in QA generation is selected according to whether the zoomed view has an anchor marker. EDGE_REWRITER receives the crop and the full image with its crop region marked;
a candidate box on the crop can additionally locate the referent being audited.
Crop solvers answer the local question; full-image and blind solvers answer the global question,
with no image supplied for blind answering.
The Kimi format instruction is appended to its open-answer requests.
Visual distractor generation uses the appropriate crop/full-view rules.
MCQ verification sees the crop, local question, global question as context, and assembled choices.
blocks.zh:
CAPTION1接收了标有作物区域的完整图像. CAPTION2 接收到一个无标记的缩放视图,而CAPTION2_ANCHOR_MARKED 则预先将标记特定指令放在同一个标题模板中.
QA世代的本地锚定规则根据放大视图是否有锚定标记来选择. EDGE_重写 获得作物和完整的图像,并标明其作物区域;
作物上的候选盒可以额外找到正在审计的裁判。
作物解答者回答局部问题;全图像解答者和盲解者回答全球问题,
无法为盲目回答提供图像 。
Kimi格式指令附在其公开回答请求之后.
视觉干扰器生成使用适当的作物/全景规则.
MCQ核查将作物,局部问题,全球问题视为背景,并集合了选择.

blocks.en: J.1 Shared instructions
blocks.zh: J.1 共同指示

blocks.en: SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT — apply to every direction word you read or write: - LEFT/RIGHT BETWEEN OBJECTS uses the viewer’s frame of the image: ’the person to the left of the sign’ means left as seen by the viewer. Never mirror-compute the reference object’s own left/right when locating one object relative to another. When such a phrase is load-bearing, prefer explicit wording such as ’on the left side of the image’. - BODY PARTS are anatomical, never viewer-relative: ’right hand’ always means the person’s own right hand. Derive the side from the person’s facing direction, never from raw image position: facing the camera -> the right hand appears on the viewer’s LEFT; facing away from the camera -> the right hand appears on the viewer’s RIGHT; facing image-left -> the left side of the body is toward the camera; facing image-right -> the right side of the body is toward the camera. If the facing direction is not clearly visible, never use left/right body-part wording; identify the part another way (by what it holds or touches, or with explicit viewer wording such as ’the hand on the left side of the image’). - FRONT/BEHIND is NEVER a depth word. Scene depth must be written only as ’closer to the camera (than X)’ / ’farther from the camera (than X)’ / ’beyond X from the camera’s viewpoint’. The words front/behind are reserved exclusively for the intrinsic front/back sides of people, animals, and vehicles whose facing you have already stated: ’in front of the seated man’ is the side his face and chest point toward, and ’behind him’ is his back side, regardless of distance to the camera. - DEPTH-FLIP TRAP (the most common mistake — check every sentence): when the camera sees a person’s BACK, that person faces AWAY, so objects deeper in the scene are IN FRONT of that person, and objects between the camera and the person are behind them. Writing ’behind the man’ for a sign that lies beyond a man seen from the back is WRONG — write ’in front of the man (farther from the camera)’ or ’farther from the camera than the man’. The same flip applies to seated crowds watching something away from the camera. - For objects with no inherent front (poles, boxes, trees, candles, signs), never use front/behind at all; use camera-distance or image-position wording. - VEHICLE AND BUILDING PARTS use part terms fixed to the object itself: ’the cab end’, ’the rear of the trailer’, ’the side facing the camera’, ’the entrance side’. Never call a vehicle end ’front’ unless it is the actual forward/cab end of that vehicle. - GROUPS and entities whose facing cannot be determined: use the viewer frame with explicit image wording (’in the upper-left part of the image’, ’farther from the camera’), never intrinsic terms. - WHOSE FRAME ’THE IMAGE’ MEANS. Image-frame wording — ’in the upper-left part of the image’, ’near the left edge of the image’, ’图像左侧’ — always refers to the FULL photograph, and to nothing else.

" 总是指FLL照片,而别无其他。

blocks.en: SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT — apply to every direction word you read or write:
blocks.zh: SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT——适用于你读或写的每一个方向词:

blocks.en: - LEFT/RIGHT BETWEEN OBJECTS uses the viewer’s frame of the image: ’the person to the left of the sign’ means left as seen by the viewer. Never mirror-compute the reference object’s own left/right when locating one object relative to another. When such a phrase is load-bearing, prefer explicit wording such as ’on the left side of the image’.
blocks.zh: - LEFT/RIGHT objects之间使用观众的图像框: '观众看到的路标左侧的人左侧的手段. 在查找一个对象相对于另一个对象时, 绝不用镜像计算参考对象的左/右 。 当这样的短语充满负载时,倾向于明确的措辞,如 " 在图像的左边 " 。

blocks.en: - BODY PARTS are anatomical, never viewer-relative: ’right hand’ always means the person’s own right hand. Derive the side from the person’s facing direction, never from raw image position: facing the camera -> the right hand appears on the viewer’s LEFT; facing away from the camera -> the right hand appears on the viewer’s RIGHT; facing image-left -> the left side of the body is toward the camera; facing image-right -> the right side of the body is toward the camera. If the facing direction is not clearly visible, never use left/right body-part wording; identify the part another way (by what it holds or touches, or with explicit viewer wording such as ’the hand on the left side of the image’).
blocks.zh: - 身体部分是解剖学的,绝不是相对的: ' 右手 ' 总是指个人的右手。 从人物的正面方向衍生侧面,从不从原始图像位置:面对镜头 - > 右手出现在观众的LEFT上;面对镜头 - > 右手出现在观众的右边;面对图像-左 身体的左侧是向摄像头;正对着图像->身体的右侧是向摄像头。 如果面部方向没有清晰可见,就永远不要使用左/右身体部分的措辞;确定另一方式(用它持有或触碰的东西,或用 " 图像左侧的手 " 等清晰的观众措辞)。

blocks.en: - FRONT/BEHIND is NEVER a depth word. Scene depth must be written only as ’closer to the camera (than X)’ / ’farther from the camera (than X)’ / ’beyond X from the camera’s viewpoint’. The words front/behind are reserved exclusively for the intrinsic front/back sides of people, animals, and vehicles whose facing you have already stated: ’in front of the seated man’ is the side his face and chest point toward, and ’behind him’ is his back side, regardless of distance to the camera.
blocks.zh: - FRONT/BEHIND从来不是一个深度词。 场景深度只能写成 ' 关闭相机(比X) ' / ' 远离相机(比X) ' / ' 从相机的角度超越X ' 。 前面/后面的字是专指人们、动物和车辆的内在前/后两面的,你们已经指出: " 在坐在座位上的人的前面,他的脸和胸部指向的一边, " 他的后面是他的背面,无论与镜头的距离如何。

blocks.en: - DEPTH-FLIP TRAP (the most common mistake — check every sentence): when the camera sees a person’s BACK, that person faces AWAY, so objects deeper in the scene are IN FRONT of that person, and objects between the camera and the person are behind them. Writing ’behind the man’ for a sign that lies beyond a man seen from the back is WRONG — write ’in front of the man (farther from the camera)’ or ’farther from the camera than the man’. The same flip applies to seated crowds watching something away from the camera.
blocks.zh: - DEPTH-FLIP TRAP(最常见的错误——检查每个句子):当镜头看到一个人的背面时,那个人面对AWAY,所以更深处的物体是在那个人的FRONT中,镜头和那个人之间的物体就在后面. 写着`在人身后面 ' 的标语, 同样的翻转适用于坐着的人群在镜头之外观看一些东西.

blocks.en: - For objects with no inherent front (poles, boxes, trees, candles, signs), never use front/behind at all; use camera-distance or image-position wording.

blocks.en: - VEHICLE AND BUILDING PARTS use part terms fixed to the object itself: ’the cab end’, ’the rear of the trailer’, ’the side facing the camera’, ’the entrance side’. Never call a vehicle end ’front’ unless it is the actual forward/cab end of that vehicle.

blocks.zh: - 谁弱 ' 印象 ' 的含义。 图像框架的措辞—— " 在图像的左上角 " , " 靠近图像的左边缘 " , " . " 总是指FLL照片,而别无其他。

blocks.en: CROP FRAME CAVEAT: - Your view is a window cut out of the middle of a larger photograph, so its borders are not the photograph’s borders and its left side is not the photograph’s left side. A position read off this view may be stated only as local to it, never as image-frame wording. - A FRAME SIDE IS ONLY HONEST NEAR AN EDGE. ’on the left side of the image’ is worth saying about something in the outer third of the photograph; for anything nearer the middle it reads as a claim the object is not where it is, and a solver scanning that side will not find it. When the target sits toward the centre, locate it against a named object instead — ’just right of the fire hydrant’, ’in front of the bus shelter and a little to its left’ — which stays true wherever the frame is drawn. You cannot see where this crop sits in the photograph, so when in doubt prefer the named object. - FRAME SUPERLATIVES REQUIRE THE WHOLE PHOTOGRAPH. leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right, 最左, 最右, 最上, 最下, 最顶, 最底 assert that nothing of the kind lies further out, which only a view of the entire photograph can establish. Without that view do not write one in either language. Bounded superlatives inside one named host (’the bottom word on the blue sign’) are unaffected. - A HOST’S OWN CORNER NEEDS THAT CORNER IN VIEW. ’the bottom right corner of the window’, ’the top of the sign’, ’货架最下层’ name a position inside another object, and they are only true if THAT object’s edge on that side is visible here. When the host runs past the border, the corner you are looking at is the CROP’s corner, not the host’s, and the phrase points at something else entirely in the full photograph: a bookcase cropped to its top two shelves makes ’the book at the bottom of the bookcase’ name a green spine on the second shelf, while the bookcase’s real bottom shelf holds a red one. Use such a phrase only when you can see where the host ends on that side; otherwise identify the thing by what it is attached to, what is next to it, or its own visible attributes.
blocks.zh: CROP FRAME CAVAAT: - 您的视线是从更大的照片中间切出的窗口, 因此其边界不是照片的边界, 左侧不是照片的左侧。 从这一观点中读出的立场只能作为当地立场,而不能作为图像框架的措辞。 - 光线很短 离车厢很近 照片的左侧值得提及照片外三分之一的东西, 当目标坐到中心时,将目标定位在某个命名物体上 -- -- " 消防栓的右侧 " 、 " 公共汽车掩体的前面 " 、 " 左侧一点 " -- -- 无论画框在何处,都真实存在。 您无法看到照片中这个作物的位置, 所以当怀疑中更喜欢命名对象时 。 - 精密的超音速 需要整个摄影。 最左,最右,最右,最下,最左,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最右,最左,最右,最右,最 没有这种观点,就不用两种语言写一个。 一个有名的主机( ' 蓝色标志上的底字 ' )内有界的超人不会受到影响。 -一个旅店的老板需要这个 ' 窗口右下角 ' , ' 标志的顶部 ' , 指定另一个物体内的位置, 只有当该物体的边缘在这里可见时, 它们才是真的。 当主机穿过边界时,你所看到的角落是CROP的角落,而不是主机的角落,而句子的指点是全照片中的其他东西:一个书架割到其前两个书架上,使书架底部的书架成为第二书架上的绿色脊椎,而书架真正的底部书架则有一个红色的。 只有在看到主机结束在那一侧时才使用这样的短语;否则就用它附着的,旁边的,或者它自己的可见属性来识别该事物.

blocks.en: Describe this image thoroughly. Then list every distinct, individually identifiable object or structure you can see (buildings, boats, vehicles, people, signs, statues, gates, bridges, etc.). blocks.en: You are preparing referring expressions for a visual grounding model. Below is a description of an image. Extract up to {max_phrases} candidate landmark objects and rewrite each as a SELF-CONTAINED English referring phrase that would pick out exactly one object instance for someone looking at the image. Rules: - Each phrase must denote exactly ONE object instance. Add a position word (left / center / right, foreground / background) or a color/size attribute whenever the bare noun could match several instances. - Position words inside a phrase must be IMAGE-FRAME words only: left / center / right, upper / lower, foreground / background, closest to the camera. NEVER locate a candidate with ’in front of’, ’behind’, ’ahead of’, or ’beyond’ another object or person — depth intent is ambiguous and grounding models disagree on it. blocks.en: You are given a full image with one highlighted red rectangular region. Describe **only the visual content inside the highlighted region and never mention the rest of the image.** Use the rest of the image only as context. The pipeline has pre-selected one anchor object inside this region (localization metadata only): "{anchor}" ANCHOR-CENTERED ORGANIZATION (same convention as the zoomed view): treat this anchor as the primary reference point of the description, not as its exclusive scope. First identify the anchor and state every attribute of it that is discernible at this scale, then cover its immediate neighborhood, then the rest of the region. Whenever visually supported, express other objects’ positions relative to this anchor. The anchor phrase is localization metadata only: never copy an attribute, text, count, or relation from the phrase unless you can independently see it in the image. If several objects match the phrase, describe each of them and say the reference is ambiguous; if you cannot confidently locate the referent, say so and describe the region normally. The anchor never shrinks your coverage duty: everything else plainly visible in the region must still be described. YOUR CAPTION DEFINES WHAT THE FULL-IMAGE VIEW CAN SEE. A later stage compares this caption against a zoomed-in description of exactly the same region and treats every attribute you omitted as "not visible at full-image scale". The zoomed description follows the same spatial and inclusion rules as this one; the only intended difference between the two descriptions is resolution. Omitting something that is in fact plainly visible therefore corrupts the comparison. Be exhaustive about everything you can genuinely discern at this scale, and explicit about what you cannot. EXHAUSTIVENESS CONTRACT (work from large to small): - For every large or prominent object in the region — especially people — state ALL attributes that are plainly discernible at this scale: garment types and their colors (shirt, pants, dress, hat, shoes), object colors and materials, obvious pose or action, obviously identifiable held or attached items, and coarse spatial relations between the described objects. A large foreground person whose shirt color is obvious must have that shirt color stated. - Then cover mid-sized objects the same way. - For small objects and fine details (small text, small items, precise counts, subtle patterns, distant faces), report what is discernible and explicitly say "unclear" or "not readable at this scale" for the rest. Saying unclear is valuable signal; silently skipping is not. - Do not compress multiple distinct objects into one vague summary sentence when their individual attributes are visible. - When several instances of one category are present (price tags, signs, windows), bind each described instance to a stable qualifier — attachment or nearest-object relation, a part location on its host, or an explicit image-frame position — instead of the bare category noun. <<<INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>> PERSON ORIENTATION: before naming a person’s own left/right body side or a side-specific held item, state which way that person faces and derive the side per the contract above. When the facing is not discernible at this scale, use viewer wording (’the hand on the viewer’s left’) or say the side is unclear; never guess an anatomical side. RECTANGLE-EDGE POLICY (aligned with the zoomed view): the rectangle boundary is an artificial viewport, not photographed scene content. For a discrete object that crosses the boundary, apply exactly one branch: - If it cannot be confidently identified, or no complete part of it lies inside the region, omit it entirely. - If it is clearly identifiable and at least one of its parts is completely visible inside the region, you MAY describe exactly those fully visible parts and their discernible attributes; say "unclear" for their small details. Never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, or totals for such an object, and never describe the part outside the region even though the full image shows it — it is outside this region’s scope. - Never mention the clipping itself anywhere in the caption: no "partially visible", "cut off", or "at the edge" wording. Describe what is inside, say unclear for what is too small, and stay silent about the rest. - Large scene surfaces or structures may be described when a substantial, meaningful portion lies inside the region; do not describe their truncation. Before returning the caption, perform a mandatory deletion check: remove every sentence that mentions the rectangle boundary or an object’s clipped state. If a small detail is not readable at this scale, explicitly say it is unclear. Do not guess counts, text, colors, or actions that are not visually clear.
blocks.zh: 一个突出的红色长方形区域给你一个完整的图像。 仅描述突出区域内的视觉内容,而不提其他图像。 ** 只将图像的其余部分用作上下文 。 管道预选了这个区域内的一个锚定对象(仅本地化元数据):"{anchor}" ANCHOR-CentERED Organization(与放大视角相同的公约):将这个锚定作为描述的主要参考点,而不是作为其专属范围. 首先,确定锚点,说明其在这个规模上可以发现的每个属性,然后覆盖其邻近地区,然后覆盖该地区的其他地区。 视像支持时, 显示相对于此锚的其他对象的位置 。 主机短语仅是本地化元数据:不从短语中复制属性,文本,计数,或关系,除非能在图像中独立看到. 如果几个对象与短语相匹配,请描述每个对象,并说引用模棱两可;如果你不能自信地找到引用者,请说,并正常描述区域. 主播从不收缩你的覆盖责任:该地区其他显而易见的东西仍然必须描述。 你的能力 定义什么 完整的图像可以看到。 稍后阶段将这个标题与完全相同的区域的缩放描述进行比较,并将你省略的每个属性视为"在全图像尺度上不可见". 缩放的描述遵循与这个描述相同的空间和包含规则;两个描述之间唯一预期的区别是分辨率. 暗示一些事实上显而易见的东西,因此会破坏比较。 要详尽地说明你能真正从这个尺度中看出的一切,并明确你所不能知道的一切。 对该区域每一大或突出物体——特别是人们——来说,说明在这一尺度上可明显看出的所有属性:服装类型及其颜色(衬衫、裤子、裙子、帽子、鞋子)、物体颜色和材料、明显的姿势或动作、明显可识别的持有或附着的物品以及上述物体之间的粗糙空间关系。 一个大前台的人,其衬衫颜色明显,必须注明衬衫颜色. - 然后用同样的方式覆盖中型物体。 - 对于小物体和细微的细节(小文字,小项,精确的计数,微妙的图案,遥远的面孔),报告哪些是可察觉的,并明确说"不清楚"或"在这个尺度上是不可读的". 说不清楚是有价值的信号,沉默跳过不是。 当单个属性可见时,不要将多个不同的对象压缩成一个模糊的简要句. - 怎么样? 当存在一个类别的若干例(价格标记,标志,窗口)时,将每个被描述的实例绑定在一个稳定的限定符上——附件或最近的对象关系,其主机上的一部分位置,或明确的图像框位置,而不是赤裸的类别名词. (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>>. 个人组织:在指定一个人的左/右身体一方或某一侧特定持有的物品之前,说明该人如何面对和获得上述合同的一方。 当面孔在这个尺度上无法辨识时,使用查看器的措辞( ' 查看器左侧的手 ' )或者说侧面不清楚;永远不要猜测解剖面. RECTANGLE-EDGE Policy(与放大视图一致):矩形边界是一个人工的视图,没有拍摄场景内容. 对于跨越边界的离散物体,适用一个分支: - 如果无法自信地识别,或者没有完整的部分位于区域内,则完全省略. - 如果可以明确识别,而且至少其中一部分在区域内是完全可见的,那么你就可以确切地描述那些完全可见的部分及其可辨识的属性;说出小细节的"不明确". 永远不要描述这样的物体的全对象属性,全体动作,或总数,也永远不要描述这个区域以外的部分,尽管完整的图像显示了它——它超出了这个区域的范围. - 在标题中不要在任何地方提及剪辑本身:没有“部分可见”、“切开”或“边缘”措辞。 描述里面的东西, 说不清楚什么太小, 并保持缄默 关于其余。 - 大型场景表面或结构,如果有相当大、有意义的部分位于区域内,则可以描述;不要描述它们的截断。 在返回标题前, 执行强制删除检查: 删除每个提及矩形边界或对象剪切状态的句子 。 如果一个小细节在这个尺度上无法读取,则明确说不清楚. 不要猜测数字、 文本、 颜色、 或未清晰可见的动作 。

The anchor phrase is localization metadata only: never copy an attribute, text, count, or relation from the phrase unless you can independently see it in the image. If several objects match the phrase, describe each of them and say the reference is ambiguous; if you cannot confidently locate the referent, say so and describe the region normally. The anchor never shrinks your coverage duty: everything else plainly visible in the region must still be described.
blocks.zh: A. 核心组织 (与放大观点相同的公约):将这个锚作为描述的主要参考点,而不是其专属范围. 首先,确定锚点,说明其在这个规模上可以发现的每个属性,然后覆盖其邻近地区,然后覆盖该地区的其他地区。 视像支持时, 显示相对于此锚的其他对象的位置 。 主机短语仅是本地化元数据:不从短语中复制属性,文本,计数,或关系,除非能在图像中独立看到. 如果几个对象与短语相匹配,请描述每个对象,并说引用模棱两可;如果你不能自信地找到引用者,请说,并正常描述区域. 主播从不收缩你的覆盖责任:该地区其他显而易见的东西仍然必须描述。

blocks.en: YOUR CAPTION DEFINES WHAT THE FULL-IMAGE VIEW CAN SEE. A later stage compares this caption against a zoomed-in description of exactly the same region and treats every attribute you omitted as "not visible at full-image scale". The zoomed description follows the same spatial and inclusion rules as this one; the only intended difference between the two descriptions is resolution. Omitting something that is in fact plainly visible therefore corrupts the comparison. Be exhaustive about everything you can genuinely discern at this scale, and explicit about what you cannot.
blocks.zh: 你的能力 定义什么 完整的图像可以看到。 稍后阶段将这个标题与完全相同的区域的缩放描述进行比较,并将你省略的每个属性视为"在全图像尺度上不可见". 缩放的描述遵循与这个描述相同的空间和包含规则;两个描述之间唯一预期的区别是分辨率. 暗示一些事实上显而易见的东西,因此会破坏比较。 要详尽地说明你能真正从这个尺度中看出的一切,并明确你所不能知道的一切。

blocks.en: EXHAUSTIVENESS CONTRACT (work from large to small):
blocks.zh: 合同(从大到小的工作):

blocks.en: - For every large or prominent object in the region — especially people — state ALL attributes that are plainly discernible at this scale: garment types and their colors (shirt, pants, dress, hat, shoes), object colors and materials, obvious pose or action, obviously identifiable held or attached items, and coarse spatial relations between the described objects. A large foreground person whose shirt color is obvious must have that shirt color stated.
blocks.zh: - 对于该区域每一个大型或突出物体,特别是人们,说明在这一尺度上显而易见的所有属性:服装类型及其颜色(衬衫、裤子、裙子、帽子、鞋子)、物体颜色和材料、明显的姿势或动作、明显可识别的持有或附着的物品以及上述物体之间的粗糙空间关系。 一个大前台的人,其衬衫颜色明显,必须注明衬衫颜色.

blocks.en: - Then cover mid-sized objects the same way.
blocks.zh: - 然后用同样的方式覆盖中型物体。

blocks.en: - For small objects and fine details (small text, small items, precise counts, subtle patterns, distant faces), report what is discernible and explicitly say "unclear" or "not readable at this scale" for the rest. Saying unclear is valuable signal; silently skipping is not.
blocks.zh: - 对于小物体和细微的细节(小文字,小项,精确的计数,微妙的图案,遥远的面孔),报告哪些是可察觉的,并明确说"不清楚"或"在这个尺度上是不可读的". 说不清楚是有价值的信号;沉默跳过不是。

blocks.en: - Do not compress multiple distinct objects into one vague summary sentence when their individual attributes are visible.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 当单个属性可见时,不要将多个不同的对象压缩成一个模糊的简要句.

blocks.en: - When several instances of one category are present (price tags, signs, windows), bind each described instance to a stable qualifier — attachment or nearest-object relation, a part location on its host, or an explicit image-frame position — instead of the bare category noun.
blocks.zh: - 当存在一个类别的几个实例(价格标记、标志、窗口)时,将每个被描述的实例绑定在一个稳定的限定词上——附件或最近的对象关系、其主机上的一部分位置,或一个明确的图像框位置,而不是赤裸的类别名词。
