blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>>.

blocks.en: PERSON ORIENTATION: before naming a person’s own left/right body side or a side-specific held item, state which way that person faces and derive the side per the contract above. When the facing is not discernible at this scale, use viewer wording (’the hand on the viewer’s left’) or say the side is unclear; never guess an anatomical side.
blocks.zh: 个人组织:在指定一个人的左/右身体一方或某一侧特定持有的物品之前,说明该人如何面对和获得上述合同的一方。 当面孔在这个尺度上无法辨识时,使用查看器的措辞( ' 查看器左侧的手 ' )或者说侧面不清楚;永远不要猜测解剖面.

blocks.en: RECTANGLE-EDGE POLICY (aligned with the zoomed view): the rectangle boundary is an artificial viewport, not photographed scene content. For a discrete object that crosses the boundary, apply exactly one branch:
blocks.zh: RECTANGLE-EDGE Policy(与放大视图一致):矩形边界是一个人工的视图,没有拍摄场景内容. 对于跨越边界的离散物体,适用一个分支:

blocks.en: - If it cannot be confidently identified, or no complete part of it lies inside the region, omit it entirely.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果不能有把握地确定,或者没有完整的部分存在于区域内,则完全省略。

blocks.en: - If it is clearly identifiable and at least one of its parts is completely visible inside the region, you MAY describe exactly those fully visible parts and their discernible attributes; say "unclear" for their small details. Never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, or totals for such an object, and never describe the part outside the region even though the full image shows it — it is outside this region’s scope.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果它可以明确识别,并且至少有一部分在区域内是完全可见的,那么你就可以确切地描述那些完全可见的部分及其可辨识的属性;对于它们的小细节说"不明确". 永远不要描述这样的物体的全对象属性,全体动作,或总数,也永远不要描述这个区域以外的部分,尽管完整的图像显示了它——它超出了这个区域的范围.

blocks.en: - Never mention the clipping itself anywhere in the caption: no "partially visible", "cut off", or "at the edge" wording. Describe what is inside, say unclear for what is too small, and stay silent about the rest.
blocks.zh: - 在标题中不要在任何地方提及剪辑本身:没有“部分可见”、“切开”或“边缘”措辞。 描述里面的东西, 说不清楚什么太小, 并保持缄默 关于其余。

blocks.en: - Large scene surfaces or structures may be described when a substantial, meaningful portion lies inside the region; do not describe their truncation.
blocks.zh: - 大型场景表面或结构,如果有相当大、有意义的部分位于区域内,则可以描述;不要描述它们的截断。

blocks.en: Before returning the caption, perform a mandatory deletion check: remove every sentence that mentions the rectangle boundary or an object’s clipped state.
blocks.zh: 在返回标题前, 执行强制删除检查: 删除每个提及矩形边界或对象剪切状态的句子 。

blocks.en: If a small detail is not readable at this scale, explicitly say it is unclear. Do not guess counts, text, colors, or actions that are not visually clear.
blocks.zh: 如果一个小细节在这个尺度上无法读取,则明确说不清楚. 不要猜测数字、 文本、 颜色、 或未清晰可见的动作 。

blocks.en: You are given an image crop constructed around one selected anchor object. Selected anchor object (localization metadata only): "{anchor}" Write a detailed natural-language caption organized around this selected anchor and its visible neighborhood. Treat the anchor as the primary reference point, not as the exclusive scope of the caption. Coverage and organization: - First describe the selected anchor itself in detail, including every clearly visible part, content, marking, readable text, color, attribute, condition, or action that belongs to it. - Then describe every other clearly visible object and detail in the image. Do not omit reliable visual information merely because it is not part of the anchor. - Whenever visually supported, express each other object’s relationship to the anchor, preferring frame-free devices: attached to it, contained in it, on it, nearest to it, or beside it at the same depth. When a direction word is needed, it must follow the SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT below: left/right between objects are the viewer’s (write ’to the viewer’s left of the anchor’, never the anchor’s own left/right), above/below are image-vertical, front/behind may only name the intrinsic sides of a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing you have stated, and any depth difference is written as closer to / farther from the camera. - If no reliable relationship to the anchor can be established, still describe the visible object with a neutral location within this crop. Never invent a relationship merely to connect it to the anchor. - DEPTH ZONES (mandatory): this crop is a 2D window that may span very different scene depths. For every non-anchor object you describe, make its depth relation to the anchor explicit: in the anchor’s own depth zone, clearly closer to the camera than the anchor, or clearly farther from the camera. Never say an object is near, beside, or next to the anchor when it merely appears close in the 2D frame while lying at a clearly different depth (e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a distant lighthouse is ’much closer to the camera than the lighthouse’, never ’near the lighthouse’). - The anchor phrase above is only localization metadata. Do not copy or assume any attribute, text, identity, or full-scene relationship from that phrase unless it is independently visible in this image. <<<INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>><<<INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT>>> PERSON ORIENTATION AND HANDS (mandatory): - Before describing any person’s pose, clothing sides, held objects, or body-part sides, state which way that person faces: toward the camera, away from the camera, toward the image-left, toward the image-right, or ’facing unclear’ when it cannot be determined. - POSE BEFORE SIDE: when two limbs of one person must be told apart, prefer a pose or state descriptor that needs no laterality at all — the raised arm versus the arm hanging at the side, the hand gripping the strap, the gloved hand, the arm resting on the table. Such wording is unambiguous for any viewer and stays true regardless of facing. - Name an anatomical side only when a pose descriptor cannot separate the limbs AND the person’s facing is unmistakable at this resolution (their face, or their back, is plainly readable — not inferred from a few pixels of hair or shoulder). Then derive the side from that stated facing per the frame contract and include the viewer-side derivation in parentheses so it is checkable, for example: ’He faces away from the camera; his right hand (on the viewer’s right) holds a silver can.’ - If the facing is not unmistakable, never write ’left hand’ or ’right hand’: write the pose descriptor, or ’one hand (laterality unclear)’ plus a viewer-frame location. A small or distant person is exactly the case where a confident side claim is unsafe. - Whenever you describe what one hand holds, account for the other hand in the same pass: either describe what it visibly holds (or that it is visibly empty), or record it in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section as out of view with unknown content. INSTANCE LOCKING FOR REPEATED OBJECTS: - When the crop shows, or plausibly extends into, more than one instance of a category — price tags, labels, signs, screens, windows, wheels, hands, shoes, bags, and similar repeated items — never attach information to the bare category noun. Bind every described instance to a stable qualifier that would remain valid in the full image: an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), or a part location on its host (’on the tail of the aircraft’). - A position in this frame is NOT such a qualifier and never counts as one. This crop is a window cut out of a larger photograph and its borders are not the photograph’s borders: whatever is leftmost, rightmost, or ’on the left side’ HERE can sit dead centre, or on the opposite side, of the full image. Never write a frame superlative — leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right — about anything in any wording: you cannot see what lies outside this crop, so you cannot know that anything in it is the outermost one. - When a rough position genuinely helps a reader picture the scene, word it as local to this crop (’in the left part of this crop’), never as a fact about the image. An instance with no attachment or part qualifier is described without one and recorded in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section, not pinned by position. Include useful details such as objects, readable text, colors, attributes, actions, and spatial relationships. There is no required schema, bullet format, or fixed wording; organize the description naturally. Base every statement only on visual evidence in this crop: - HONEST EDGE REPORTING: the four outer crop edges are artificial viewport boundaries, not photographed scene content. When an object is cut off by an outer edge (the anchor included), simply say what you see: describe its clearly visible parts and their attributes, and never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, totals, or overall shape/size for it, and never guess what continues beyond the edge. Keep the main description positive — what IS visible — and put every cut-off / partially-visible / out-of-view remark in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section at the end instead. A truncated object you cannot even identify belongs only in that section. - For text, use a deliberately conservative, character-by-character standard. A character is clearly legible only when its complete glyph shape and boundaries are visible and there is no reasonable alternative reading; prefer a shorter certain transcription over a longer plausible one, and never use language, brand, or scene context to complete a word. If the entire inscription meets this standard, transcribe it exactly. Otherwise never guess the uncertain characters: when a contiguous substring of at least three characters is clearly legible, report only that substring, say the rest is unclear, and state where it sits (its character count and whether it is the beginning, end, or middle). Call it a beginning or ending only when that text boundary is itself visible in the crop, and say whether the character touching the uncertain side has a complete isolated glyph — under cropping, occlusion, blur, or small scale such boundary characters are unreliable. If the sign, panel, or surface carrying an inscription is itself cut off by the crop edge at or near the text region, treat the inscription as partial with the cut side uncertain even when every visible glyph is complete — the crop is not a god’s-eye view and the text may continue on the hidden part. Never attribute text to an object unless it is visibly printed on that object. TEXT COLOR CAUTION: outlined or two-tone glyphs are easily misread at this scale — dark characters with a light outline routinely look like white text on a dark panel. State a text color only when the stroke FILL color is unambiguous; when uncertain, write ’light-colored text on a dark panel’ or ’dark text on a light panel’, or omit the color entirely. A guessed text color must never appear. FIGURE AND GROUND: a panel’s color is never the glyphs’ color. Name the color of the strokes and the color of the surface they sit on as two separate facts (’red characters on a yellow panel’), and never let one stand in for the other. Watch multi-tone signs especially: a fascia whose left panel is green and whose right panel is white has TWO panel colors and neither of them is a text color, so writing ’white letters’ for black letters on its white panel is the same error as guessing. Illuminated night signage is where this goes wrong most. - COUNTING-SCOPE POLICY: do not state an exact number merely because N instances happen to be visible in this crop. An exact count is allowed only in one of these two cases: (A) ANCHOR-OWNED SET: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, and the complete anchor-side set relevant to the count is visible. (B) FULLY CLOSED ANCHOR-RELATIVE REGION: the counted items lie in a finite interval or region defined by the selected anchor and another specific visible object, and every boundary needed to delimit that region is fully visible in the crop. The crop edges must never serve as those boundaries. Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, to the left/right of, in the background, in the water, on the beach, or on the road merely locate visible instances; they do not close a counting set. Sea, water, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, and other surfaces or scene regions that continue beyond the crop are open sets, even when every instance currently visible in the crop is sharp and separable. For an open set, use non-numeric wording such as ’several are visible’ when useful, and state that the exact scene total cannot be determined from the crop. Never estimate or give a range. - Do not infer hidden parts or use world knowledge to fill gaps. Describe uncertain details as unclear. End the caption with a final section exactly titled ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES:’. It is a short bullet inventory whose only purpose is to warn later stages which references would be ambiguous or open; it is not a description and can never be quoted as visual evidence: - List each same-category counterpart whose content is unknown because it is cut off by a crop edge, out of view, or occluded: the other hand of a person when you described one hand, additional price tags/labels/signs beyond the ones you fully described, the unseen remainder of a vehicle or large object when you described one of its parts. - Each note records only: the entity class and its owner or host (’the man’s other hand’, ’additional price tags’, ’the rest of the blue trailer’), its status (cut off at which edge, out of view, or occluded), and ’content unknown’ when applicable. - Notes must NEVER contain attributes, colors, counts, actions, or transcribed text, and must never guess what the hidden content might be. - If nothing qualifies, end with exactly ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES: none.’
blocks.zh: 给您一个围绕一个选定锁定对象构建的图像裁剪 。 选中的锁定对象( 只本地化元数据 ): “ { anchor} ” 写一个围绕此选定锚及其可见的邻里排列的详细自然语言标题 。 把锚作为主要参考点,而不是标题的专属范围. 覆盖和组织: - 首先详细描述所选主播本身,包括每个清晰可见的部分,内容,标识,可读文本,颜色,属性,条件,或属于它的动作. - 然后描述图像中所有其他清晰可见的对象和细节. 不要仅仅因为可靠视觉信息不是主播的一部分而省略. - 视像支持时,表达对方物体与锚的关系,偏爱无框装置:附着在它上,内含在它上,离它最近,或在同一深度旁边. 当需要一个方向词时,它必须遵循下面的SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT: 物体之间的左/右是查看者(写在主播左边,从不写在主播自己的左/右),上/下是图像垂直的,前/后只能标出你所描述的人、动物或车辆的内在侧面,任何深度差异都写成接近/更远的镜头. - 如果无法建立与锚的可靠关系,仍可描述在该作物中具有中性位置的可见物体。 永远不要发明一种关系 仅仅为了连接它与主播。 - DEPTH ZONES(强制性):这种作物是一个二维窗口,可能跨越非常不同的场景深度. 对于您描述的每一个非锚地物体,请明确其与锚地的深度关系:在锚地本身的深度区,明显比锚地更靠近镜头,或者明显离镜头更远. 永远不要说一个物体靠近、靠近或靠近锚, 它只是出现在2D框架, 却躺在明显不同的深度(例如, - 上面的锚词只是本地化元数据. 不复制或假设该短语中的任何属性,文本,身份,或全景关系,除非它在此图像中独立可见. blocks.en: Write a detailed natural-language caption organized around this selected anchor and its visible neighborhood. Treat the anchor as the primary reference point, not as the exclusive scope of the caption.
blocks.zh: 写一个详细的自然语言字幕 围绕这个选定的主播 及其可见的邻里。 把锚作为主要参考点,而不是标题的专属范围.

blocks.en: Coverage and organization:
blocks.zh: 覆盖范围和组织:

blocks.en: - First describe the selected anchor itself in detail, including every clearly visible part, content, marking, readable text, color, attribute, condition, or action that belongs to it.
blocks.zh: - 首先详细描述选定的锚本身,包括每一明显可见的部分、内容、标记、可读文本、颜色、属性、条件或属于它的动作。

blocks.en: - Then describe every other clearly visible object and detail in the image. Do not omit reliable visual information merely because it is not part of the anchor.
blocks.zh: - 然后描述图像中所有其他明显可见的物体和细节。 不要仅仅因为可靠视觉信息不是主播的一部分而省略.

blocks.en: - Whenever visually supported, express each other object’s relationship to the anchor, preferring frame-free devices: attached to it, contained in it, on it, nearest to it, or beside it at the same depth. When a direction word is needed, it must follow the SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT below: left/right between objects are the viewer’s (write ’to the viewer’s left of the anchor’, never the anchor’s own left/right), above/below are image-vertical, front/behind may only name the intrinsic sides of a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing you have stated, and any depth difference is written as closer to / farther from the camera.
blocks.zh: - 视像支持时,表达对方物体与锚的关系,偏爱无框装置:附着在它上,内含在它上,离它最近,或在同一深度旁边. 当需要一个方向词时,它必须遵循下面的SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT: 物体之间的左/右是查看者(写在主播左边,从不写在主播自己的左/右),上/下是图像垂直的,前/后只能标出你所描述的人、动物或车辆的内在侧面,任何深度差异都写成接近/更远的镜头.

blocks.en: - If no reliable relationship to the anchor can be established, still describe the visible object with a neutral location within this crop. Never invent a relationship merely to connect it to the anchor.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果无法建立与锚的可靠关系,则仍然描述此裁剪中性位置的可见物体. 永远不要发明一种关系 仅仅为了连接它与主播。

blocks.en: - DEPTH ZONES (mandatory): this crop is a 2D window that may span very different scene depths. For every non-anchor object you describe, make its depth relation to the anchor explicit: in the anchor’s own depth zone, clearly closer to the camera than the anchor, or clearly farther from the camera. Never say an object is near, beside, or next to the anchor when it merely appears close in the 2D frame while lying at a clearly different depth (e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a distant lighthouse is ’much closer to the camera than the lighthouse’, never ’near the lighthouse’).

blocks.en: PERSON ORIENTATION AND HANDS (mandatory):
blocks.zh: 人员组织和手(强制性):

blocks.en: - Before describing any person’s pose, clothing sides, held objects, or body-part sides, state which way that person faces: toward the camera, away from the camera, toward the image-left, toward the image-right, or ’facing unclear’ when it cannot be determined.
blocks.zh: - 在描述任何人的姿势之前,服装的侧面、持有的物体或身体部分的侧面都写明了这个人的面貌:对着镜头,离镜头远点,对着图像左侧,对着图像右侧,或者当无法确定的时候,`模糊不清'。

blocks.en: - POSE BEFORE SIDE: when two limbs of one person must be told apart, prefer a pose or state descriptor that needs no laterality at all — the raised arm versus the arm hanging at the side, the hand gripping the strap, the gloved hand, the arm resting on the table. Such wording is unambiguous for any viewer and stays true regardless of facing.
blocks.zh: - POSE在SIDE之前:当一个人的两肢必须分开时,偏爱一种姿势或完全不需要后期的状态描述——举起的手臂与悬在侧面的手臂,手握绑,手套手,手臂放在桌子上. 对于任何观众来说,这种措辞是毫不含糊的,无论面对什么,都是真实的。

blocks.en: - Name an anatomical side only when a pose descriptor cannot separate the limbs AND the person’s facing is unmistakable at this resolution (their face, or their back, is plainly readable — not inferred from a few pixels of hair or shoulder). Then derive the side from that stated facing per the frame contract and include the viewer-side derivation in parentheses so it is checkable, for example: ’He faces away from the camera; his right hand (on the viewer’s right) holds a silver can.’
blocks.zh: - 只有当一个姿势描述器无法将四肢分开,而且此人的面孔在这个解析度上是无可遮掩的时,才说出解剖的一面(其面部或背部显然可以读取——不能从几像素的头发或肩部推断出来)。 然后从框架合同中注明的面额中得出侧面,并在括号中加入取景器侧面的衍生物,因此可以核对,例如: 他的右手握着银罐, ' ' 说

blocks.en: - If the facing is not unmistakable, never write ’left hand’ or ’right hand’: write the pose descriptor, or ’one hand (laterality unclear)’ plus a viewer-frame location. A small or distant person is exactly the case where a confident side claim is unsafe.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果面孔不清晰,就永远不要写 " 左手 " 或 " 右手 " :写姿势描述符,或者 " 一只手(边际性不明) " ,加上一个取景方位。 一个小的或遥远的人恰恰是自信的一方主张不安全的情况。

blocks.en: - Whenever you describe what one hand holds, account for the other hand in the same pass: either describe what it visibly holds (or that it is visibly empty), or record it in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section as out of view with unknown content.
blocks.zh: - 当你描述一只手所持有的东西时,应说明另一只手在同一条路口:要么说明它所明显持有的东西(或它明显是空的),要么将其记录在VISILILIY和Refence Notes部分,视而不见,内容不明。

blocks.en: INSTANCE LOCKING FOR REPEATED OBJECTS:
blocks.zh: 准备重现目标:

blocks.en: - When the crop shows, or plausibly extends into, more than one instance of a category — price tags, labels, signs, screens, windows, wheels, hands, shoes, bags, and similar repeated items — never attach information to the bare category noun. Bind every described instance to a stable qualifier that would remain valid in the full image: an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), or a part location on its host (’on the tail of the aircraft’).
blocks.zh: - 当作物显示,或合理扩展成一个以上类别时——价格标记、标签、标志、屏幕、窗户、轮子、手、鞋、袋和类似的重复物品——绝不在赤裸的类别名词中附加信息。 将每个描述的示例与完整图像中仍然有效的稳定限定语连接在一起:附件或最近的物体关系( ' 最近的水壶 ' ),或其主机上的一部分位置( ' 飞机尾部 ' )。

blocks.en: - A position in this frame is NOT such a qualifier and never counts as one. This crop is a window cut out of a larger photograph and its borders are not the photograph’s borders: whatever is leftmost, rightmost, or ’on the left side’ HERE can sit dead centre, or on the opposite side, of the full image. Never write a frame superlative — leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right — about anything in any wording: you cannot see what lies outside this crop, so you cannot know that anything in it is the outermost one.
blocks.zh: - 在这个框架中的地位不是这种限定语,从不算一个。 这种作物是大照片的窗口,其边界不是照片的边界:无论什么是最左、最右或左侧。 这里可以坐死中心,或者在反面, 整个图像。 永远不要用任何措辞来写一个框架的超级——最左,最右,最上,最下,最左,最右——关于任何内容:你看不到这个作物外面的东西,所以你无法知道里面的东西是最外的.

blocks.en: - When a rough position genuinely helps a reader picture the scene, word it as local to this crop (’in the left part of this crop’), never as a fact about the image. An instance with no attachment or part qualifier is described without one and recorded in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section, not pinned by position.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 当一个粗糙的位置真正帮助读者描绘场景时, 无附件或部分限定词的事例没有说明,记录在VISILILITY和参考说明部分,而不是以位置为主。

blocks.en: Include useful details such as objects, readable text, colors, attributes, actions, and spatial relationships. There is no required schema, bullet format, or fixed wording; organize the description naturally.
blocks.zh: 包含对象,可读文本,颜色,属性,动作和空间关系等有用的细节. 没有必要的计划、项目格式或固定措辞;自然地组织描述。

blocks.en: Base every statement only on visual evidence in this crop:
blocks.zh: 每个陈述都只依据可见证据:

blocks.en: - HONEST EDGE REPORTING: the four outer crop edges are artificial viewport boundaries, not photographed scene content. When an object is cut off by an outer edge (the anchor included), simply say what you see: describe its clearly visible parts and their attributes, and never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, totals, or overall shape/size for it, and never guess what continues beyond the edge. Keep the main description positive — what IS visible — and put every cut-off / partially-visible / out-of-view remark in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section at the end instead. A truncated object you cannot even identify belongs only in that section.
blocks.zh: - HONEST EDGE报告:四个外围作物边缘是人工的观景边界,而不是拍摄场景内容. 当一个物体被外缘(包括锚)切断时,只需说出你所看到的:描述其清晰可见的部分及其属性,永远不要说明整个物体属性,全身动作,总和,或整体形状/大小,也永远不要猜测什么在边缘之外继续. 保持主要描述的正面——可见的东西——并将每个截断/部分可见/不见的评语放在VISIULILILILIE和Refence Notes的结尾部分。 您甚至无法识别的切换对象只属于该部分。

blocks.en: - For text, use a deliberately conservative, character-by-character standard. A character is clearly legible only when its complete glyph shape and boundaries are visible and there is no reasonable alternative reading; prefer a shorter certain transcription over a longer plausible one, and never use language, brand, or scene context to complete a word. If the entire inscription meets this standard, transcribe it exactly. Otherwise never guess the uncertain characters: when a contiguous substring of at least three characters is clearly legible, report only that substring, say the rest is unclear, and state where it sits (its character count and whether it is the beginning, end, or middle). Call it a beginning or ending only when that text boundary is itself visible in the crop, and say whether the character touching the uncertain side has a complete isolated glyph — under cropping, occlusion, blur, or small scale such boundary characters are unreliable. If the sign, panel, or surface carrying an inscription is itself cut off by the crop edge at or near the text region, treat the inscription as partial with the cut side uncertain even when every visible glyph is complete — the crop is not a god’s-eye view and the text may continue on the hidden part. Never attribute text to an object unless it is visibly printed on that object. TEXT COLOR CAUTION: outlined or two-tone glyphs are easily misread at this scale — dark characters with a light outline routinely look like white text on a dark panel. State a text color only when the stroke FILL color is unambiguous; when uncertain, write ’light-colored text on a dark panel’ or ’dark text on a light panel’, or omit the color entirely. A guessed text color must never appear.
blocks.zh: - 对于文字,使用一个刻意保守的,逐个角色的标准. 一个角色只有在其完整的格言形状和边界可见且没有合理的替代读法时,才能明显辨别出来;宁可使用更短的某一个抄本而不是一个更长的可信抄本,从不使用语言,品牌,或场景上下文来完成一个字. 如果整个铭文符合这个标准,就确切地转录下来. 否则就永远不要猜测不确定的字符:当至少三个字符的毗连子字符串明显可以辨别时,只报告该子字符串,说其余的不清楚,并说明其坐落位置(其字符计数以及是否是起始,结束,还是中间). 只有当文字边界本身在裁剪中可见时,才称它为开始或结束,并说触摸不确定一方的字符是否有完全孤立的格莱法——在裁剪,封存,模糊,或小尺度下,这种边界字符是不可靠的. 如果带有铭文的标志、面板或表面本身在文字区域或附近被作物边缘割断,即使每个可见的文字完整,仍将铭文与剪切侧部分不确定——作物不是神眼观,文字可能继续隐藏。 永远不要将文本属性给一个对象,除非它明显地打印在该对象上。 TEXT COLOR CAUTION: 简写或双调格子在这个尺度上很容易被误读——带有光线轮廓的暗字符通常在暗面板上看起来像白文本. 仅在中风 FILL 颜色明确时写出文字颜色; 当不确定时, 在暗面板上写出 ' 浅色文字 ' 或 " 暗色文字在淡面板上 ' , 或者完全省略颜色。 猜想的文字颜色永远不能出现 。

blocks.en: FIGURE AND GROUND: a panel’s color is never the glyphs’ color. Name the color of the strokes and the color of the surface they sit on as two separate facts (’red characters on a yellow panel’), and never let one stand in for the other. Watch multi-tone signs especially: a fascia whose left panel is green and whose right panel is white has TWO panel colors and neither of them is a text color, so writing ’white letters’ for black letters on its white panel is the same error as guessing. Illuminated night signage is where this goes wrong most.
blocks.zh: 图片和图片:一个面板的颜色从来不是甘油的颜色。 把中风的颜色和它们所坐的表面的颜色命名为两个不同的事实(`黄色面板上的红色字符 ' ),绝不让其中一人站在另一边。 特别是观察多色标志:一个左面板是绿色的、右面板是白色的Fascia有两个面板颜色,两个面板都不是一种文字颜色,因此在其白色面板上为黑色字母写`白色字母'与猜测是相同的错误。 灯光照亮的夜间标志 是最不对劲的地方

blocks.en: - COUNTING-SCOPE POLICY: do not state an exact number merely because N instances happen to be visible in this crop. An exact count is allowed only in one of these two cases:
blocks.zh: - 协调-合作政策:不要仅仅因为这种作物中偶然出现N种情况而说明确切数字。 只允许在这两种情况下中的一个进行精确的计算:

blocks.en: (A) ANCHOR-OWNED SET: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, and the complete anchor-side set relevant to the count is visible.
blocks.zh: (A) ANCHOR-OWONED SET:计数的物项是选定锚的部件、附着物、磨损物、被物、或包含在所选锚上,与计数有关的完整锚侧设定可见。

blocks.en: (B) FULLY CLOSED ANCHOR-RELATIVE REGION: the counted items lie in a finite interval or region defined by the selected anchor and another specific visible object, and every boundary needed to delimit that region is fully visible in the crop. The crop edges must never serve as those boundaries.
blocks.zh: (B) 完全封闭的ANCHOR-反应区域:所计项目位于特定锚和另一个特定可见物体界定的有限间隔或区域,划定该区域所需的所有边界在作物中都完全可见。 作物边缘绝不能成为这些界限。

blocks.en: Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, to the left/right of, in the background, in the water, on the beach, or on the road merely locate visible instances; they do not close a counting set. Sea, water, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, and other surfaces or scene regions that continue beyond the crop are open sets, even when every instance currently visible in the crop is sharp and separable. For an open set, use non-numeric wording such as ’several are visible’ when useful, and state that the exact scene total cannot be determined from the crop. Never estimate or give a range.
blocks.zh: 诸如附近、周围、后面、前面、左边/右边、背景、水里、海滩上或路上的词句只是查找可见的事例;它们不关闭一个计数集。 海,水,海滩,道路,田地,天空,人群,以及农作物以外的其它地表或场景区域都是开放式的,即使目前农作物中可见的每一个实例都是尖锐的,可以分开的. 对于一个开放的集合,使用非数字语言,如 " 几个 " 当有用时是可见的,并说确切的场景总数不能从作物中确定。 从不估计或给出范围。

blocks.en: - Do not infer hidden parts or use world knowledge to fill gaps. Describe uncertain details as unclear.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 不要推断隐藏的部分或使用世界知识来填补空白. 将不确定的细节描述为不明确。

blocks.en: End the caption with a final section exactly titled ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES:’. It is a short bullet inventory whose only purpose is to warn later stages which references would be ambiguous or open; it is not a description and can never be quoted as visual evidence:
blocks.zh: 标题的最后一节完全称为`责任和参考说明 ' 。 这是一份简短的清单,其唯一目的是提醒后期哪些提法含糊不清或公开;它不是一个描述,永远不能作为视觉证据引用:

blocks.en: - List each same-category counterpart whose content is unknown because it is cut off by a crop edge, out of view, or occluded: the other hand of a person when you described one hand, additional price tags/labels/signs beyond the ones you fully described, the unseen remainder of a vehicle or large object when you described one of its parts.
blocks.zh: - 列出内容不明的同一类对应方,因为这些对应方被作物边缘割断,视线外,或被占据:在描述一方时,他人的另一只手,超出你完全描述的标签/标签/标志;在描述其一部分时,车辆或大型物体的无形剩余部分。

blocks.en: - Each note records only: the entity class and its owner or host (’the man’s other hand’, ’additional price tags’, ’the rest of the blue trailer’), its status (cut off at which edge, out of view, or occluded), and ’content unknown’ when applicable.
blocks.zh: 每张纸条只记录:实体类别及其所有者或主机( " 男子的另一只手 " 、 " 附加价格标签 " 、 " 蓝色拖车 " 的其余部分)、其状况(在哪个边缘被切断、或被关闭)以及 " 内容不明 " 。

blocks.en: - Notes must NEVER contain attributes, colors, counts, actions, or transcribed text, and must never guess what the hidden content might be.
blocks.zh: - 说明不得包含属性、颜色、计数、动作或转录文字,也不得猜测隐藏内容可能是什么。

blocks.en: - If nothing qualifies, end with exactly ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES: none.’
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果无任何条件,则以 " 责任和参考说明 " 结束:无。 ' ' 说

Then write the caption as if the artificial rectangle were absent. blocks.en: J.4 Incremental evidence and bilingual QA generation
blocks.zh: J.4 递增证据和双语质量保证生成

blocks.en: Two descriptions of the SAME image region are given. caption1 was written while seeing the full image (the region was highlighted with a box). caption2 was written while seeing a high-resolution crop of exactly that region. Both captions were given the same selected anchor phrase and were asked to organize around that anchor, so ’the anchor’ in either caption denotes the same photographed object; use that shared reference to align object identities between them. Selected anchor object: "{anchor}" The phrases ’selected object’, ’selected anchor’, ’marked object’, or ’outlined object’ in caption2 refer to this exact photographed anchor, not to a newly appearing object. Use this metadata only to align object identity between the two captions. Do not merge a different same-category object with the selected anchor. If an object’s identity cannot be aligned reliably, omit that candidate fact. Any selection rectangle, outline, box, marker, label, or annotation mentioned by caption2 is pipeline metadata, not photographed content, and must never become an incremental fact. Extract the incremental facts: discrete, visually verifiable information that caption2 provides and caption1 either omits (absent), marks as unclear (unclear), or states differently (contradicted). Contradictions ARE increments: report them with relation "contradicted" and record caption1’s claim. MANDATORY CROP-VIEWPORT INVARIANCE CHECK (higher priority than treating contradictions as increments): every retained fact must describe the photographed scene or an object’s intrinsic property, and must remain semantically true if the crop were expanded. The crop is not a privileged or god’s-eye view of the scene; it merely hides content beyond its four artificial edges. A difference in how much of an object falls inside the crop is NEVER an absent, unclear, or contradicted scene fact. Reject any candidate based on an object being at a crop edge, cut off, cropped, only partially visible, or reduced to particular visible body parts by the crop. For example, if caption1 describes a person walking while caption2 says only the person’s head and shoulders are visible at the bottom edge, these claims do NOT contradict each other: caption2 is reporting viewport truncation, so omit the candidate entirely. Apply this rule even if caption2 states the boundary observation confidently and even if it can be assigned one of the allowed fact types. Silently audit every proposed fact for crop-edge dependence before adding it to the JSON. VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES handling: caption2 may end with a section titled ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES’. That section is disambiguation context ONLY. Never extract a fact from it, never quote it in whole or in part as source_from_caption2, and never let it add, upgrade, or contradict main-description content. Use it solely to stay aware that other same-category instances or hidden parts exist with unknown content. REFERENT QUALIFIER PRESERVATION: when a caption2 evidence sentence pins an instance with a qualifier — an anatomical side (’in his right hand’), a stated facing direction, an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), a part location on a host (’on the tail of the aircraft’), or a depth-zone tag (’much closer to the camera than the anchor’) — the fact’s statement MUST keep that qualifier. Dropping the qualifier and attributing the information to the bare category (’the man holds a can’, ’the price tag reads 140’) is forbidden, because other instances may exist beyond the crop. Never flip an anatomical side into a viewer side or vice versa when restating evidence; parenthetical viewer-side derivations from caption2 may be omitted from the statement, but the anatomical side itself must be preserved exactly. SPATIAL-FRAME CONFLICTS ARE NOT INCREMENTS: both captions follow the same frame contract (anatomical body sides derived from stated facing; viewer frame between objects; no depth ’behind’). If the two captions disagree ONLY about which body side of the same person carries an item or pose (left vs right hand/arm/leg/shoulder), and caption2 states the person’s facing with a derivation while caption1 does not, treat caption2’s side as a corrected relabeling of the same observation: do NOT emit the side flip itself as a contradicted fact, and never create a fact whose main content is which body side something is on. Silently use caption2’s side inside any other fact about that item. CAPTION1 OMISSION GUARD (applies to relation ’absent’ only): caption1 is written at full-image scale but may still simply forget an obvious attribute. When caption1 clearly describes an object as large or prominent within the region — for example a person occupying much of it — and the candidate fact states a coarse attribute any full-image viewer would plainly see (dominant clothing color or garment type, overall object color, coarse pose, obvious ongoing action), treat the missing attribute as a caption1 omission, NOT an increment, and omit the fact. Keep ’absent’ facts only for genuinely fine-grained information: small text, small parts or accessories, precise counts, subtle patterns, small held items, or details whose visibility plausibly requires zooming in. This guard never applies to facts whose relation is ’unclear’ (caption1 explicitly could not see it) or ’contradicted’ (caption1 made a different claim). Only keep facts of these types: count, OCR text, color, action, local attribute, spatial relation. Discard: - subjective wording and anything hedged with "possibly/maybe"; - texture-only remarks (foliage, grass, sky, water, lighting); - facts about the region boundary itself (what is inside/outside the box, objects cut by the crop edge); - range counts ("15-20") and estimates; - hue-level color differences (red vs orange, cyan vs blue) — keep a color contradiction only if the two claims are clearly different color classes. COUNT FACT ELIGIBILITY (mandatory and higher priority than contradiction): - Retain an exact count only when it belongs to exactly one of two scope types: (A) anchor_owned — items that are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region — items inside a finite region explicitly bounded by the selected anchor and another specific object, with all boundaries fully visible in caption2. - The artificial crop boundary never closes a set. Relative words such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field are locators, not complete boundaries. A visible subset of people or objects on a sea, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, or other region that may continue beyond the crop is not an exact scene count. Reject it even if caption2 gives a confident number and even if caption1 gives a different number. - For every retained count fact, add count_scope_type (anchor_owned or closed_anchor_relative_region), counted_entity, scope_boundary_description, and scope_fully_visible=true. If you cannot truthfully fill all four fields from caption2, omit the count fact. For non-count facts, use null for these fields. OCR evidence rules: - TYPE DISCIPLINE: any fact whose statement reports readable characters, letters, digits, words, logo text, or an inscription MUST use type ’OCR text’ with all audit fields filled. Never type a text-reading fact as attribute, local attribute, or color — doing so would smuggle it past every OCR boundary rule. - Preserve caption2’s exact certainty boundary. If caption2 says only a substring is legible, label the fact as partial OCR text and preserve the exact substring, its character count, and its stated position. - A partial OCR fact is eligible only when it contains at least three contiguous clearly legible characters and caption2 identifies a usable position for that substring. - Never fill in, repair, normalize, or guess unclear characters. Never turn a partial substring into a claim about the full inscription, word, brand, or name. - If caption2 transcribes a sequence but also says the inscription extends into a cropped or obscured side, treat it as partial OCR even when the visible sequence itself is described as clear. Preserve which side is uncertain and whether the boundary-adjacent glyph is fully isolated. - For every OCR fact, add these audit fields: ocr_scope (full or partial), visible_sequence (the exact transcribed characters), uncertain_side (left, right, top, bottom, both, internal, none, or unknown), and boundary_character_isolated (a JSON boolean true or false, never a quoted string). If any portion of the same inscription, sign, label, or printed text is described as cropped, obscured, incomplete, or unclear, ocr_scope MUST be partial. Set boundary_character_isolated to true only when caption2 explicitly confirms that the glyph touching the uncertain side is complete and visibly separated on both sides; otherwise use false. - For every OCR fact, also express the evidence relative to NORMAL READING ORDER rather than only to image geometry. Set substring_position to full when the complete inscription is visible, prefix when the visible sequence is the beginning of a longer inscription, suffix when it is the ending, or unknown when caption2 does not support that decision. Set unsafe_boundary to beginning or end when the corresponding boundary character of visible_sequence touches an uncertain region; use both, internal, none, or unknown when appropriate. Do not trim visible_sequence yourself. Physical top/bottom/left/right and sequence beginning/end are different concepts. Output strict JSON only: {"incremental_facts": [{"type": "...", "statement": "...", "source_from_caption2": "...", "ocr_scope": "full|partial|null", "visible_sequence": "...|null", "uncertain_side": "left|right|top|bottom|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "substring_position": "full|prefix|suffix|unknown|null", "unsafe_boundary": "beginning|end|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "boundary_character_isolated": false, "count_scope_type": "anchor_owned|closed_anchor_relative_region|null", "counted_entity": "...|null", "scope_boundary_description": "...|null", "scope_fully_visible": true, "relation_to_caption1": "absent|unclear|contradicted", "caption1_claim": null}], "skip_reason": null} If there is no reliable increment — in particular if every candidate fact concerns only vegetation, sky, water, lighting, or generic texture — return an empty list with a short skip_reason. caption1: {caption1} caption2: {caption2}

blocks.en: MANDATORY CROP-VIEWPORT INVARIANCE CHECK (higher priority than treating contradictions as increments): every retained fact must describe the photographed scene or an object’s intrinsic property, and must remain semantically true if the crop were expanded. The crop is not a privileged or god’s-eye view of the scene; it merely hides content beyond its four artificial edges. A difference in how much of an object falls inside the crop is NEVER an absent, unclear, or contradicted scene fact. Reject any candidate based on an object being at a crop edge, cut off, cropped, only partially visible, or reduced to particular visible body parts by the crop. For example, if caption1 describes a person walking while caption2 says only the person’s head and shoulders are visible at the bottom edge, these claims do NOT contradict each other: caption2 is reporting viewport truncation, so omit the candidate entirely. Apply this rule even if caption2 states the boundary observation confidently and even if it can be assigned one of the allowed fact types. Silently audit every proposed fact for crop-edge dependence before adding it to the JSON.

blocks.en: REFERENT QUALIFIER PRESERVATION: when a caption2 evidence sentence pins an instance with a qualifier — an anatomical side (’in his right hand’), a stated facing direction, an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), a part location on a host (’on the tail of the aircraft’), or a depth-zone tag (’much closer to the camera than the anchor’) — the fact’s statement MUST keep that qualifier. Dropping the qualifier and attributing the information to the bare category (’the man holds a can’, ’the price tag reads 140’) is forbidden, because other instances may exist beyond the crop. Never flip an anatomical side into a viewer side or vice versa when restating evidence; parenthetical viewer-side derivations from caption2 may be omitted from the statement, but the anatomical side itself must be preserved exactly.

blocks.en: SPATIAL-FRAME CONFLICTS ARE NOT INCREMENTS: both captions follow the same frame contract (anatomical body sides derived from stated facing; viewer frame between objects; no depth ’behind’). If the two captions disagree ONLY about which body side of the same person carries an item or pose (left vs right hand/arm/leg/shoulder), and caption2 states the person’s facing with a derivation while caption1 does not, treat caption2’s side as a corrected relabeling of the same observation: do NOT emit the side flip itself as a contradicted fact, and never create a fact whose main content is which body side something is on. Silently use caption2’s side inside any other fact about that item.

blocks.en: CAPTION1 OMISSION GUARD (applies to relation ’absent’ only): caption1 is written at full-image scale but may still simply forget an obvious attribute. When caption1 clearly describes an object as large or prominent within the region — for example a person occupying much of it — and the candidate fact states a coarse attribute any full-image viewer would plainly see (dominant clothing color or garment type, overall object color, coarse pose, obvious ongoing action), treat the missing attribute as a caption1 omission, NOT an increment, and omit the fact. Keep ’absent’ facts only for genuinely fine-grained information: small text, small parts or accessories, precise counts, subtle patterns, small held items, or details whose visibility plausibly requires zooming in. This guard never applies to facts whose relation is ’unclear’ (caption1 explicitly could not see it) or ’contradicted’ (caption1 made a different claim).

blocks.en: COUNT FACT ELIGIBILITY (mandatory and higher priority than contradiction):
blocks.zh: 协调事实平等(强制性和高于矛盾):

blocks.en: - Retain an exact count only when it belongs to exactly one of two scope types: (A) anchor_owned — items that are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region — items inside a finite region explicitly bounded by the selected anchor and another specific object, with all boundaries fully visible in caption2.
blocks.zh: - 只有在完全属于两种范围类型之一时才保留精确的计数:(A) 锚——属于选定锚的一部分、附着、佩戴、持有或含有的物品;或(B) 封闭的_锁定_相对_区域——明确以选定锚和其他特定物体为界的有限区域内的物品,所有边界在标题2中完全可见。

blocks.en: - The artificial crop boundary never closes a set. Relative words such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field are locators, not complete boundaries. A visible subset of people or objects on a sea, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, or other region that may continue beyond the crop is not an exact scene count. Reject it even if caption2 gives a confident number and even if caption1 gives a different number.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 人工作物边界从未关闭过一个集. 相近,左右,后方,前方,左/右,后方,水中,或沙滩/公路/田地上等相对的文字是定位的,并非完整的边界. 海洋、海滩、道路、田野、天空、人群或其他区域中可能延续到作物以外的人或物体的可见子集并不是确切的场景。 即使字幕2给出了自信的编号,即使字幕1给出了不同的编号,也还是拒绝.

blocks.en: - For every retained count fact, add count_scope_type (anchor_owned or closed_anchor_relative_region), counted_entity, scope_boundary_description, and scope_fully_visible=true. If you cannot truthfully fill all four fields from caption2, omit the count fact. For non-count facts, use null for these fields.
blocks.zh: - 对每个保留的计数事实, 添加计数_ 镜像_ 类型( 锁定_ 拥有或关闭_ 锁定_ 相对_ 区域)、 计数_ 实体、 范围_ 界限_ 描述、 范围_ 完全_ 可见= true。 如果您无法从标题2中真实填写全部四个字段, 请省略计数事实 。 对于不计数的事实,对这些字段无效使用.

blocks.en: OCR evidence rules:
blocks.zh: OCR证据规则:

blocks.en: - TYPE DISCIPLINE: any fact whose statement reports readable characters, letters, digits, words, logo text, or an inscription MUST use type ’OCR text’ with all audit fields filled. Never type a text-reading fact as attribute, local attribute, or color — doing so would smuggle it past every OCR boundary rule.
blocks.zh: - TYPE DISCIPLINE:任何其报表报告可读字符、字母、数字、单词、标志文本或铭文的事实都使用 " OCR文本 " 类型,并填充所有审计字段。 永远不要将文本读取的事实打入属性,局部属性,或颜色——这样做会把它偷运过每一个OCR边界规则.

blocks.en: - Preserve caption2’s exact certainty boundary. If caption2 says only a substring is legible, label the fact as partial OCR text and preserve the exact substring, its character count, and its stated position.
blocks.zh: - 保留标题2的确切确定性界限。 如果字幕2只说一个子字符串是可辨识的,则将事实标为部分OCR文本,并保存准确的子字符串,其字符计数,以及其声明的位置.

blocks.en: - A partial OCR fact is eligible only when it contains at least three contiguous clearly legible characters and caption2 identifies a usable position for that substring.
blocks.zh: - 部分OCR事实只有在包含至少三个毗连的明显可识别字符和标题2 确定该子串可用位置时才有资格。

blocks.en: - Never fill in, repair, normalize, or guess unclear characters. Never turn a partial substring into a claim about the full inscription, word, brand, or name.
blocks.zh: - 永远不要填充,修复,正常化,或者猜不清字符. 永远不要把部分小字串变成关于完整铭文、文字、品牌或名称的主张。

blocks.en: - If caption2 transcribes a sequence but also says the inscription extends into a cropped or obscured side, treat it as partial OCR even when the visible sequence itself is described as clear. Preserve which side is uncertain and whether the boundary-adjacent glyph is fully isolated.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果标题2将一个序列转录下来,但又说该铭文延伸成一个被裁剪或模糊的侧面,即使可见序列本身被描述为清晰,仍将其作为部分OCR处理. 保护哪一方不确定 边界相邻的格子是否完全隔离

blocks.en: - For every OCR fact, add these audit fields: ocr_scope (full or partial), visible_sequence (the exact transcribed characters), uncertain_side (left, right, top, bottom, both, internal, none, or unknown), and boundary_character_isolated (a JSON boolean true or false, never a quoted string). If any portion of the same inscription, sign, label, or printed text is described as cropped, obscured, incomplete, or unclear, ocr_scope MUST be partial. Set boundary_character_isolated to true only when caption2 explicitly confirms that the glyph touching the uncertain side is complete and visibly separated on both sides; otherwise use false.
blocks.zh: - 对于每个OCR事实,添加这些审计字段: ocr_scope(完整或部分),可见_序列(确切的转录字符),不确定_侧(左,右,上,下,内,无,或未知),和边界_特征_同位化(一个JSON布尔真假,从不引用字符串). 如果同一铭文、标志、标签或印刷文本的任何部分被描述为裁剪、遮蔽、不完整或不明确,则MUST ocr_scope是部分的。 只有当标题2明确确认触碰不确定侧面的格莱弗在两侧完整且明显分离时,才将边界_特征_异化为真;否则使用假.

blocks.en: - For every OCR fact, also express the evidence relative to NORMAL READING ORDER rather than only to image geometry. Set substring_position to full when the complete inscription is visible, prefix when the visible sequence is the beginning of a longer inscription, suffix when it is the ending, or unknown when caption2 does not support that decision. Set unsafe_boundary to beginning or end when the corresponding boundary character of visible_sequence touches an uncertain region; use both, internal, none, or unknown when appropriate. Do not trim visible_sequence yourself. Physical top/bottom/left/right and sequence beginning/end are different concepts.
blocks.zh: - 对于每一个OCR事实,也表达与NORMAL READING ORDER有关的证据,而不仅仅是图像几何. 当完整的铭文可见时将子字符串_位置设置为完整,当可见的序列是较长铭文的开始时将前缀设置为完整,当它是结束时将后缀设置为完整,或者当标题2不支持这个决定时将未知. 当可见_序列的相应边界特性触及到一个不确定的区域时,将不安全的_边界设置为开始或结束;同时使用内部的,无,或在适当情况下未知。 不要修剪可见_ 顺序你自己 。 物理上/下/左/右和顺序开始/结束是不同的概念.

blocks.en: Output strict JSON only:
blocks.zh: 输出严格 JSON只说:

blocks.en: {"incremental_facts": [{"type": "...", "statement": "...", "source_from_caption2": "...", "ocr_scope": "full|partial|null", "visible_sequence": "...|null", "uncertain_side": "left|right|top|bottom|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "substring_position": "full|prefix|suffix|unknown|null", "unsafe_boundary": "beginning|end|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "boundary_character_isolated": false, "count_scope_type": "anchor_owned|closed_anchor_relative_region|null", "counted_entity": "...|null", "scope_boundary_description": "...|null", "scope_fully_visible": true, "relation_to_caption1": "absent|unclear|contradicted", "caption1_claim": null}], "skip_reason": null}
If there is no reliable increment — in particular if every candidate fact concerns only vegetation, sky, water, lighting, or generic texture — return an empty list with a short skip_reason.
blocks.zh: 如果没有可靠的增量——特别是如果每个候选事实只涉及植被、天空、水、照明或一般纹理——则返回一个空列表,附带简短的跳动理由。

blocks.zh: 标题1:

blocks.en: {caption1}
blocks.zh: {标题1}

blocks.zh: 标题2:

blocks.en: {caption2}
blocks.zh: {标题2}

blocks.en: You are generating fine-grained visual QA from incremental facts. The anchor object (salient and uniquely locatable in the full image) is: "{anchor}" Crop-local anchor rule: {local_anchor_rule} Incremental facts (information visible only when zooming into the region around the anchor; each has an evidence sentence from the zoomed-in caption): {facts} Full zoomed-view description of the region (use it to check for duplicate objects of the same category — NOT as a source of new facts): {caption2} Current generation target plus feedback from prior QA candidates for this SAME anchor: {retry_context} Generate up to {qa_per_anchor} questions. Every incremental fact has a source_fact_index. Return that exact integer for the one fact used by each QA. Copy evidence_sentence directly from that fact’s source_from_caption2 when available; otherwise use its statement. Question rules: - Each answer must come from exactly one incremental fact. - When generating more than one QA in the same response, every QA must use a different source_fact_index and evidence sentence; never make two questions from the same fact or paraphrase the same question. - Any question that asks the solver to read or transcribe text, letters, characters, digits, words, logo lettering, or a specified character span MUST use question_type=ocr. Never label such a question as attribute, comparison, or another type. - PRIORITY: if one or more eligible OCR facts are present, generate QA from those OCR facts before using count, attribute, action, or spatial facts. The incremental-facts list is ordered with OCR facts first. - Read the ENTIRE OCR fact, especially statement and source_from_caption2; do not treat visible_sequence as the only useful information. Visual details explicitly tied to the text—such as its background color, text color, position, orientation, containing panel, or relation to another label—are valuable referring cues. Prefer a question that uses those cues to identify one text region over a generic question that asks for every word on a whole sign or logo. Use a visual attribute as a locator, not as another requested answer. - A HEDGED IDENTITY IS NOT A REFERENT. When caption2 hedges what something is — ’what looks like a bird’, ’possibly a helmet’, ’某种容器’ — it is telling you it could not identify the object, and a referring expression built on that guess matches nothing when the guess is wrong: a solver hunting for a bird will never find the plastic bag it actually is. Drop the hedged noun and locate the thing by what IS certain — where it sits, what it is inside or attached to, its color and size (’the small white object on the ledge above the second window’). If nothing certain identifies it, skip the fact. Never carry the hedge into the question either: ’the shoe or boot’ tells a solver you are guessing. - LOCATOR ATTRIBUTE RELIABILITY: prefer host-level cues — panel/sign color, position, containing object, nearest landmark — over the text’s OWN color. Small text color is frequently misperceived (dark outlined glyphs read as white), and a wrong locator attribute misleads solvers or matches a different text region. Include the text’s color only when the fact states it without hedging AND it adds discrimination that the host cue does not already provide; when the panel alone is unique, leave the text color out. Never take a color from one region of a multi-tone sign and attach it to text sitting on another region; if you cannot say the stroke fill without hedging, use the host cue alone. - ONE HOST PER OCR ANSWER. The answer is text carried by a SINGLE bounded host — one sign, label, plate, panel, or printed line. Never assemble an answer out of characters sitting on separate objects, and never scope an OCR question by nearness to a GROUP (’the digits printed near the green bottles’, ’the letters around the potted plants’): proximity to a set has no boundary a solver can reproduce, so which characters belong in the answer becomes arbitrary and a second reader will include a different set. If the text you want spans separate hosts, ask about one of them instead. - OCR facts may contain deterministic fields computed by code: safe_sequence, safe_character_count, required_span, and qa_eligible. Never correct, repair, or invent characters beyond safe_sequence. The answer must be one clearly supported CONTIGUOUS segment of safe_sequence. - For a partial OCR fact (required_span=first or last), write a PLAIN text-reading question about that inscription, located by host-level cues, with the answer equal to safe_sequence verbatim. Do not add any span wording (no ’first/last k characters’), do not add totality words such as ’entire’, ’complete’, or ’all the text’, and never mention cropping or hidden characters. A dedicated edge-rewriting stage that sees the full photograph will rewrite such drafts into the final safe span wording; your draft only needs to pick the right inscription and copy safe_sequence. - LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT: when required_span=full and the fact itself explicitly associates different complete words or consecutive word groups with independently identifiable visual regions, you may ask for one such region and use only its complete text as the answer. The chosen answer must be one or more WHOLE consecutive words appearing verbatim in safe_sequence; never take characters from inside a word. Both questions must include the fact-supported visual locator that isolates that segment. Do not invent a color, position, container, or relation. If the fact does not support a unique localized segment, use the complete safe_sequence instead. - Example: if a fact says that OPEN appears in white on an upper green panel and 24 HOURS appears on a separate lower black strip, prefer asking what text appears on the upper green panel (answer: OPEN), rather than what all text on the sign says. This example describes the policy only; never copy its objects, colors, positions, or text into another image’s QA. - For required_span=full, either ask for the complete clearly legible text and use safe_sequence verbatim, or apply LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT exactly as defined above. - Never write view-dependent instructions such as ’excluding the top character’, ’ignore the cropped character’, ’remove the first visible letter’, or any reference to an image/crop boundary, cropping, truncation, or hidden characters. A fixed first/last k span must have the same answer in the full image and zoomed image. - Skip every OCR fact with qa_eligible=false or without all required deterministic fields. - If the context contains prior-candidate entries in addition to the generation_target_state, choose a DIFFERENT incremental fact and answer property. Do not repeat or merely paraphrase any rejected or retained global/crop question, evidence sentence, or source fact. - Use rejection feedback only to choose a better-supported candidate. NEVER alter the reference answer to imitate verifier outputs, and never invent a fact absent from the incremental-facts list. - If a previous candidate failed crop verification, prefer a different fact whose answer is larger/clearer and directly visible in the crop. - The generation_target_state entry in the context is authoritative. If zoom_required_still_needed=true and a previous accepted candidate was answerable from the full image, prefer a substantially smaller or finer detail marked absent/unclear/contradicted. If it is false, a retained full-image-answerable QA counts toward the accepted-question minimum; the next distinct accepted QA may be either full-image-answerable or zoom-required. - If retry feedback says a previous candidate remained ambiguous AFTER the dedicated image-aware referent repair failed, use a different uniquely referable target. Never add answer-leaking qualifiers. - DISAMBIGUATION: before writing each question, scan the full description above. If the answer object’s category could match more than one object in the crop (e.g. a ring worn by a person vs a standalone ring product image), the crop-local referring phrase MUST include a qualifier that separates them (position, size, displayed-vs-worn, color). If no crop-visible qualifier can make it unique, skip that fact. - Write TWO semantically paired versions of every question: 1. question_zh / question_en are GLOBAL questions for the original full image. They MUST make the answer object locatable in the full image by a solver who has never seen the crop. Choose the locator by the target’s REAL relation to the anchor (see GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY below). 2. crop_question_zh / crop_question_en are LOCAL questions for the exact zoomed crop. Remove context that the crop itself cannot establish, such as "in the center of the plaza", "on the building in the background", or "to the right of the white building". Keep only qualifiers whose evidence is visible inside the crop and that are needed to identify the answer object there. - Follow the Crop-local anchor rule exactly. A selection rectangle may be used only as a referring-expression locator for the photographed anchor, its parts, contents, markings, or related nearby objects. Never ask about the rectangle itself, its color, shape, boundary, corners, or any artificial label. The GLOBAL questions must never mention a selection rectangle. - The GLOBAL and LOCAL versions MUST ask the same property of the same object and MUST have the same answer. The local version is not a new question. - The LOCAL question must be self-contained and its answer object must be uniquely identifiable inside the crop. If removing unavailable global context makes that impossible, skip the fact. GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY (the crop is a 2D window; objects inside it can lie at completely different scene depths, so 2D adjacency inside the crop is NOT scene proximity): (a) If the answer object has a REAL, visually supported scene relation to the anchor — it is a part of it, attached to it, on the same supporting surface, held by it, or genuinely adjacent at the same depth — locate it through the anchor phrase as usual. (b) If the answer object is clearly at a different depth than the anchor (the zoomed description says it is much closer to or farther from the camera, e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a background lighthouse), NEVER claim proximity with words such as near, beside, next to, 附近, 旁边, and never use front/behind as a disguised depth word. That fabricates a relation that does not exist, misleads the solver into searching around the anchor, and reads unnaturally. PREFER KEEPING THE ANCHOR in the question through an HONEST relation — it is the verified, easiest-to-find landmark — choosing whichever of these reads naturally: - CAMERA-AXIS relation (works for ANY anchor, including faceless structures; preferred when the target lies on or near the anchor’s line of sight, which crop co-membership usually guarantees): state the depth order along the viewing axis with the canonical wording — target closer to the camera: ’the yellow taxi between the clock tower and the camera’ / 在钟楼与镜头之间的黄色出租车; target farther: ’the brick warehouse beyond the red barge, farther from the camera’ / 越过红色驳船更远处的砖砌仓库. When the two do not overlap in the image, add a small image-frame offset word (’below the clock tower and between it and the camera’). This wording is honest 3D geometry, never a proximity claim. - INTRINSIC ANCHOR-FRAME relation: when the anchor is a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing caption2 states, the target may be located in the anchor’s own frame with each side derived mechanically per the contract. Example: a cyclist riding toward the viewer has the deeper scene BEHIND him and his left-hand side on the viewer’s right, so ’the bright blue vertical sign behind the cyclist on his left-hand side’ is honest and natural. SIDE-BLINDNESS GUARDRAIL: verification models cannot reliably resolve a person’s left/right sides, so any anchor-frame directional clause is narrative scaffolding only — the question MUST still identify the target uniquely when that clause is ignored, through at least one anchor-independent discriminator (object type plus color, nearest fixed landmark, or viewer-frame position). If uniqueness would depend on the anchor-frame clause itself, do not use this option. - EXPLICIT IMAGE-FRAME relation to the anchor: honest 2D wording such as ’in the image, above the cyclist in the background’ or ’below the lighthouse and much closer to the camera’, never wording that implies physical proximity. - SELF-LOCATING referent (fallback when no anchor-linked wording reads naturally, e.g. the linkage would feel contrived across a large cluttered depth gap): drop the anchor and locate the target with full-image-frame position plus its own visible attributes, e.g. ’the jogger in the lower-center foreground of the image wearing a cap’. Depth words like foreground/closer to the camera stay true across views; horizontal words must be re-derived from the FULL image, never copied from the crop question. (c) If none of these produces a referent you are confident is unique in the FULL image, skip the fact. Prefer facts about the anchor itself or objects in its own depth zone: a crop-foreground object much closer to the camera is usually large and legible in the full image, so its facts rarely survive the full-image difficulty gate; spend them only when nothing anchored remains. - Example pair: GLOBAL: "What text is written on the sign in the center of the plaza?" LOCAL: "What text is written on the sign?" - NEVER put the answer attribute itself into either referring expression (if the answer is a color, the referring phrase must not mention that color). - The answer must be a single definite value: an exact count, one color word, a short text string, or a short action. Skip facts with ranges, hedges, or subjective wording. - The answer itself must never be an anatomical body side (’left hand’, ’right leg’) NOR a part location on an oriented object (’near the front left corner’, ’at the rear end’, 车头/车尾): all vision models share systematic mirror and orientation confusion, so such answers cannot be verified reliably. Sides and part locations serve only as referring qualifiers inside questions. - COUNTING SOURCE GATE: before using a count fact, classify its real-scene scope. It is eligible only as (A) anchor_owned: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, with the complete relevant anchor-side set visible; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region: the items occupy a finite interval or region explicitly bounded by the anchor and another specific visible object, and all boundaries are fully visible. If neither classification is supported, skip the fact, even when it contains an exact number and is contradicted by caption1. - Crop edges never close a counting scope. Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field identify a visible subset but do not define a complete set. Never generate a question asking for the total of such an open scene region. In particular, counting the instances currently visible in a cropped slice of sea, beach, road, crowd, field, or sky is forbidden. - For an eligible anchor_owned count, the question must explicitly bind the counted items to the anchor. For an eligible closed_anchor_relative_region count, the question must name both bounding objects and the finite interval/region between them. A generic phrase such as ’behind the anchor’ is insufficient. - Prefer count facts carrying count_scope_type and scope_fully_visible=true. Independently audit the evidence and full crop description; metadata cannot rescue an actually open scope. - Skip facts about the region boundary and vegetation/sky texture. - Skip color facts that differ only at hue level between the two views. <<<INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>><<<INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT>>> - Apply the frame contract above to every direction word in questions and answers. Body-part sides stay anatomical exactly as the fact states them (’right hand’ means his own right hand); never convert an anatomical side into an image side or vice versa. Keep parenthetical facing/viewer-side derivations OUT of the question text — questions carry only natural human phrasing. - BILINGUAL FRAME PARITY: the Chinese and English versions must encode the same frame with the same discipline. In Chinese, scene depth must be written as 背景中 / 前景中 / 离镜头更远 / 更靠近镜头 — NEVER as 后方、身后、前方 or 前面 attached to a person or animal (write 跑者背景中更远处的车辆, not 跑者后方的车辆). Use 身后/面前 only for a person’s intrinsic sides and only when the question itself states that person’s facing (e.g. 背对镜头的人身后). 左手/右手 are anatomical only, exactly like left/right hand in English. - LIMB QUALIFIER PREFERENCE: to single out one of a person’s paired limbs, prefer the pose or state the fact records — the raised arm, the arm hanging at the side, the hand holding the strap — over an anatomical side. Pose wording is natural, needs no facing derivation, and is the only kind a solver can check; verification models do not reliably resolve a person’s left from their right. Use ’left/right hand’ only when the fact states the side with an explicit facing derivation AND no pose descriptor separates the limbs. - REFERENT CLOSURE (mandatory): if the fact’s answer object belongs to a multi-instance category — hands, feet, shoes, price tags, labels, signs, screens, wheels, windows, bags, or similar repeated parts and products — and the zoomed description or its VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES indicate that other instances exist anywhere in the scene, are cut off, or are out of view with unknown content, then BOTH the global and crop questions MUST pin the exact instance using the qualifier carried by the fact and its evidence: the anatomical side (’in his right hand’), the attachment or nearest relation (’on the price tag closest to the kettle’), or the part location (’on the rear end of the large blue trailer’). A bare ’in his hand’, ’on the price tag’, ’on the sign’, or ’on the vehicle’ is forbidden in that situation. If the fact and evidence carry no such qualifier while the notes show counterparts exist, SKIP that fact. - Never mention the crop viewport, cropping, truncation, cut-off or out-of-view states, visibility limitations, or the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section in any question; the notes only tell you when an extra pinning qualifier is required. Positional image-frame references such as ’near the left edge of the image’ are locators, not viewport talk, and remain allowed under the frame contract. - FRAME CLAIMS COME FROM CAPTION1 ONLY. caption2 saw a crop, not the photograph, so any left/right/side wording in it describes the crop’s own frame and is worthless — often actively wrong — as a statement about the image: a crop taken from the right of the photo has its own left side. Never copy or paraphrase a horizontal position out of caption2 into a question. Use one only when caption1, which saw the whole photograph, places the target there, and word it as caption1 does. - NO FRAME SUPERLATIVES. Never write leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right, 最左, 最右, 最上, 最下, 最顶, 最底 about the image in either language. Being the outermost of a category is a claim about everything in the photograph, which neither caption can establish; use an attachment, nearest-object, or part qualifier instead. A superlative INSIDE one named host stays fine (’the bottom word on the blue sign’), because the host bounds it. - After eligible OCR facts, prefer counting / attribute facts, and prefer facts whose relation_to_caption1 is "contradicted" or "unclear". Output strict JSON only: {"qas": [{"question_zh": "...", "question_en": "...", "crop_question_zh": "...", "crop_question_en": "...", "answer": "...", "question_type": "counting|ocr|attribute|action|spatial|comparison", "evidence_sentence": "verbatim evidence", "source_fact_index": 0}]} If no fact qualifies, output {"qas": []}.
blocks.zh: 你正在生成精细的视觉QA 从渐进的事实。 主锚对象(在完整图像中是斜的和唯一可移动的)是:"{anchor}" 裁剪本地锁定规则 : {local_ anchor_rule} 增量事实(仅在将信息放大到锚周围的区域时才能看到;每个都从缩放标题中得出证据句子): {事实} 区域全缩放视图描述( 用它来检查同一类的重复对象—— 不作为新事实的来源 ) : {caption2} 当前生成目标加上来自此 SAME 主机的 QA 候选人的反馈 : { retry_ context} 生成最多 {qa_ per_ anchor} 的问题 。 每个增量的事实都有源_事实_index. 返回每个质量评估所用的一个事实的精确整数。 直接从该事实的来源复制证据_判决_当有_caption2;否则使用其陈述。 问题规则 – 每个答案必须来自一个完全的递增的事实 – 当在同一答复中生成一个以上的QA时,每个QA必须使用不同的源_事实_索引和证据句;从不从同一个事实中提出两个问题,或从同一个问题中解释一个问题. - 任何要求解答者读取或转写文本、字母、字符、数字、单词、标志字母,或指定字符跨度为MUST的问题_类型=ocr的问题。 永远不要将这样的问题标为属性,比较,或者其他类型. - 优先事项:如果存在一个或多个合格的OCR事实,则在使用计数、属性、行动或空间事实之前,从OCR这些事实中生成质量保证。 增量事实清单首先与OCR事实一起订购. - 阅读 ENTIRE OCR 事实,特别是语句和来源_ from_caption2;不要将可见_序列作为唯一有用的信息. 与文本明确挂钩的视觉细节——例如其背景颜色、文本颜色、位置、方向、包含面板或与另一标签的关系——是有价值的参考提示。 偏好用这些提示来识别一个文本区域的问题,而不是一个泛泛的问题,即对整个标志或标志上每个字都提出问题。 使用视觉属性作为定位器,而不是作为另一个请求的答案. - 赫德的认同不是一种联系。 当标题2套住什么是“鸟”、“可能是头盔”时, 丢弃树篱上的名词, 并按它所确定的位置定位, 它坐在哪里, 它的内在或附着着着什么, 它的颜色和大小( ' ' 第二窗口上方的窗台上的小白色物体 ' ) 。 如果没有确切的识别,就跳过这个事实. 鞋或靴子告诉一个解答者, - LOCATOR ATTRIBUTE Reliability: 偏好主机级别的提示——面板/符号颜色,位置,包含对象,最近的地标——而不是文本的自有颜色. 小的文本颜色经常被误解(暗中描述的glyphs读作白色),错误的定位属性会误导解析者或匹配不同的文本区域. 包含文本的颜色, 只有当事实说明它没有套期, 并且添加了主机提示尚未提供的区别; 当面板是独一无二的时, 将文本颜色放出 。 千万不要从一个多色符号的区域中取一个颜色,并附在另一个区域中文本上;如果你不能在不套期的情况下表示中风填充,请单独使用主机提示. - 一个HOSTEROCR回答。 答案是由一个SINGLE定界主机携带的文本——一个标志,标签,盘子,面板,或打印行. 从不从坐在不同物体上的字符中组出一个答案,也从不通过靠近一个小组( ' 绿色瓶子附近的数字打印 ' , ' 盆栽周围的字母 ' )来标注OCR问题:靠近一个集没有解答者可以复制的边界,因此答案中属于哪个字符变得武断,第二个读者将包含不同的集。 如果您想要的文本横跨不同的主机, 请询问其中之一 。 - OCR的事实可能包含根据代码计算的确定性字段:安全序列、安全性、安全性、安全性。 永远不要改正、修复或发明超出安全序列的字符。 答案必须是明确支持的安全序列部分。 - 对于部分OCR事实(需要_span= first或last),写一个PLAIN文本读取问题,关于该铭文,按主机级提示定位,答案等于安全_序列逐字记录. 不要添加任何跨度(没有 " first/last k 字符 " ), 不要添加 " entire " 、 " complete " 或 " all the text " 等全词, 也不要提及裁剪或隐藏字符。 一个看到完整照片的专用边框重写阶段将把这些草稿重写成最后的安全跨度文字;您的草稿只需要选择正确的铭文并复制安全序列。 - LOCALIZED FULL-OCR单元:当需要_span=full,而且事实本身明确地将不同的完整词组或连续的单词组与独立可识别的视觉区域联系起来时,您可以要求一个这样的区域,并且只使用其完整文本作为答案。 所选的答案必须是一个或一个以上的WALE连续的单词在safet_sequence中逐字出现;从一个单词中不取字符. 这两个问题都必须包括事实支持的视觉定位器,它孤立了这个部分. 不创建颜色、位置、容器或关系。 如果事实不支持一个独特的局部区段,则使用完整的安全_序列代替. - 例如:如果一个事实说OPEN在上绿色面板上以白色出现,24 HOURS在单独的下黑色面条上出现,则更喜欢问上绿色面板上出现什么文字(回答:OPEN),而不是标语上所有文字都写什么. 此示例只描述策略; 绝不将对象、 颜色、 位置或文本复制到另一个图像的QA中 。 - 对要求的_span=full, 要么要求完整清晰可辨认的文本并使用安全的_序列逐字记录,要么适用上文所定义的LOCALIZED FLL-OCR部分。 - 绝不编写依赖视图的指令,如 " 排除顶端字符 " 、 " 忽略所刻录的字符 " 、 " 移动第一个可见字母 " 、或提及图像/作物边界、裁剪、截断或隐藏字符。 固定的第一个/最后一个 k 跨度必须在完整图像和放大图像中具有相同的答案 。 - 跳过每个OCR 事实,使用 qa_access=false 或没有所有必要的决定性领域。 - 如果上下文中除生成_目标_状态外还包含先前的指定条目,请选择一个不同的增量事实并回答属性。 不要重复或仅仅解释任何被拒绝或保留的全球/作物问题、证据判决或来源事实。 - 使用拒绝反馈只选择一个得到更好支持的候选人。 永远不要修改参考答案来模仿核查结果,决不在递增事实清单中捏造一个事实。 - 如果前一个候选人的作物验证失败, 则选择一个不同的事实, 其答案更大/ 更清晰, 在作物中直接可见 。 如果缩放_ required_stall_request= true 和先前被接受的候选人从完整图像中可以回答,则更喜欢用少得多或更细的细节标记缺失/不明确/有争议。 如果错误,保留的全部图像解答QA会算入可接受的最低问题;下一个显著的可接受QA可以是完全图像解答或缩放要求. - 如果重试反馈说前一名候选人在专用图像感知参考修复失败后仍然含糊不清,则使用不同的可参考目标。 永远不要添加解答的修饰符. 在写出每个问题之前 扫描上面的完整描述 如果答题对象的分类可以匹配裁剪中的多个对象(例如,一个人佩戴的环与独立的环产品映像),裁剪本地参考词MUST包含一个将它们分开的修饰词(位置,大小,显示-vs-worn,颜色). 如果没有任何作物可见的修饰剂能够使它变得独一无二,就跳过这个事实. - 给每个问题写两个拼写版本: 1. question_zh / question_en是全球问题,用于原始全图像. 由从未见过裁剪的解析器使答案对象在完整图像中可以移动. 选择目标与主机之间的真实关系定位符(见下文全球LOCATOR政策)。 2. 作物_问题_zh / 作物_问题_en 是精确放大作物的 LOCAL 问题。 删除作物本身无法建立的上下文,如"在广场中心","在背景的建筑物上",或"在白色建筑的右边". 仅保留其证据在作物内可见,并且是在那里识别答案对象所需的限定词。 - 遵守作物本地主播规则 选择矩只可用作被拍摄锚、其部件、内容、标记或附近相关物体的参考表示器。 永远不要问矩形本身,它的颜色,形状,边界,角,或者任何人工标签. 全球问题决不能提到选择矩形。 - Global 和 LOCAL 版本 MUST 询问同一对象的相同属性, MUST 也有相同的答案. 本地版本不是一个新问题。 - LOCAL问题必须是自成一体的,其答案对象必须是作物内唯一可识别的。 如果删除无法获取的全局背景使得无法做到这一点,则跳过事实。 全球LOCATOR政策( 裁剪是一个 2D 窗口; 里面的物体可以躺在完全不同的场景深处, 因此裁剪里面的 2D 相邻性不是场景相近 ) : (a) 如果答题对象与锚具有真实的、视像支持的场景关系——它是锚的一部分、附着在锚上、在同一支持面上、由它持有、或在同一深度真正相邻的场景——则按惯例通过锚定语将其定位。 (b) 如果答案对象明显处于与锚的深度不同的深度(放大描述说它离相机更近或更远,例如,在背景灯塔周围建造的作物内有一个前台慢跑者),从不声称靠近诸如靠近,靠近,靠近,靠近,靠近,靠近,**,并且从不使用前台/后台作为伪装的深度词. 这造就了一个不存在的关系,误导了解答者绕着锚进行搜索,并且不自然地阅读. 倾向于通过一个交际关系——这是经过核实的、最容易找到的地标——来决定其中哪一个自然是: - CAMERA-AXIS关系(为任何锚的工作,包括无脸结构;在目标位于锚的视线上或附近时首选,通常由共同成员保证):用犬形文字说明取景轴的深度顺序——目标靠近照相机: '钟楼和照相机之间的黄色出租车 ' ;目标更远:`红驳船以外的砖仓,离照相机更远 ' 。 当两者没有在图像中重叠时,增加一个小的图像框抵消词( ' 在钟楼下方以及它与相机之间 ' ). 这个措辞是诚实的3D几何,从来不是近距离主张. - INTRINSIC ANCHOR-FRAME关系:当锚是人、动物或车辆,其正面标题2说明时,目标可能位于锚本身的框中,每方根据合同通过机械方式得出。 因此左手边的自行车手背后的明亮蓝色垂直标志是诚实和自然的。 SIDE-BLINDENES GUARDRAL: 校验模型无法可靠地解决一个人的左/右侧,因此任何锚定框方向条款都只是叙事脚手架——当该条款被忽略时,MUST仍然通过至少一个锚定独立的区分器(对象类型加颜色,最近的固定地标,或查看器-帧位置)来单独确定目标. 如果独特性取决于锚定框架条款本身,则不使用这一选择。 - EXPLICIT IMAGE-FRAME与主播的关系:诚实的二维措辞,如 " 在图像中 " 、 " 在灯塔下 " 或 " 在灯塔下 " 、 " 离照相机更近 " 等,从未出现过暗示身体接近的措辞。 - SELF-LOCATING参考词(当没有与锚相连的措辞自然读取时倒计时,例如,连接会感到跨越一个巨大的杂乱的深度差距):放下锚并用全图像框位置加上其自身的可见属性定位目标,例如 " 戴着盖子的图像在下中心前缘的慢跑者 " 。 前方/镜头关闭等深度单词在视图之间保持真实性;水平单词必须从FUL图像中重新产生,绝不从裁剪问题中复制. (c) 如果这些没有产生一个推荐人,你相信在全能图像中是独一无二的,就跳过这个事实。 更喜欢关于锚本身或自身深度区域物体的事实:一个远近于相机的作物前物体通常很大,在完整图像中可以辨别,因此其事实很少在完整图像难度门后幸存;只有在没有锚定残留时才使用. - 例子对:全球:"广场中心标志上写了什么文字?" "LOCAL:"什么文字写在标志上?" - 从不将答案属性本身放在任何一种引用表达式中(如果答案是颜色,则引用短语不得提及该颜色). - 答案必须是单一的确定值:精确的计数,一个颜色的单词,一个短的文本字符串,或者一个短的动作. 以范围、套期或主观措辞跳过事实。 答案本身绝不是解剖身体( ' 左手 ' , ' 右腿 ' ) NOR在一个面向对象( ' 在左前角附近 ' , ' 在后端 ' )上的一部分位置:所有视觉模型都共享系统镜像和定向混淆,因此无法可靠地验证这些答案。 侧面和部分位置仅作为问题中的限定词。 在使用计数事实之前, 分类它的真实范围。 它只能作为(A)锚属:被计数的物品是部分,附着,磨损,由或包含在选定的锚属中,完整的相关锚侧设置可见;或者(B)闭合_anchor_relative_region:这些物品占据了明确以锚属和另一个特定可见物体为界的有限间隔或区域,所有边界都完全可见. 如果两者都不支持分类,则跳过这个事实,即使它包含一个确切的数字,并与标题1相矛盾. - 作物边缘从不关闭计数范围。 诸如靠近,周围,后面,前面,左/右,背景,水中,或在海滩/公路/战地上识别一个可见的子集,但没有定义完整的集. 永远不要提出这样一个空地区域的全部问题。 特别是,禁止在海、海滩、道路、人群、田野或天空中计数目前可以看到的情况。 - 对于合格的主播-拥有的计数,问题必须明确将计数的项目与主播挂钩。 对于符合条件的封闭_anchor_relative_region 计数,问题必须同时指定约束对象和它们之间的有限间隔/区域. 诸如 " 锚在后面 " 这样的通用短语是不够的。 - 优先计数事实,包含计数_范围_类型和范围_完全_可见=真. 独立审计证据和完整的作物描述;元数据无法挽救实际开放的范围。 - 省略有关区域边界和植被/天空纹理的事实。 - 跳过两种观点之间不同颜色的事实。 QQINSERT:SPATIAL_FRAME_RULESQINSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVATT>>> - 将上方框架合同应用于问答中的每个方向词. 身体部分的侧面保持解剖状态,与事实完全一致(右手意味着自己的右手);绝不将解剖面转换成图像面,反之亦然。 保持括号面/视图边衍生 在提问文本中——问题只包含自然的人类措辞. - BILINGUAL FRAME PARITY:中文版和英文版必须用相同的学科编码同一个框. 在中文中,场景深度必须写成QQ / / / / / / / / —— 绝不是QQ 或 + + 附属于一个人或动物(write + ,而不是 + ). 只为一个人的内在侧面而使用QQ/□,并且只有在问题本身表明此人面临时才使用(例如QQ). QQ/QQ只是解剖学,与英语中的左/右手完全一样. - LIMB QUALIFIER 偏好:单挑一个人的双肢之一,更喜欢姿势或说明事实记录——举起的手臂,手臂悬在侧面,手握带子——而不是解剖面。 Pose的措辞是自然的,不需要面对推论,是解决者唯一可以检查的;核查模型不能可靠地解决一个人从右侧留下的问题。 只有在事实表明一方有明确的面部特征,没有姿势描述符将四肢分开时,才使用左/右手。 - 参考关闭(强制性):如果事实的解答对象属于多事件类别——手、脚、鞋、价格标记、标签、标志、屏幕、轮子、窗户、袋或类似的重复部件和产品,以及放大描述或其VISUILILILY和ReFERENCES说明表明现场任何地方都存在其他情况,或断绝或断绝了不明内容的视线,那么全球问题和作物问题就用事实及其证据所携带的限定词定出确切的例子:解剖方面(他的右手)、附件或最近的关系(在离水壶最近的价格标记上)或部分地点(在大蓝色拖车的后端)。 在那种情况下,禁止赤裸裸地 " 在手上 " 、 " 在价格标签上 " 、 " 在标志上 " 或 " 在车辆上 " 。 如果事实和证据没有这种限定语,而注释显示存在对应语,则SKIP就存在这一事实。 - 在任何问题中都不要提及作物视图、裁剪、截断或断视状态、能见度限制、或VISILILITY和参考说明部分;这些注释只告诉你何时需要额外定点词。 定位图像框架的参考文献,如 " 靠近图像的左边缘 " 是定位器,而不是视网膜谈话,而且根据帧合同是允许的。 - 只从Capition1公司提出的紧急索赔。 标题2看到了一个作物,而不是照片,所以其中任何左/右/侧措辞都描述了作物自己的框架,并且作为图像的表述是毫无价值的——常常是积极错误的:从照片右侧拍摄的作物有自己的左侧。 绝不将标题2中的水平位置复制或变换成问题。 仅当看到整张照片的字幕1将目标放在那里时使用一个,并将其作为字幕1使用。 - 没有精细的分母。 永远不要写最左,最右,最上,最下,最左,最右,最右,Q最左,Q最上,Q最下,Q最顶,Q最底,Q最底,关于两种语言中的图像. 作为某类中最外层的,是对照片中所有内容的索赔,但标题都无法证明;而是使用附件、最近对象或部分限定词。 超强的INSIDE, 命名为主机的保持很好( ' ' 蓝色标志上的底字 ' ), ——在符合资格的OCR事实后,更喜欢计数/属性事实,更喜欢其关系_caption1为"矛盾"或"不明"的事实. 输出严格 JSON : {"qas":[{"issues_zh":"...","issues_en":"......","crop_issues_zh":"......","回答":"......","问题_类型":"计算Xocr|atpatization+|spatial|patial|patization","证据_判决":"口头证据","来源_事实_index": {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我还得说 如果没有事实可言,则输出{qas':[]}。
