blocks.zh: 增量事实(仅在将信息放大到锚周围的区域时才能看到;每个都从缩放标题中得出证据句子):

blocks.en: {facts}
blocks.zh: [事实]

blocks.en: Full zoomed-view description of the region (use it to check for duplicate objects of the same category — NOT as a source of new facts):
blocks.zh: 区域的全面缩放视图描述( 用它来检查同一类别的重复对象—— 不作为新事实的来源):

blocks.en: {caption2}
blocks.zh: {标题2}

blocks.en: Current generation target plus feedback from prior QA candidates for this SAME anchor:
blocks.zh: 当前生成目标加上来自先前的QA候选人的反馈,用于此SAME主播:

blocks.en: {retry_context}
blocks.zh: {重试_背景}

blocks.en: Generate up to {qa_per_anchor} questions.
blocks.zh: 生成最多 {qa_ per_ anchor} 的问题 。

blocks.en: Every incremental fact has a source_fact_index. Return that exact integer for the one fact used by each QA. Copy evidence_sentence directly from that fact’s source_from_caption2 when available; otherwise use its statement.
blocks.zh: 每个增量的事实都有源_事实_index. 返回每个质量评估所用的一个事实的精确整数。 直接从该事实的来源复制证据_判决_当有_caption2;否则使用其陈述。

blocks.en: Question rules:
blocks.zh: 问题规则:

blocks.en: - Each answer must come from exactly one incremental fact.
blocks.zh: - 每一个答案都必须来自一个完全递增的事实。

blocks.en: - When generating more than one QA in the same response, every QA must use a different source_fact_index and evidence sentence; never make two questions from the same fact or paraphrase the same question.
blocks.zh: - 当在同一个回复中生成一个以上的QA时,每个QA必须使用不同的源_事实_索引和证据句;从不从同一个事实中提出两个问题,或从同一个问题中解释一个问题.

blocks.en: - Any question that asks the solver to read or transcribe text, letters, characters, digits, words, logo lettering, or a specified character span MUST use question_type=ocr. Never label such a question as attribute, comparison, or another type.
blocks.zh: - 任何要求解答者读取或转写文本、字母、字符、数字、单词、标志字母,或指定字符跨度为MUST的问题_类型=ocr的问题。 永远不要将这样的问题标为属性,比较,或者其他类型.

blocks.en: - PRIORITY: if one or more eligible OCR facts are present, generate QA from those OCR facts before using count, attribute, action, or spatial facts. The incremental-facts list is ordered with OCR facts first.
blocks.zh: - 优先事项:如果存在一个或多个合格的OCR事实,则在使用计数、属性、行动或空间事实之前,从OCR这些事实中生成质量保证。 增量事实清单首先与OCR事实一起订购.

blocks.en: - Read the ENTIRE OCR fact, especially statement and source_from_caption2; do not treat visible_sequence as the only useful information. Visual details explicitly tied to the text—such as its background color, text color, position, orientation, containing panel, or relation to another label—are valuable referring cues. Prefer a question that uses those cues to identify one text region over a generic question that asks for every word on a whole sign or logo. Use a visual attribute as a locator, not as another requested answer.
blocks.zh: - 阅读 ENTIRE OCR 事实,特别是语句和来源_ from_caption2;不要将可见_序列作为唯一有用的信息. 与文本明确挂钩的视觉细节——例如其背景颜色、文本颜色、位置、方向、包含面板或与另一标签的关系——是有价值的参考提示。 偏好用这些提示来识别一个文本区域的问题,而不是一个泛泛的问题,即对整个标志或标志上每个字都提出问题。 使用视觉属性作为定位器,而不是作为另一个请求的答案.

blocks.en: - A HEDGED IDENTITY IS NOT A REFERENT. When caption2 hedges what something is — ’what looks like a bird’, ’possibly a helmet’, ’某种容器’ — it is telling you it could not identify the object, and a referring expression built on that guess matches nothing when the guess is wrong: a solver hunting for a bird will never find the plastic bag it actually is. Drop the hedged noun and locate the thing by what IS certain — where it sits, what it is inside or attached to, its color and size (’the small white object on the ledge above the second window’). If nothing certain identifies it, skip the fact. Never carry the hedge into the question either: ’the shoe or boot’ tells a solver you are guessing.
blocks.zh: - 赫德的认同不是一种联系。 当标题2套住什么是“鸟”、“可能是头盔”时, 丢弃树篱上的名词, 并按它所确定的位置定位, 它坐在哪里, 它的内在或附着着着什么, 它的颜色和大小( ' ' 第二窗口上方的窗台上的小白色物体 ' ) 。 如果没有确切的识别,就跳过这个事实. 鞋或靴子告诉一个解答者,

blocks.en: - LOCATOR ATTRIBUTE RELIABILITY: prefer host-level cues — panel/sign color, position, containing object, nearest landmark — over the text’s OWN color. Small text color is frequently misperceived (dark outlined glyphs read as white), and a wrong locator attribute misleads solvers or matches a different text region. Include the text’s color only when the fact states it without hedging AND it adds discrimination that the host cue does not already provide; when the panel alone is unique, leave the text color out. Never take a color from one region of a multi-tone sign and attach it to text sitting on another region; if you cannot say the stroke fill without hedging, use the host cue alone.
blocks.zh: - LOCATOR ATTRIBUTE Reliability: 偏好主机级别的提示——面板/符号颜色,位置,包含对象,最近的地标——而不是文本的自有颜色. 小的文本颜色经常被误解(暗中描述的glyphs读作白色),错误的定位属性会误导解析者或匹配不同的文本区域. 包含文本的颜色, 只有当事实说明它没有套期, 并且添加了主机提示尚未提供的区别; 当面板是独一无二的时, 将文本颜色放出 。 千万不要从一个多色符号的区域中取一个颜色,并附在另一个区域中文本上;如果你不能在不套期的情况下表示中风填充,请单独使用主机提示.

blocks.en: - ONE HOST PER OCR ANSWER. The answer is text carried by a SINGLE bounded host — one sign, label, plate, panel, or printed line. Never assemble an answer out of characters sitting on separate objects, and never scope an OCR question by nearness to a GROUP (’the digits printed near the green bottles’, ’the letters around the potted plants’): proximity to a set has no boundary a solver can reproduce, so which characters belong in the answer becomes arbitrary and a second reader will include a different set. If the text you want spans separate hosts, ask about one of them instead.
blocks.zh: - 一个Host per OCR 回答。 答案是由一个SINGLE定界主机携带的文本——一个标志,标签,盘子,面板,或打印行. 从不从坐在不同物体上的字符中组出一个答案,也从不通过靠近一个小组( ' 绿色瓶子附近的数字打印 ' , ' 盆栽周围的字母 ' )来标注OCR问题:靠近一个集没有解答者可以复制的边界,因此答案中属于哪个字符变得武断,第二个读者将包含不同的集。 如果您想要的文本横跨不同的主机, 请询问其中之一 。

blocks.en: - OCR facts may contain deterministic fields computed by code: safe_sequence, safe_character_count, required_span, and qa_eligible. Never correct, repair, or invent characters beyond safe_sequence. The answer must be one clearly supported CONTIGUOUS segment of safe_sequence.
blocks.zh: - OCR的事实可能包含根据代码计算的确定性字段:安全序列、安全性、安全性、安全性。 永远不要改正、修复或发明超出安全序列的字符。 答案必须是明确支持的安全序列部分。

blocks.en: - For a partial OCR fact (required_span=first or last), write a PLAIN text-reading question about that inscription, located by host-level cues, with the answer equal to safe_sequence verbatim. Do not add any span wording (no ’first/last k characters’), do not add totality words such as ’entire’, ’complete’, or ’all the text’, and never mention cropping or hidden characters. A dedicated edge-rewriting stage that sees the full photograph will rewrite such drafts into the final safe span wording; your draft only needs to pick the right inscription and copy safe_sequence.
blocks.zh: - 对于部分OCR事实(需要_span= first或last),写一个PLAIN文本读取问题,关于该铭文,按主机级提示定位,答案等于安全_序列逐字记录. 不要添加任何跨度(没有 " first/last k 字符 " ), 不要添加 " entire " 、 " complete " 或 " all the text " 等全词, 也不要提及裁剪或隐藏字符。 一个看到完整照片的专用边框重写阶段将把这些草稿重写成最后的安全跨度文字;您的草稿只需要选择正确的铭文并复制安全序列。

blocks.en: - LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT: when required_span=full and the fact itself explicitly associates different complete words or consecutive word groups with independently identifiable visual regions, you may ask for one such region and use only its complete text as the answer. The chosen answer must be one or more WHOLE consecutive words appearing verbatim in safe_sequence; never take characters from inside a word. Both questions must include the fact-supported visual locator that isolates that segment. Do not invent a color, position, container, or relation. If the fact does not support a unique localized segment, use the complete safe_sequence instead.
blocks.zh: - LOCALIZED FULL-OCR单元:当需要_span=full,而且事实本身明确地将不同的完整词组或连续的单词组与独立可识别的视觉区域联系起来时,您可以要求一个这样的区域,并且只使用其完整文本作为答案。 所选的答案必须是一个或一个以上的WALE连续的单词在safet_sequence中逐字出现;从一个单词中不取字符. 这两个问题都必须包括事实支持的视觉定位器,它孤立了这个部分. 不创建颜色、位置、容器或关系。 如果事实不支持一个独特的局部区段,则使用完整的安全_序列代替.

blocks.en: - Example: if a fact says that OPEN appears in white on an upper green panel and 24 HOURS appears on a separate lower black strip, prefer asking what text appears on the upper green panel (answer: OPEN), rather than what all text on the sign says. This example describes the policy only; never copy its objects, colors, positions, or text into another image’s QA.
blocks.zh: - 例如:如果一个事实说OPEN在上绿色面板上以白色出现,24 HOURS在单独的下黑色面条上出现,则更喜欢问上绿色面板上出现什么文字(回答:OPEN),而不是标语上所有文字都写什么. 此示例只描述策略; 绝不将对象、 颜色、 位置或文本复制到另一个图像的QA中 。

blocks.en: - For required_span=full, either ask for the complete clearly legible text and use safe_sequence verbatim, or apply LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT exactly as defined above.
blocks.zh: - 对要求的_span=full, 要么要求完整清晰可辨认的文本并使用安全的_序列逐字记录,要么适用上文所定义的LOCALIZED FLL-OCR部分。

blocks.en: - Never write view-dependent instructions such as ’excluding the top character’, ’ignore the cropped character’, ’remove the first visible letter’, or any reference to an image/crop boundary, cropping, truncation, or hidden characters. A fixed first/last k span must have the same answer in the full image and zoomed image.
blocks.zh: - 绝不编写依赖视图的指令,如 " 排除顶端字符 " 、 " 忽略所刻录的字符 " 、 " 移动第一个可见字母 " 、或提及图像/作物边界、裁剪、截断或隐藏字符。 固定的第一个/最后一个 k 跨度必须在完整图像和放大图像中具有相同的答案 。

blocks.en: - Skip every OCR fact with qa_eligible=false or without all required deterministic fields.
blocks.zh: - 跳过每个OCR 事实,使用 qa_access=false 或没有所有必要的决定性领域。

blocks.en: - If the context contains prior-candidate entries in addition to the generation_target_state, choose a DIFFERENT incremental fact and answer property. Do not repeat or merely paraphrase any rejected or retained global/crop question, evidence sentence, or source fact.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果上下文中除了生成_目标_状态外还包含先前的指定条目,则选择一个偏差递增的事实并回答属性. 不要重复或仅仅解释任何被拒绝或保留的全球/作物问题、证据判决或来源事实。

blocks.en: - Use rejection feedback only to choose a better-supported candidate. NEVER alter the reference answer to imitate verifier outputs, and never invent a fact absent from the incremental-facts list.
blocks.zh: - 使用拒绝反馈只选择一个得到更好支持的候选人。 永远不要修改参考答案来模仿核查结果,决不在递增事实清单中捏造一个事实。

blocks.en: - If a previous candidate failed crop verification, prefer a different fact whose answer is larger/clearer and directly visible in the crop.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 如果先前候选人的作物核查失败,则倾向于另一种事实,其答案更大/更清晰,并在作物中直接可见。

blocks.en: - The generation_target_state entry in the context is authoritative. If zoom_required_still_needed=true and a previous accepted candidate was answerable from the full image, prefer a substantially smaller or finer detail marked absent/unclear/contradicted. If it is false, a retained full-image-answerable QA counts toward the accepted-question minimum; the next distinct accepted QA may be either full-image-answerable or zoom-required.
blocks.zh: - 上下文中的生成_目标_状态条目是权威的. 如果缩放_ required_stall_request= true 和先前被接受的候选人从完整图像中可以回答,则更喜欢用少得多或更细的细节标记缺失/不明确/有争议。 如果错误,保留的全部图像解答QA会算入可接受的最低问题;下一个显著的可接受QA可以是完全图像解答或缩放要求.

blocks.en: - If retry feedback says a previous candidate remained ambiguous AFTER the dedicated image-aware referent repair failed, use a different uniquely referable target. Never add answer-leaking qualifiers.
blocks.zh: - 如果重试反馈说前一名候选人在专用图像感知参考修复失败后仍然含糊不清,则使用不同的可参考目标。 永远不要添加解答的修饰符.

blocks.en: - DISAMBIGUATION: before writing each question, scan the full description above. If the answer object’s category could match more than one object in the crop (e.g. a ring worn by a person vs a standalone ring product image), the crop-local referring phrase MUST include a qualifier that separates them (position, size, displayed-vs-worn, color). If no crop-visible qualifier can make it unique, skip that fact.
blocks.zh: 在写出每个问题之前 扫描上面的完整描述 如果答题对象的分类可以匹配裁剪中的多个对象(例如,一个人佩戴的环与独立的环产品映像),裁剪本地参考词MUST包含一个将它们分开的修饰词(位置,大小,显示-vs-worn,颜色). 如果没有任何作物可见的修饰剂能够使它变得独一无二,就跳过这个事实.

blocks.en: - Write TWO semantically paired versions of every question:
blocks.zh: - 给每个问题写两个拼写版本:

blocks.en: 1. question_zh / question_en are GLOBAL questions for the original full image. They MUST make the answer object locatable in the full image by a solver who has never seen the crop. Choose the locator by the target’s REAL relation to the anchor (see GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY below).
blocks.zh: 1. question_zh / question_en是全球问题,用于原始全图像. 由从未见过裁剪的解析器使答案对象在完整图像中可以移动. 选择目标与主机之间的真实关系定位符(见下文全球LOCATOR政策)。

blocks.en: 2. crop_question_zh / crop_question_en are LOCAL questions for the exact zoomed crop. Remove context that the crop itself cannot establish, such as "in the center of the plaza", "on the building in the background", or "to the right of the white building". Keep only qualifiers whose evidence is visible inside the crop and that are needed to identify the answer object there.
blocks.zh: 2. 作物_问题_zh / 作物_问题_en 是精确放大作物的 LOCAL 问题。 删除作物本身无法建立的上下文,如"在广场中心","在背景的建筑物上",或"在白色建筑的右边". 仅保留其证据在作物内可见,并且是在那里识别答案对象所需的限定词。

blocks.en: - Follow the Crop-local anchor rule exactly. A selection rectangle may be used only as a referring-expression locator for the photographed anchor, its parts, contents, markings, or related nearby objects. Never ask about the rectangle itself, its color, shape, boundary, corners, or any artificial label. The GLOBAL questions must never mention a selection rectangle.
blocks.zh: - 遵守作物本地主播规则 选择矩只可用作被拍摄锚、其部件、内容、标记或附近相关物体的参考表示器。 永远不要问矩形本身,它的颜色,形状,边界,角,或者任何人工标签. 全球问题决不能提到选择矩形。

blocks.en: - The GLOBAL and LOCAL versions MUST ask the same property of the same object and MUST have the same answer. The local version is not a new question.
blocks.zh: - Global 和 LOCAL 版本 MUST 询问同一对象的相同属性, MUST 也有相同的答案. 本地版本不是一个新问题。

blocks.en: - The LOCAL question must be self-contained and its answer object must be uniquely identifiable inside the crop. If removing unavailable global context makes that impossible, skip the fact.
blocks.zh: - LOCAL问题必须是自成一体的,其答案对象必须是作物内唯一可识别的。 如果删除无法获取的全局背景使得无法做到这一点,则跳过事实。

blocks.en: GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY (the crop is a 2D window; objects inside it can lie at completely different scene depths, so 2D adjacency inside the crop is NOT scene proximity):
blocks.zh: 全球LOCATOR政策( 裁剪是一个 2D 窗口; 里面的物体可以躺在完全不同的场景深处, 因此裁剪里面的 2D 相邻性不是场景相近 ) :

blocks.en: (a) If the answer object has a REAL, visually supported scene relation to the anchor — it is a part of it, attached to it, on the same supporting surface, held by it, or genuinely adjacent at the same depth — locate it through the anchor phrase as usual.
blocks.zh: (a) 如果答题对象与主播有真实,视觉支持的场景关系——它是主播的一部分,附着在主播身上,在同一支持面上,由主播持有,或者在同一个深度上真正相邻,则通过主播短语按常态定位.

blocks.en: (b) If the answer object is clearly at a different depth than the anchor (the zoomed description says it is much closer to or farther from the camera, e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a background lighthouse), NEVER claim proximity with words such as near, beside, next to, 附近, 旁边, and never use front/behind as a disguised depth word. That fabricates a relation that does not exist, misleads the solver into searching around the anchor, and reads unnaturally. PREFER KEEPING THE ANCHOR in the question through an HONEST relation — it is the verified, easiest-to-find landmark — choosing whichever of these reads naturally:
blocks.zh: (b) 国家 如果答题对象明显处于与主播不同的深度(放大描述说它离相机更近或更远,例如,在背景灯塔周围建造的作物内部有一个前地慢跑者),则永远不要声称接近诸如靠近,靠近,靠近,靠近,**,**,也永远不要使用前方/后方作为伪装的深度词. 这造就了一个不存在的关系,误导了解答者绕着锚进行搜索,并且不自然地阅读. 倾向于通过一个交际关系——这是经过核实的、最容易找到的地标——来决定其中哪一个自然是:

blocks.en: - CAMERA-AXIS relation (works for ANY anchor, including faceless structures; preferred when the target lies on or near the anchor’s line of sight, which crop co-membership usually guarantees): state the depth order along the viewing axis with the canonical wording — target closer to the camera: ’the yellow taxi between the clock tower and the camera’ / 在钟楼与镜头之间的黄色出租车; target farther: ’the brick warehouse beyond the red barge, farther from the camera’ / 越过红色驳船更远处的砖砌仓库. When the two do not overlap in the image, add a small image-frame offset word (’below the clock tower and between it and the camera’). This wording is honest 3D geometry, never a proximity claim.
blocks.zh: - CAMERA-AXIS关系(为任何锚的工作,包括无脸结构;在目标位于锚的视线上或附近时首选,通常由共同成员保证):用犬形文字说明取景轴的深度顺序——目标靠近照相机: '钟楼和照相机之间的黄色出租车 ' ;目标更远:`红驳船以外的砖仓,离照相机更远 ' 。 当两者没有在图像中重叠时,增加一个小的图像框抵消词( ' 在钟楼下方以及它与相机之间 ' ). 这个措辞是诚实的3D几何,从来不是近距离主张.

blocks.en: - INTRINSIC ANCHOR-FRAME relation: when the anchor is a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing caption2 states, the target may be located in the anchor’s own frame with each side derived mechanically per the contract. Example: a cyclist riding toward the viewer has the deeper scene BEHIND him and his left-hand side on the viewer’s right, so ’the bright blue vertical sign behind the cyclist on his left-hand side’ is honest and natural. SIDE-BLINDNESS GUARDRAIL: verification models cannot reliably resolve a person’s left/right sides, so any anchor-frame directional clause is narrative scaffolding only — the question MUST still identify the target uniquely when that clause is ignored, through at least one anchor-independent discriminator (object type plus color, nearest fixed landmark, or viewer-frame position). If uniqueness would depend on the anchor-frame clause itself, do not use this option.
blocks.zh: - INTRINSIC ANCHOR-FRAME关系:当锚是人、动物或车辆,其正面标题2说明时,目标可能位于锚本身的框中,每方根据合同通过机械方式得出。 因此左手边的自行车手背后的明亮蓝色垂直标志是诚实和自然的。 SIDE-BLINDENES GUARDRAL: 校验模型无法可靠地解决一个人的左/右侧,因此任何锚定框方向条款都只是叙事脚手架——当该条款被忽略时,MUST仍然通过至少一个锚定独立的区分器(对象类型加颜色,最近的固定地标,或查看器-帧位置)来单独确定目标. 如果独特性取决于锚定框架条款本身,则不使用这一选择。

blocks.en: - EXPLICIT IMAGE-FRAME relation to the anchor: honest 2D wording such as ’in the image, above the cyclist in the background’ or ’below the lighthouse and much closer to the camera’, never wording that implies physical proximity.
blocks.zh: - EXPLICIT IMAGE-FRAME与主播的关系:诚实的二维措辞,如 " 在图像中 " 、 " 在灯塔下 " 或 " 在灯塔下 " 、 " 离照相机更近 " 等,从未出现过暗示身体接近的措辞。

blocks.en: - SELF-LOCATING referent (fallback when no anchor-linked wording reads naturally, e.g. the linkage would feel contrived across a large cluttered depth gap): drop the anchor and locate the target with full-image-frame position plus its own visible attributes, e.g. ’the jogger in the lower-center foreground of the image wearing a cap’. Depth words like foreground/closer to the camera stay true across views; horizontal words must be re-derived from the FULL image, never copied from the crop question.
blocks.zh: - SELF-LOCATING参考词(当没有与锚相连的措辞自然读取时倒计时,例如,连接会感到跨越一个巨大的杂乱的深度差距):放下锚并用全图像框位置加上其自身的可见属性定位目标,例如 " 戴着盖子的图像在下中心前缘的慢跑者 " 。 前方/镜头关闭等深度单词在视图之间保持真实性;水平单词必须从FUL图像中重新产生,绝不从裁剪问题中复制.

blocks.en: (c) If none of these produces a referent you are confident is unique in the FULL image, skip the fact.
blocks.zh: (c) 如果这些没有产生一个推荐人,你相信在全能图像中是独一无二的,就跳过这个事实。

blocks.en: Prefer facts about the anchor itself or objects in its own depth zone: a crop-foreground object much closer to the camera is usually large and legible in the full image, so its facts rarely survive the full-image difficulty gate; spend them only when nothing anchored remains.
blocks.zh: 更喜欢关于锚本身或自身深度区域物体的事实:一个远近于相机的作物前物体通常很大,在完整图像中可以辨别,因此其事实很少在完整图像难度门后幸存;只有在没有锚定残留时才使用.

blocks.en: - Example pair:
blocks.zh: - 示例对:

blocks.en: GLOBAL: "What text is written on the sign in the center of the plaza?"
blocks.zh: 全球:"广场中央的标志上写了什么文字?"

blocks.en: LOCAL: "What text is written on the sign?"
blocks.zh: "LOCAL:"什么文字写在标志上?"

blocks.en: - NEVER put the answer attribute itself into either referring expression (if the answer is a color, the referring phrase must not mention that color).
blocks.zh: - 从不将答案属性本身放在任何一种引用表达式中(如果答案是颜色,则引用短语不得提及该颜色).

blocks.en: - The answer must be a single definite value: an exact count, one color word, a short text string, or a short action. Skip facts with ranges, hedges, or subjective wording.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 答案必须是单一的确定值:精确的计数,一个颜色的单词,一个短的文本字符串,或者一个短的动作. 用范围、套期或主观措辞跳过事实。

blocks.en: - The answer itself must never be an anatomical body side (’left hand’, ’right leg’) NOR a part location on an oriented object (’near the front left corner’, ’at the rear end’, 车头/车尾): all vision models share systematic mirror and orientation confusion, so such answers cannot be verified reliably. Sides and part locations serve only as referring qualifiers inside questions.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 答案本身绝不是解剖身体( ' 左手 ' , ' 右腿 ' ) NOR在一个面向对象( ' 在左前角附近 ' , ' 在后端 ' )上的一部分位置:所有视觉模型都共享系统镜像和定向混淆,因此无法可靠地验证这些答案。 侧面和部分位置仅作为问题中的限定词。

blocks.en: - COUNTING SOURCE GATE: before using a count fact, classify its real-scene scope. It is eligible only as (A) anchor_owned: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, with the complete relevant anchor-side set visible; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region: the items occupy a finite interval or region explicitly bounded by the anchor and another specific visible object, and all boundaries are fully visible. If neither classification is supported, skip the fact, even when it contains an exact number and is contradicted by caption1.
blocks.zh: 在使用计数事实之前, 分类它的真实范围。 它只能作为(A)锚属:被计数的物品是部分,附着,磨损,由或包含在选定的锚属中,完整的相关锚侧设置可见;或者(B)闭合_anchor_relative_region:这些物品占据了明确以锚属和另一个特定可见物体为界的有限间隔或区域,所有边界都完全可见. 如果两者都不支持分类,则跳过这个事实,即使它包含一个确切的数字,并与标题1相矛盾.

blocks.en: - Crop edges never close a counting scope. Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field identify a visible subset but do not define a complete set. Never generate a question asking for the total of such an open scene region. In particular, counting the instances currently visible in a cropped slice of sea, beach, road, crowd, field, or sky is forbidden.
blocks.zh: - 作物边缘从不关闭计数范围。 诸如靠近,周围,后面,前面,左/右,背景,水中,或在海滩/公路/战地上识别一个可见的子集,但没有定义完整的集. 永远不要提出这样一个空地区域的全部问题。 特别是,禁止在海、海滩、道路、人群、田野或天空中计数目前可以看到的情况。

blocks.en: - For an eligible anchor_owned count, the question must explicitly bind the counted items to the anchor. For an eligible closed_anchor_relative_region count, the question must name both bounding objects and the finite interval/region between them. A generic phrase such as ’behind the anchor’ is insufficient.
blocks.zh: - 对于合格的主播-拥有的计数,问题必须明确将计数的项目与主播挂钩。 对于符合条件的封闭_anchor_relative_region 计数,问题必须同时指定约束对象和它们之间的有限间隔/区域. 诸如 " 锚在后面 " 这样的通用短语是不够的。

blocks.en: - Prefer count facts carrying count_scope_type and scope_fully_visible=true. Independently audit the evidence and full crop description; metadata cannot rescue an actually open scope.
blocks.zh: - 优先计数事实,包含计数_范围_类型和范围_完全_可见=真. 独立审计证据和完整的作物描述;元数据无法挽救实际开放的范围。

blocks.en: - Skip facts about the region boundary and vegetation/sky texture.
blocks.zh: - 省略有关区域边界和植被/天空纹理的事实。

blocks.en: - Skip color facts that differ only at hue level between the two views.
blocks.zh: - 跳过两种观点之间不同颜色的事实。

blocks.en: - Apply the frame contract above to every direction word in questions and answers. Body-part sides stay anatomical exactly as the fact states them (’right hand’ means his own right hand); never convert an anatomical side into an image side or vice versa. Keep parenthetical facing/viewer-side derivations OUT of the question text — questions carry only natural human phrasing.
blocks.zh: - 将上述框架合同适用于问答中的每个方向词。 身体部分的侧面保持解剖状态,与事实完全一致(右手意味着自己的右手);绝不将解剖面转换成图像面,反之亦然。 保持括号面/视图边衍生 在提问文本中——问题只包含自然的人类措辞.

blocks.en: - BILINGUAL FRAME PARITY: the Chinese and English versions must encode the same frame with the same discipline. In Chinese, scene depth must be written as 背景中 / 前景中 / 离镜头更远 / 更靠近镜头 — NEVER as 后方、身后、前方 or 前面 attached to a person or animal (write 跑者背景中更远处的车辆, not 跑者后方的车辆). Use 身后/面前 only for a person’s intrinsic sides and only when the question itself states that person’s facing (e.g. 背对镜头的人身后). 左手/右手 are anatomical only, exactly like left/right hand in English.
blocks.zh: - BILINGUAL FRAME PARITY:中文版和英文版必须用相同的学科编码同一个框. 在中文中,场景深度必须写成QQ / / / / / / / / —— 绝不是QQ 或 + + 附属于一个人或动物(write + ,而不是 + ). 只为一个人的内在侧面而使用QQ/□,并且只有在问题本身表明此人面临时才使用(例如QQ). QQ/QQ只是解剖学,与英语中的左/右手完全一样.

blocks.en: - LIMB QUALIFIER PREFERENCE: to single out one of a person’s paired limbs, prefer the pose or state the fact records — the raised arm, the arm hanging at the side, the hand holding the strap — over an anatomical side. Pose wording is natural, needs no facing derivation, and is the only kind a solver can check; verification models do not reliably resolve a person’s left from their right. Use ’left/right hand’ only when the fact states the side with an explicit facing derivation AND no pose descriptor separates the limbs.
blocks.zh: - LIMB QUALIFIER 偏好:单挑一个人的双肢之一,更喜欢姿势或说明事实记录——举起的手臂,手臂悬在侧面,手握带子——而不是解剖面。 Pose的措辞是自然的,不需要面对推论,是解决者唯一可以检查的;核查模型不能可靠地解决一个人从右侧留下的问题。 只有在事实表明一方有明确的面部特征,没有姿势描述符将四肢分开时,才使用左/右手。

blocks.en: - REFERENT CLOSURE (mandatory): if the fact’s answer object belongs to a multi-instance category — hands, feet, shoes, price tags, labels, signs, screens, wheels, windows, bags, or similar repeated parts and products — and the zoomed description or its VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES indicate that other instances exist anywhere in the scene, are cut off, or are out of view with unknown content, then BOTH the global and crop questions MUST pin the exact instance using the qualifier carried by the fact and its evidence: the anatomical side (’in his right hand’), the attachment or nearest relation (’on the price tag closest to the kettle’), or the part location (’on the rear end of the large blue trailer’). A bare ’in his hand’, ’on the price tag’, ’on the sign’, or ’on the vehicle’ is forbidden in that situation. If the fact and evidence carry no such qualifier while the notes show counterparts exist, SKIP that fact.
blocks.zh: - 参考关闭(强制性):如果事实的解答对象属于多事件类别——手、脚、鞋、价格标记、标签、标志、屏幕、轮子、窗户、袋或类似的重复部件和产品,以及放大描述或其VISUILILILY和ReFERENCES说明表明现场任何地方都存在其他情况,或断绝或断绝了不明内容的视线,那么全球问题和作物问题就用事实及其证据所携带的限定词定出确切的例子:解剖方面(他的右手)、附件或最近的关系(在离水壶最近的价格标记上)或部分地点(在大蓝色拖车的后端)。 在那种情况下,禁止赤裸裸地 " 在手上 " 、 " 在价格标签上 " 、 " 在标志上 " 或 " 在车辆上 " 。 如果事实和证据没有这种限定语,而注释显示存在对应语,则SKIP就存在这一事实。

blocks.en: - Never mention the crop viewport, cropping, truncation, cut-off or out-of-view states, visibility limitations, or the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section in any question; the notes only tell you when an extra pinning qualifier is required. Positional image-frame references such as ’near the left edge of the image’ are locators, not viewport talk, and remain allowed under the frame contract.
blocks.zh: - 在任何问题中都不要提及作物视图、裁剪、截断或断视状态、能见度限制、或VISILILITY和参考说明部分;这些注释只告诉你何时需要额外定点词。 定位图像框架的参考文献,如 " 靠近图像的左边缘 " 是定位器,而不是视网膜谈话,而且根据帧合同是允许的。

blocks.en: - FRAME CLAIMS COME FROM CAPTION1 ONLY. caption2 saw a crop, not the photograph, so any left/right/side wording in it describes the crop’s own frame and is worthless — often actively wrong — as a statement about the image: a crop taken from the right of the photo has its own left side. Never copy or paraphrase a horizontal position out of caption2 into a question. Use one only when caption1, which saw the whole photograph, places the target there, and word it as caption1 does.
blocks.zh: - 仅凭Capition1公司提出的紧急索赔。 标题2看到了一个作物,而不是照片,所以其中任何左/右/侧措辞都描述了作物自己的框架,并且作为图像的表述是毫无价值的——常常是积极错误的:从照片右侧拍摄的作物有自己的左侧。 绝不将标题2中的水平位置复制或变换成问题。 仅当看到整张照片的字幕1将目标放在那里时使用一个,并将其作为字幕1使用。

blocks.en: - NO FRAME SUPERLATIVES. Never write leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right, 最左, 最右, 最上, 最下, 最顶, 最底 about the image in either language. Being the outermost of a category is a claim about everything in the photograph, which neither caption can establish; use an attachment, nearest-object, or part qualifier instead. A superlative INSIDE one named host stays fine (’the bottom word on the blue sign’), because the host bounds it.
blocks.zh: - 没有精细的分母。 永远不要写最左,最右,最上,最下,最左,最右,最右,Q最左,Q最上,Q最下,Q最顶,Q最底,Q最底,关于两种语言中的图像. 作为某类中最外层的,是对照片中所有内容的索赔,但标题都无法证明;而是使用附件、最近对象或部分限定词。 超强的INSIDE, 命名为主机的保持很好( ' ' 蓝色标志上的底字 ' ),

blocks.en: - After eligible OCR facts, prefer counting / attribute facts, and prefer facts whose relation_to_caption1 is "contradicted" or "unclear".
blocks.zh: ——在符合资格的OCR事实后,更喜欢计数/属性事实,更喜欢其关系_caption1为"矛盾"或"不明"的事实.

blocks.en: J.5 Joint crop/full-image audit and rewriting
blocks.zh: J.5 联合作物/全成像审计和改写

blocks.en: You are the crop-boundary auditor and question rewriter of a visual-QA data pipeline. BACKGROUND — WHY THIS STAGE EXISTS: The pipeline writes fine-grained QA about one anchor object. Every earlier stage saw ONLY a crop taken around that anchor: a describer captioned the crop, and a question writer turned caption facts into a crop-local question plus a full-image question. Neither could see past the crop’s four edges, so two recurring failures escape them: 1. INCOMPLETE ANSWER CLAIM: the object or inscription carrying the answer continues beyond the crop boundary, and the recorded answer silently claims to be the complete text or a whole-object attribute when it is not (a sign whose top line sits above the crop; a hull that runs past the edge with more markings). 2. REFERENT AMBIGUOUS IN THE FULL IMAGE: the referring phrase picks exactly one thing inside the crop but matches several things in the full photograph (three white signs on the same wall; a second red inscription on the same hull). You are the first stage that sees BOTH views, so these become direct observations for you. Downstream, independent solver models will answer the crop-local question seeing only the crop, and the full-image question seeing only the full photograph. Your goal: an honest, careful solver in EITHER view must arrive at exactly the recorded answer. Rejecting a question throws away everything already spent creating it, so PREFER RESCUING a question with a bounded rewrite over dropping it — but never rescue one at the cost of truthfulness. INPUTS: Image 1 is the crop. A cyan box labeled C1, if present, marks the already-certified unique referent of the crop-local question; a thin red rectangle, if present, marks the anchor. Both are annotations, never scene content. Image 2 is the FULL photograph with a red rectangle marking where the crop was taken. Use it to see what continues beyond the crop and what else in the scene matches the question’s wording. Image 2 may be lower-resolution: use it to detect continuation and count referent matches, not to read new text. THE QA UNDER AUDIT: anchor: "{anchor}" question_type: {question_type} global question (full-image solvers) EN: {question_en} global question ZH: {question_zh} crop-local question EN: {crop_question_en} crop-local question ZH: {crop_question_zh} recorded answer: {answer} mechanical OCR contract (null for non-OCR): {ocr_constraint} caption evidence sentence: {evidence} AUDIT PROCEDURE: A. CONTINUATION: in Image 2, does the object or inscription that carries the answer visibly continue beyond the crop rectangle in a way that could add to or change the answer as the question words it? For an OCR question, also check inside the crop whether the inscription’s own host is cut or occluded near the text so the text may continue out of sight. A cut-off host is harmless when the question only asks about a bounded part that is fully visible. THE BURDEN IS ON ’false’. Reaching the crop border IS continuation unless you can point to the reason it is not. Answer false only when you can name what bounds the host on that side — its own frame, edge, corner or end, visible INSIDE one of the two views — or when Image 2 shows the whole host with nothing further. If the host runs to the border and you cannot see where it stops, that is true, not false, however legible the part you can read: a street plate whose left edge is the crop’s left edge gets read as ’STATION ROAD’ when the plate says ’OLD STATION ROAD’, and a menu board whose bottom is the crop’s bottom shows two of its five lines. Both look complete. Being able to read what is visible is not evidence that nothing else is there. Answering true does not condemn the QA — narrow_semantic rescues it by re-scoping to a sub-block you CAN see whole (’the line nearest the arrow marker’, ’the bottom word’). Prefer that rescue over a confirm you cannot justify. B. UNIQUENESS: read each referring phrase of the GLOBAL question and count what it matches in Image 2; read the CROP question and count matches in Image 1. A locator difference that a careful solver would treat as decisive (unique attachment, position, or size wording) counts as disambiguation; a bare category plus color usually does not. For an OCR question, ALSO count the text blocks: every separate inscription on the same host that a solver could take to match how the question describes the text (its color, case, or style) is a competing candidate. Judge like a strict solver, not a brand reader: a smaller second line counts; a darker shade of the same hue counts; digits and mixed letter-digit strings count as capital-glyph text; a registration or phone number printed under a brand name is the classic competing block. If more than one block could match, an honest solver cannot know which to read: the wording must single one out by row, size, or position (rewrite), or the QA must be dropped. Never assume the most prominent text is ’the’ text. WEAK TEXT REFERENT RULE: a text referent described only by color and/or letter case (’the red capital letters’) with no size, row, or position qualifier is weak wording. Whenever the host carries ANY other marking — even one you judge too small or too faint to read — prefer a minimal tightening rewrite (add ’the largest’, a row, or a position word) over keep. The tightening costs nothing and makes the question robust to markings at the edge of legibility. Enumerate this audit in the output field other_inscriptions_on_host: one entry per OTHER inscription, print, number, or marking on the same host (empty list only when the host truly carries no other markings). could_match_question_wording=true means a strict solver could take that block as matching the question’s text description. Keeping the question while any entry is true is a contradiction — then you must rewrite (single the target out by row, size, or position) or drop; code enforces this. C. COUNT SCOPE (counting questions): the counted set must be closed by visible boundaries; if Image 2 shows the set continuing outside the crop while the question implies a total, the claim is broken. VERDICTS: - keep: both audits clean; the recorded answer is exactly what an honest solver would give in both views. - rewrite: a bounded edit repairs the problem — tighten a referring phrase so it is unique in both views, or narrow an OCR claim to a safe span (see OCR SPAN DECISION). Rewrite all four question fields consistently. - drop: the recorded answer is factually wrong or unverifiable in either view, no crop-visible qualifier can make the referent unique, or a count’s scope is opened by the crop edge. Also drop when a rescue would need information a crop-only solver cannot see. - COUNT RESCUE BAN: a counting question whose set the crop opens can NEVER be rescued by wording. Adding ’visible’ / ’可见’ or similar makes the crop total and the full-image total differ, so the two views would have different correct answers. Such a question is unfixable: drop it. REWRITE RULES: - The recorded answer may NEVER be extended, corrected, or replaced with content you read in Image 2 — you sit downstream of evidence extraction and may only NARROW claims. For a non-OCR question the answer must stay exactly unchanged; you edit wording only. For an OCR question the answer may only shrink to a contiguous part of the recorded sequence. - CROSS-VIEW LOCATOR ATTRIBUTES: check every attribute the question uses to FIND the target — color, size, material, shape — against both images, including attributes the draft already contained. A sliver visible in the crop routinely misdescribes the whole object in the full photograph: a white sign whose only visible strip sits against an orange panel reads as ’the orange sign’ in the crop and matches nothing (or something else) in the full image. Replace a misleading attribute with one true in both views, or drop when none exists. - Every qualifier you add must be verifiable inside the CROP (crop solvers cannot see past it) and stay true in the full image. Prefer attachment, nearest-object, part-position, row/line position, or relative-size cues. Never use viewport words (crop, edge, truncated, cut off, visible portion, 画面边缘, 被截断), and never copy answer characters or answer words into any question field. - Keep the two languages synchronized and keep the global/crop pairing: the global question locates the target for a full-image solver (usually via the anchor); the crop question drops context the crop cannot establish. - Spatial wording in rewrites must obey this contract: <<<INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>><<<INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT>>> OCR SPAN DECISION (REQUIRED for every ocr question, in ocr_span_decision; null for non-OCR): You MAY change an OCR question’s answer — this is usually the BEST rescue, not a last resort — provided the new answer is a contiguous part of the recorded one. Upstream drafts are often clumsy (a 20-character positional span, or a sequence that silently spans a truncation); your job is to re-scope onto a piece that is easy to refer to and true in both views: the bottom word, the largest line, the top row, or the first few letters. Work through the decisions in this order and pick the FIRST that yields a claim true in both views: - confirm: the inscription the question asks about is completely visible with no plausible continuation, and the recorded answer is its complete text (or the question already carries consistent span wording). Valid with verdict keep or with a rewrite that only fixed the referring phrase. confirm is FORBIDDEN whenever you observed the inscription’s host cut or continuing at or near the text region — in the crop or in Image 2. Observing continuation and confirming anyway is a contradiction; choose narrow_semantic, demote, or drop instead. - narrow_semantic (PREFERRED rescue): re-scope the question to one fully-visible, visually isolable sub-block — the bottom word, the topmost row, the largest line, the group on one panel — whose complete text is a contiguous whole-word part of the recorded sequence; the answer becomes exactly that part (’what is the bottom word on the sign’ -> ’Bakery’ where the recorded answer was ’Old Town Bakery’). A solver reads such a unit naturally, with no character counting. Identify the sub-block ONLY by visual properties (position, size, row, color of its panel), never by quoting its text. THE SUB-BLOCK MUST BE CLOSED ON THE CUT SIDE. A sub-block is only ’fully visible’ if every one of its own boundaries is inside the crop, and the boundary that matters is the one facing the cut. When the host is cut on its LEFT or RIGHT, a row or line runs straight into that cut and is not closed, so ’the lower line’, ’the word at the top of the sign’, ’the largest word on the second row’ and any other row- or band-based selector is invalid there — pick a unit bounded away from the cut instead (a word whose far side is clear space, the block on one whole panel). When the host is cut at the TOP or BOTTOM, rows away from the cut are fine and a column is not. A size superlative (’the largest word’) over a unit that continues out of view is a claim about text you cannot see. If no closed sub-block exists, use demote_first / demote_last or drop; do not narrow onto an open one. - demote_first / demote_last: for the cases narrow_semantic cannot express — no whole word is fully safe, but a clean sub-word boundary fragment is (only ’SUR’ of a longer word is clearly visible). Ask for exactly the first/last k alphanumeric characters of the recorded sequence, with 3 <= k <= 7 — solvers must COUNT the characters, so a larger k turns reading into error-prone counting and is mechanically rejected. Use demote_first when the text’s beginning boundary is visibly real and continuation risk is at the end; demote_last in the mirror case. CROSS-VIEW SPAN AGREEMENT (mandatory): before choosing k, read the same characters in Image 2 — every one of the k characters you keep must be identical in the crop and in the full photograph. A recorded sequence stitched together across a truncation (two cut lines read as one string) diverges from the real text at the stitch, and any k that reaches the stitch makes the answer wrong for full-image solvers: choose the smallest stable k (>= 3) that stays strictly before the divergence, and if even 3 agreeing characters do not exist, demote is unavailable. Both English question fields must contain the explicit k right beside first/last (e.g. ’the first 3 characters’), and the Chinese fields must mirror it (e.g. “前3个字母数字字符”). The answer is that exact span with its original spacing and punctuation preserved. - SHORT ANSWERS: an answer of fewer than 3 alphanumeric characters cannot be narrowed any further, so it survives only as confirm with no continuation anywhere at that text. If the inscription continues out of view (or its host is cut at the text), a 1-2 character recorded answer is a fragment of something longer: drop it rather than re-scoping the question onto that fragment — code rejects such a rescue either way. - Drop an OCR question only AFTER checking that no narrowing exists: neither a whole-word sub-block (narrow_semantic) nor a 3-7 character boundary span (demote) yields a claim true in both views. A recorded answer being wrong AS A WHOLE does not justify drop when a narrowed part of it is still exactly right. Do not transcribe scene text in reasons beyond what the recorded answer already contains. Return strict JSON only: {"continuation_beyond_crop": true|false, "full_image_referent_matches": <integer count for the global question’s referent in Image 2>, "crop_referent_matches": <integer count in Image 1>, "other_inscriptions_on_host": [{"description": "where/what kind of marking, WITHOUT transcribing it", "could_match_question_wording": true|false}] (for non-OCR questions use []), "verdict": "keep|rewrite|drop", "ocr_span_decision": "confirm|narrow_semantic|demote_first|demote_last"|null, "rewrite": null|{"question_zh": "...", "question_en": "...", "crop_question_zh": "...", "crop_question_en": "...", "answer": "..."}, "drop_reason": null|"concise reason", "reason": "concise image-specific audit reason"}
blocks.zh: 你是作物边界审计员 并质疑重写可视QA数据管道。 背景: 为什么这一阶段存在: 管道写着精细的QA关于一个锚物. 在较早的阶段,只看到一种作物围绕该锚进行:一个描述者对作物进行了描述,一个提问作家将描述事实变成了一个作物-局部问题和一个完整的图像问题。 也看不到作物的四边, 所以有两个反复出现的失败, 1. INCOMPLETE ANSWER索赔:载有答复的物体或铭文继续超出作物边界,所记录的答案默默地声称,如果不是,就是完整的文字或整个物体属性(一个其顶线位于作物之上的标志;一个通过边缘的船体,加上更多的标记)。 2. FulL IMAGE中提及Ambiguous:引言词在作物内部选取了完全一样的东西,但与完整照片中的几样东西相匹配(同一墙上三个白色标志;同一船体上第二个红色铭文)。 你是第一个看到这两个观点的阶段, 所以这些成为你直接的观察。 下游,独立的解析器模型会回答作物-局部问题只看到作物,全图像问题只看到完整的照片. 你的目标:一个诚实,仔细的解决方案 在Eirher观点中必须得出准确的 记录的答案。 拒绝一个问题就放弃了已经花费的一切,因此,PRIFER重写一个问题,而不是放弃一个问题——但绝不以诚实为代价拯救一个问题。 INPUTS:图像1是作物. 标注为C1的青色盒,如果存在,则标注已被认证的作物-局部问题的独特参考物;如果存在,则标注锚定物的细红色矩形. 两者都是说明,从来不是场景内容. 图像2是带有红色矩形标志的FulL照片,是收割作物的地方. 用它来观察在作物之外还有什么在现场与问题的措辞相符。 图2可能是低分辨率的:用它来检测续作和计算参考匹配,而不是读取新文本. 审计下的QA: 主播: "{anchor}" 问题_类型: { question_type} 全球问题(全图像解析器) EN: {issue_en} 全球问题 ZH: {issue_zh} 裁剪本地问题 EN: { crop_ question_en} program- local question ZH: {crop_ question_zh} 记录的回答 : {answer} 机械 OCR 合同( null for no- OCR): {ocr_ construction} 标题证据句: {证据} A. 审计程序:A. 继续:在图像2中,带有答案的物体或铭文是否明显地延续到作物矩形之外,从而能够将答案作为问题词加以补充或改变? 对于一个OCR问题,请在收割器内检查铭文本身的主机是否在文字附近被剪断或被占用,这样文字就可以继续离开视线. 当问题只问到一个完全可见的有界部分时,断层主机是无害的. 堡垒是虚假的。 到达作物边界IS继续,除非你能说明原因。 答案是虚假的,只有在你能够给那个侧面的宿主点出什么界限——它自己的框架,边缘,角或端,可见的INSIDE 两种观点之一——或者当Image 2以没有其他内容显示整个宿主时. 如果宿主跑到边境, 你却看不到它停在哪里, 这是正确的, 不是虚假的, 无论你能读到什么清晰的部分: 一个街牌左边缘是作物的左边缘, 两者看起来都是完整的。 能够读懂可见的东西,并不是证明那里没有别的东西。 回答真话并不谴责QA — — 狭义的语义拯救它, 重新定义到一个可以看到完整的小块( ' 箭头标志最近的线条 ' , ' 底字 ' )。 最好把营救比起确认你无法证明 B. UNIQUENESS:读取全球问题中的每一个参考短语,并算出图像2中它匹配的内容;读取图像1中的CROP问题和计数匹配. 谨慎解决者会视其为决定性(独特的附件,位置,或大小措辞)的定位差异,算作模糊不清;赤色类加颜色通常不会. 对于一个OCR问题,还计算文本块:一个解题者可以在同一主机上的每一个单独的铭文来匹配问题如何描述文本(其颜色,大小写,或风格)是一个相互竞争的候选人. 评委像严格解答者,而不是品牌阅读器:较小的第二行计数;同样hue计数的更暗的阴影;数字和混合字母数字字符串计为资本-glyph文本;在品牌名下打印的注册号或电话号码是经典的竞争块. 如果一个以上的块可以匹配,一个诚实的解析器无法知道要读到哪个:措辞必须逐行选择一个,大小,或位置(重写),或者必须删除QA. 永远不要认为最突出的文本是‘文本'。 WEAK TEXT Reffelent RULE:一个仅用颜色和/或字母大小写描述的文本引用( ' 红色大写字母 ' ),没有大小、行或位置修饰词是弱的。 当主机携带任何其他标记时——即使是你判断太小或太晕不能阅读的标记——都宁愿保留一个最小的收紧重写(加上‘最大'、一行或一个位置单词)。 收紧不费钱,使问题变得难以辨别。 在输出字段其他_ incripts_on_host中进行这一审计:每个其它字段一个条目,打印,数字,或者在同一主机上进行标记(只有在主机真的没有其他标记时才进行空列表). 可能_ match_ question_wording= truth 表示严格解答者可以将该块作为匹配问题文本描述的块 。 在任何条目属实的情况下保留问题是一个矛盾——那么你必须重写(按行,大小,或位置重写目标)或下降;代码执行这个. C. COUNT SCOPE(计数问题):计数的集必须用可见的边界关闭;如果图像2显示的集在作物之外继续,而问题意味着一个总数,则索赔被打破。 VERDICTS: - 保持:两种审计都是干净的;记录的答案正是诚实的解决者在两种观点中给出的. - 重写:有限度的编辑修复问题——将引文收紧,这样在两种观点中都是独一无二的,或者将OCR的主张缩小到安全范围(见OCR SPAN决定)。 一致重写所有四个问题字段。 - 下降:记录的答案在两种观点中都是事实错误或无法核实的,任何作物可见的限定词都不能使裁判独有,或者一个伯爵的范围被作物边缘打开。 当救援需要信息时, 仅靠作物解析器无法看到时, 请放下 。 - CONT ResCUE BAN:一个计算问题,谁的收成打开了,永远无法用措辞挽救。 加上`可见'/`’可见’'或类似,作物总数和全图像总数就不同了,因此两种观点会有不同的正确答案。 这样的问题是无法解决的:放弃吧. 重述规则: - 记录的答案可能永远不会被扩展,更正,或者被您在图像2中读到的内容所取代——你坐在证据提取的下游,可能只能是NARROW索赔. 对于非OCR问题,答案必须完全不变;只编辑措辞。 对于一个OCR问题,答案可能只缩到记录序列的毗连部分. - Cross-VIEW LOCATOR ATTRIBUTES:对照两个图像,包括已经包含的草稿属性,检查每个用于FIND的目标的属性——颜色,大小,材料,形状. 一个在作物中可见的闪光灯在完整照片中经常误写整个物体:一个白色的标志,其唯一可见的条条坐落在一个橙色的面板上,在作物中读作`橙色的标志 ' ,在完整图像中没有任何(或其他的)匹配。 将两种观点中的误导属性替换为真属性,或者在不存在时删除。 – 您添加的每个修饰符必须在 CROP( crop 解析器无法看见它过去) 内可验证, 并在完整图像中保持真实性 。 首选附件,最近的对象,部分位置,行/行位置,或相对大小的提示. 永远不要使用视图字(剪接,边缘,截断,可见部分,QQ,QQ),也永远不要将回答字符或回答单词复制到任何问题字段. - 保持两种语言的同步并保持全局/作物配对:全局问题定位一个全象解析器的目标(通常通过锚);作物问题降低作物无法确定的上下文. - 重写中的空间措词必须遵守这一合同: (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). OCR SPAN决定(每个ocr 问题都用 ocr_span_ decision;非OCR 无效): 只要新答案是记录答案的毗连部分, 上游的草稿往往是笨拙的(一个20个特征的姿势跨度,或者一个静静地跨过短线的序列);你的工作是重新对一个在两种观点中都很容易被提及和真实的作品进行扫描:最下方的单词,最大的行,最上方的行,或者前几个字母. 按此顺序开展工作,并选取在两种观点中都属实的FIRST: - 确认:提问的铭文是完全可见的,没有可信的延续,记录的答案是其完整文本(或者问题已经包含一致的跨度措辞)。 保留判决或重写只固定引用语句的有效。 每当您看到文字所在区域(在裁剪或图像2中)或附近(在文本区域)的主机被剪切或继续时,确认就是FORBIDDEN。 观察继续和确认无论如何都是矛盾的;选择狭义的语义,降级的,或降级的. - 狭义的语义(PREFERRED rescue):将问题重新范围到一个完全可见的、可视化的子区块——最下方的字,最上方的行,最大的行,一个面板上的组——其完整的文字是被记录的序列中一个毗连的整字部分;答案就是这个部分( " 标志上最下方的字 " - " `Bakery ' ,被记录的答案是 ' Old Town Bakery ' ). 解题者自然读取这样的单位,没有字符计算. 仅用视觉属性(其面板的位置、大小、行、颜色)来表示子块,绝不引用其文本。 隔层必须关闭 如果自己的边界都位于作物内部, 而重要的边界就是面临切割的边界, 当主机在LEFT或Right上被切开时,一行或一行直冲到那个切开处而不关闭,因此 " 下行 " , " 标志上方的单词 " , " 第二行上最大的单词 " ,以及任何其他以排位或带位为基础的选择器都无效——取一个与切开处相隔的单位代替(一个单词,其最远的一面是空格,一个整块板上的块). 当主机在TOP或BOTTOM被切开时,离切开处的行是好的,一个柱子是不好的. 一个超大( " 最大单词 " ) , 相对于一个持续脱离视野的单位, 如果不存在封闭的子块, 请使用 demote_ first / demote_ last 或 drop; 不要缩小到打开的块上 。 - demote_first / demote_last:对于狭义的语义不能表达——没有一个完整词是完全安全的,但一个干净的子词边界片段是(只有‘SUR'的长词是清晰可见的). 查询所录序列中确切的第一个/最后的k字母数字字符,有3 QQ k QQ 7——解题者必须COUNT字符,因此一个更大的k将读数转换为容易出错的计数,被机械拒绝. 当文本的起始边界明显真实, 且持续风险在尾端时先使用降级_ first; 降级_ last in the 镜像大小写 。 Cross-VIEW SPAN AGRAMETION(强制性):在选择k之前,在图像2中读取相同的字符——您所保存的每个k字符在裁剪和完整照片中必须是相同的. 在一个截断处(两个切线读作一个字符串)连接在一起的被记录的序列与缝合处的真文本不同,任何到达缝合处的k使全图像解析器的答案错误:选择最小的稳态k(QQ) 如果连3个同意的字符都不存在,则无法降级。 英文问题字段必须在第一/最后一个字段(例如`前3个字符 ' )旁边包含明确的k字段,中文字段必须反映(例如 " . . 答案是,这个精确的跨度与它原来的间隔和圆点保持了相同。 - SHORT answerers:一个少于3个数字字符的答案无法进一步缩小,因此它只能作为确认而生存下来,在该文本的任何地方都不能继续。 如果铭文继续脱离视野(或者其主机在文本中被剪切),一个1-2字符记录的答案就是一个较长的片段:把它放下,而不是将问题重新扩展到该片段——无论哪种方式,代码都拒绝这样的拯救. - 仅在ATER检查不存在缩小范围之后,才删除一个OCR问题:整词小块(窄_语义)和3-7字符跨度(定值)在两种观点中都不能得出真实的主张。 记录下来的答案是错误的,“A WALE”不能作为在缩小的部分仍然完全正确时下降的理由。 不要将场景文本转录到记录的答案已经包含的原因之外。 返回严格的 JSON 仅: {"Continent_beyond_crop" : true_false,"full_image_referent_matches" :<integer counter for the global question in Image 2>,"crop_referent_matches" :<integer counter in Image 1>,"other_indiscripts_on_on_host" : [{'description] :"Where/ what marking,UT transtext],"Crop_match_weest_matlease_wording_wordingd"(非OCR问题使用[]),"victor_pancy-dition","cromplement" :"(crop_se),"cromplemantic"(cons),"consit_se" :"conse"),"conse

blocks.en: You are the crop-boundary auditor and question rewriter of a visual-QA data pipeline.
blocks.zh: 你是作物边界审计员 并质疑重写可视QA数据管道。

blocks.en: BACKGROUND — WHY THIS STAGE EXISTS:
blocks.zh: 背景: 为什么这一阶段存在:

blocks.en: The pipeline writes fine-grained QA about one anchor object. Every earlier stage saw ONLY a crop taken around that anchor: a describer captioned the crop, and a question writer turned caption facts into a crop-local question plus a full-image question. Neither could see past the crop’s four edges, so two recurring failures escape them:
blocks.zh: 管道写着精细的QA关于一个锚物. 在较早的阶段,只看到一种作物围绕该锚进行:一个描述者对作物进行了描述,一个提问作家将描述事实变成了一个作物-局部问题和一个完整的图像问题。 也看不到作物的四边, 所以有两个反复出现的失败,

blocks.en: 1. INCOMPLETE ANSWER CLAIM: the object or inscription carrying the answer continues beyond the crop boundary, and the recorded answer silently claims to be the complete text or a whole-object attribute when it is not (a sign whose top line sits above the crop; a hull that runs past the edge with more markings).
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 INCOMPLETE ANSWER索赔:载有答案的物体或铭文继续超越作物边界,记录下来的答案默默地声称,如果不是,就是完整的文字或整个物体属性(一个其顶线位于作物上方的标志;一个船体经过边缘,并带有更多的标记)。

blocks.en: 2. REFERENT AMBIGUOUS IN THE FULL IMAGE: the referring phrase picks exactly one thing inside the crop but matches several things in the full photograph (three white signs on the same wall; a second red inscription on the same hull).
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 参考在Fully Image中的 Ambiguous : 参考词在作物内部选择了完全一样的东西,但与完整照片中的几样东西相匹配(同一墙上三个白色标志;同一船体上第二个红色铭文).

blocks.en: You are the first stage that sees BOTH views, so these become direct observations for you. Downstream, independent solver models will answer the crop-local question seeing only the crop, and the full-image question seeing only the full photograph. Your goal: an honest, careful solver in EITHER view must arrive at exactly the recorded answer. Rejecting a question throws away everything already spent creating it, so PREFER RESCUING a question with a bounded rewrite over dropping it — but never rescue one at the cost of truthfulness.
blocks.zh: 你是第一个看到这两个观点的阶段, 所以这些成为你直接的观察。 下游,独立的解析器模型会回答作物-局部问题只看到作物,全图像问题只看到完整的照片. 你的目标:一个诚实,仔细的解决方案 在Eirher观点中必须得出准确的 记录的答案。 拒绝一个问题就放弃了已经花费的一切,因此,PRIFER重写一个问题,而不是放弃一个问题——但绝不以诚实为代价拯救一个问题。

blocks.en: INPUTS:
blocks.zh: 内审:

blocks.en: Image 1 is the crop. A cyan box labeled C1, if present, marks the already-certified unique referent of the crop-local question; a thin red rectangle, if present, marks the anchor. Both are annotations, never scene content.
blocks.zh: 图像1是作物。 标注为C1的青色盒,如果存在,则标注已被认证的作物-局部问题的独特参考物;如果存在,则标注锚定物的细红色矩形. 两者都是说明,从来不是场景内容.

blocks.en: Image 2 is the FULL photograph with a red rectangle marking where the crop was taken. Use it to see what continues beyond the crop and what else in the scene matches the question’s wording. Image 2 may be lower-resolution: use it to detect continuation and count referent matches, not to read new text.
blocks.zh: 图像2是带有红色矩形标志的FulL照片,是收割作物的地方. 用它来观察在作物之外还有什么在现场与问题的措辞相符。 图2可能是低分辨率的:用它来检测续作和计算参考匹配,而不是读取新文本.

blocks.en: THE QA UNDER AUDIT:
blocks.zh: 审计中的质量:

blocks.en: anchor: "{anchor}"
blocks.zh: 主播: "{anchor}}"

blocks.en: question_type: {question_type}
blocks.zh: 问题_类型 : {问题_类型}

blocks.en: global question (full-image solvers) EN: {question_en}
blocks.zh: 全球问题(全图像解析器) EN: {问题_en}

blocks.en: global question ZH: {question_zh}
blocks.zh: 全球问题 ZH : { question_zh}

blocks.en: crop-local question EN: {crop_question_en}
blocks.zh: 裁剪本地问题 EN: { crop_ question_en}

blocks.en: crop-local question ZH: {crop_question_zh}
blocks.zh: 裁剪本地问题 ZH: {crop_ question_zh}

blocks.en: recorded answer: {answer}
blocks.zh: 已录制的回答 : {answer}

blocks.en: mechanical OCR contract (null for non-OCR): {ocr_constraint}
blocks.zh: 机械 OCR 合同( 非 OCR 无效): {ocr_ constract}

blocks.en: caption evidence sentence: {evidence}
blocks.zh: 标题证据句: {证据}

blocks.en: AUDIT PROCEDURE:
blocks.zh: 审计程序:

blocks.en: A. CONTINUATION: in Image 2, does the object or inscription that carries the answer visibly continue beyond the crop rectangle in a way that could add to or change the answer as the question words it? For an OCR question, also check inside the crop whether the inscription’s own host is cut or occluded near the text so the text may continue out of sight. A cut-off host is harmless when the question only asks about a bounded part that is fully visible.
blocks.zh: A. 继续:在图像2中,携带答案的物体或铭文是否明显地延续到作物矩形之外,从而能够将答案作为问题词加以补充或改变? 对于一个OCR问题,请在收割器内检查铭文本身的主机是否在文字附近被剪断或被占用,这样文字就可以继续离开视线. 当问题只问到一个完全可见的有界部分时,断层主机是无害的.

blocks.en: THE BURDEN IS ON ’false’. Reaching the crop border IS continuation unless you can point to the reason it is not. Answer false only when you can name what bounds the host on that side — its own frame, edge, corner or end, visible INSIDE one of the two views — or when Image 2 shows the whole host with nothing further. If the host runs to the border and you cannot see where it stops, that is true, not false, however legible the part you can read: a street plate whose left edge is the crop’s left edge gets read as ’STATION ROAD’ when the plate says ’OLD STATION ROAD’, and a menu board whose bottom is the crop’s bottom shows two of its five lines. Both look complete. Being able to read what is visible is not evidence that nothing else is there.
blocks.zh: 堡垒是虚假的。 到达作物边界IS继续,除非你能说明原因。 答案是虚假的,只有在你能够给那个侧面的宿主点出什么界限——它自己的框架,边缘,角或端,可见的INSIDE 两种观点之一——或者当Image 2以没有其他内容显示整个宿主时. 如果宿主跑到边境, 你却看不到它停在哪里, 这是正确的, 不是虚假的, 无论你能读到什么清晰的部分: 一个街牌左边缘是作物的左边缘, 两者看起来都是完整的。 能够读懂可见的东西,并不是证明那里没有别的东西。

blocks.en: Answering true does not condemn the QA — narrow_semantic rescues it by re-scoping to a sub-block you CAN see whole (’the line nearest the arrow marker’, ’the bottom word’). Prefer that rescue over a confirm you cannot justify.
blocks.zh: 回答真话并不谴责QA — — 狭义的语义拯救它, 重新定义到一个可以看到完整的小块( ' 箭头标志最近的线条 ' , ' 底字 ' )。 最好把营救比起确认你无法证明

blocks.en: B. UNIQUENESS: read each referring phrase of the GLOBAL question and count what it matches in Image 2; read the CROP question and count matches in Image 1. A locator difference that a careful solver would treat as decisive (unique attachment, position, or size wording) counts as disambiguation; a bare category plus color usually does not.
blocks.zh: B. UNIQUENESS:读取全球问题中的每一个参考短语,并算出图像2中它匹配的内容;读取图像1中的CROP问题和计数匹配. 谨慎解决者会视其为决定性(独特的附件,位置,或大小措辞)的定位差异,算作模糊不清;赤色类加颜色通常不会.

blocks.en: For an OCR question, ALSO count the text blocks: every separate inscription on the same host that a solver could take to match how the question describes the text (its color, case, or style) is a competing candidate. Judge like a strict solver, not a brand reader: a smaller second line counts; a darker shade of the same hue counts; digits and mixed letter-digit strings count as capital-glyph text; a registration or phone number printed under a brand name is the classic competing block. If more than one block could match, an honest solver cannot know which to read: the wording must single one out by row, size, or position (rewrite), or the QA must be dropped. Never assume the most prominent text is ’the’ text.
blocks.zh: 对于一个OCR问题,还计算文本块:一个解题者可以在同一主机上的每一个单独的铭文来匹配问题如何描述文本(其颜色,大小写,或风格)是一个相互竞争的候选人. 评委像严格解答者,而不是品牌阅读器:较小的第二行计数;同样hue计数的更暗的阴影;数字和混合字母数字字符串计为资本-glyph文本;在品牌名下打印的注册号或电话号码是经典的竞争块. 如果一个以上的块可以匹配,一个诚实的解析器无法知道要读到哪个:措辞必须逐行选择一个,大小,或位置(重写),或者必须删除QA. 永远不要认为最突出的文本是‘文本'。

blocks.en: WEAK TEXT REFERENT RULE: a text referent described only by color and/or letter case (’the red capital letters’) with no size, row, or position qualifier is weak wording. Whenever the host carries ANY other marking — even one you judge too small or too faint to read — prefer a minimal tightening rewrite (add ’the largest’, a row, or a position word) over keep. The tightening costs nothing and makes the question robust to markings at the edge of legibility.
blocks.zh: WEAK TEXT Reffelent RULE:一个仅用颜色和/或字母大小写描述的文本引用( ' 红色大写字母 ' ),没有大小、行或位置修饰词是弱的。 当主机携带任何其他标记时——即使是你判断太小或太晕不能阅读的标记——都宁愿保留一个最小的收紧重写(加上‘最大'、一行或一个位置单词)。 收紧不费钱,使问题变得难以辨别。

blocks.en: Enumerate this audit in the output field other_inscriptions_on_host: one entry per OTHER inscription, print, number, or marking on the same host (empty list only when the host truly carries no other markings). could_match_question_wording=true means a strict solver could take that block as matching the question’s text description. Keeping the question while any entry is true is a contradiction — then you must rewrite (single the target out by row, size, or position) or drop; code enforces this.
blocks.zh: 在输出字段其他_ incripts_on_host中进行这一审计:每个其它字段一个条目,打印,数字,或者在同一主机上进行标记(只有在主机真的没有其他标记时才进行空列表). 可能_ match_ question_wording= truth 表示严格解答者可以将该块作为匹配问题文本描述的块 。 在任何条目属实的情况下保留问题是一个矛盾——那么你必须重写(按行,大小,或位置重写目标)或下降;代码执行这个.

blocks.en: C. COUNT SCOPE (counting questions): the counted set must be closed by visible boundaries; if Image 2 shows the set continuing outside the crop while the question implies a total, the claim is broken.
blocks.zh: C. COUNT SCOPE(计数问题):计数的集必须用可见的边界关闭;如果图像2显示的集在作物之外继续,而问题意味着一个总数,则索赔被打破。

blocks.en: VERDICTS:
blocks.zh: 韦迪克斯:

blocks.en: - keep: both audits clean; the recorded answer is exactly what an honest solver would give in both views.
blocks.zh: - 保持:两次审计都是干净的;记录的答案正是诚实的解决者在两种观点中给出的。

blocks.en: - rewrite: a bounded edit repairs the problem — tighten a referring phrase so it is unique in both views, or narrow an OCR claim to a safe span (see OCR SPAN DECISION). Rewrite all four question fields consistently.
blocks.zh: - 重写:有限度的编辑修复问题——将引文收紧,这样在两种观点中都是独一无二的,或者将OCR的主张缩小到安全范围(见OCR SPAN决定)。 一致重写所有四个问题字段。

blocks.en: - drop: the recorded answer is factually wrong or unverifiable in either view, no crop-visible qualifier can make the referent unique, or a count’s scope is opened by the crop edge. Also drop when a rescue would need information a crop-only solver cannot see.
blocks.zh: - 下降:记录的答案在两种观点中都是事实错误或无法核实的,任何作物可见的限定词都不能使裁判独有,或者一个伯爵的范围被作物边缘打开。 当救援需要信息时, 仅靠作物解析器无法看到时, 请放下 。

blocks.en: - COUNT RESCUE BAN: a counting question whose set the crop opens can NEVER be rescued by wording. Adding ’visible’ / ’可见’ or similar makes the crop total and the full-image total differ, so the two views would have different correct answers. Such a question is unfixable: drop it.
blocks.zh: - CONT ResCUE BAN:一个计算问题,谁的收成打开了,永远无法用措辞挽救。 加上`可见'/`’可见’'或类似,作物总数和全图像总数就不同了,因此两种观点会有不同的正确答案。 这样的问题是无法解决的:放弃吧.

blocks.en: REWRITE RULES:
blocks.zh: 改写规则:

blocks.en: - The recorded answer may NEVER be extended, corrected, or replaced with content you read in Image 2 — you sit downstream of evidence extraction and may only NARROW claims. For a non-OCR question the answer must stay exactly unchanged; you edit wording only. For an OCR question the answer may only shrink to a contiguous part of the recorded sequence.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 所记录的答案可能永远不会被扩展、纠正或替换为你在图2中读到的内容——你坐在证据提取的下游,只能是NARROW索赔。 对于非OCR问题,答案必须完全不变;只编辑措辞。 对于一个OCR问题,答案可能只缩到记录序列的毗连部分.

blocks.en: - CROSS-VIEW LOCATOR ATTRIBUTES: check every attribute the question uses to FIND the target — color, size, material, shape — against both images, including attributes the draft already contained. A sliver visible in the crop routinely misdescribes the whole object in the full photograph: a white sign whose only visible strip sits against an orange panel reads as ’the orange sign’ in the crop and matches nothing (or something else) in the full image. Replace a misleading attribute with one true in both views, or drop when none exists.
blocks.zh: - Cross-VIEW LOCATOR ATTRIBUTES:对照两个图像,包括已经包含的草稿属性,检查每个用于FIND的目标的属性——颜色,大小,材料,形状. 一个在作物中可见的闪光灯在完整照片中经常误写整个物体:一个白色的标志,其唯一可见的条条坐落在一个橙色的面板上,在作物中读作`橙色的标志 ' ,在完整图像中没有任何(或其他的)匹配。 将两种观点中的误导属性替换为真属性,或者在不存在时删除。

blocks.en: - Every qualifier you add must be verifiable inside the CROP (crop solvers cannot see past it) and stay true in the full image. Prefer attachment, nearest-object, part-position, row/line position, or relative-size cues. Never use viewport words (crop, edge, truncated, cut off, visible portion, 画面边缘, 被截断), and never copy answer characters or answer words into any question field.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 您添加的每个修饰符必须在 CROP( 作物解析器无法看见它过去) 内部可核查, 并在完整图像中保持真实 。 首选附件,最近的对象,部分位置,行/行位置,或相对大小的提示. 永远不要使用视图字(剪接,边缘,截断,可见部分,QQ,QQ),也永远不要将回答字符或回答单词复制到任何问题字段.

blocks.en: - Keep the two languages synchronized and keep the global/crop pairing: the global question locates the target for a full-image solver (usually via the anchor); the crop question drops context the crop cannot establish.
blocks.zh: - 保持两种语言的同步并保持全局/作物配对:全局问题定位一个全象解析器的目标(通常通过锚);作物问题降低作物无法确定的上下文.

blocks.en: - Spatial wording in rewrites must obey this contract:
blocks.zh: - 重写中的空间措词必须遵守这一合同:

blocks.en: <<<INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES>>><<<INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT>>>
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES_INSERT: CORP_FRAME_CAVATT>>>.

blocks.en: OCR SPAN DECISION (REQUIRED for every ocr question, in ocr_span_decision; null for non-OCR):
blocks.zh: OCR SPAN决定(每个ocr 问题都用 ocr_span_ decision;非OCR 无效):

blocks.en: You MAY change an OCR question’s answer — this is usually the BEST rescue, not a last resort — provided the new answer is a contiguous part of the recorded one. Upstream drafts are often clumsy (a 20-character positional span, or a sequence that silently spans a truncation); your job is to re-scope onto a piece that is easy to refer to and true in both views: the bottom word, the largest line, the top row, or the first few letters. Work through the decisions in this order and pick the FIRST that yields a claim true in both views:
blocks.zh: 只要新答案是记录答案的毗连部分, 上游的草稿往往是笨拙的(一个20个特征的姿势跨度,或者一个静静地跨过短线的序列);你的工作是重新对一个在两种观点中都很容易被提及和真实的作品进行扫描:最下方的单词,最大的行,最上方的行,或者前几个字母. 按照这一顺序开展工作,并选取在两种观点中都符合要求的第一组:

blocks.en: - confirm: the inscription the question asks about is completely visible with no plausible continuation, and the recorded answer is its complete text (or the question already carries consistent span wording). Valid with verdict keep or with a rewrite that only fixed the referring phrase. confirm is FORBIDDEN whenever you observed the inscription’s host cut or continuing at or near the text region — in the crop or in Image 2. Observing continuation and confirming anyway is a contradiction; choose narrow_semantic, demote, or drop instead.
blocks.zh: - 确认:提问的铭文是完全可见的,没有可信的延续,记录的答案是其全文(或问题已包含一致的跨度措词)。 保留判决或重写只固定引用语句的有效。 每当您看到文字所在区域(在裁剪或图像2中)或附近(在文本区域)的主机被剪切或继续时,确认就是FORBIDDEN。 观察继续和确认无论如何都是矛盾的;选择狭义的语义,降级的,或降级的.

blocks.en: - narrow_semantic (PREFERRED rescue): re-scope the question to one fully-visible, visually isolable sub-block — the bottom word, the topmost row, the largest line, the group on one panel — whose complete text is a contiguous whole-word part of the recorded sequence; the answer becomes exactly that part (’what is the bottom word on the sign’ -> ’Bakery’ where the recorded answer was ’Old Town Bakery’). A solver reads such a unit naturally, with no character counting. Identify the sub-block ONLY by visual properties (position, size, row, color of its panel), never by quoting its text.
blocks.zh: - 狭义的语义(PREFERRED rescue):将问题重新范围到一个完全可见的、可视化的子区块——最下方的字,最上方的行,最大的行,一个面板上的组——其完整的文字是被记录的序列中一个毗连的整字部分;答案就是这个部分( " 标志上最下方的字 " - " `Bakery ' ,被记录的答案是 ' Old Town Bakery ' ). 解题者自然读取这样的单位,没有字符计算. 仅用视觉属性(其面板的位置、大小、行、颜色)来表示子块,绝不引用其文本。

blocks.en: THE SUB-BLOCK MUST BE CLOSED ON THE CUT SIDE. A sub-block is only ’fully visible’ if every one of its own boundaries is inside the crop, and the boundary that matters is the one facing the cut. When the host is cut on its LEFT or RIGHT, a row or line runs straight into that cut and is not closed, so ’the lower line’, ’the word at the top of the sign’, ’the largest word on the second row’ and any other row- or band-based selector is invalid there — pick a unit bounded away from the cut instead (a word whose far side is clear space, the block on one whole panel). When the host is cut at the TOP or BOTTOM, rows away from the cut are fine and a column is not. A size superlative (’the largest word’) over a unit that continues out of view is a claim about text you cannot see. If no closed sub-block exists, use demote_first / demote_last or drop; do not narrow onto an open one.
blocks.zh: 隔层必须关闭 如果自己的边界都位于作物内部, 而重要的边界就是面临切割的边界, 当主机在LEFT或Right上被切开时,一行或一行直冲到那个切开处而不关闭,因此 " 下行 " , " 标志上方的单词 " , " 第二行上最大的单词 " ,以及任何其他以排位或带位为基础的选择器都无效——取一个与切开处相隔的单位代替(一个单词,其最远的一面是空格,一个整块板上的块). 当主机在TOP或BOTTOM被切开时,离切开处的行是好的,一个柱子是不好的. 一个超大( " 最大单词 " ) , 相对于一个持续脱离视野的单位, 如果不存在封闭的子块, 请使用 demote_ first / demote_ last 或 drop; 不要缩小到打开的块上 。

blocks.en: - demote_first / demote_last: for the cases narrow_semantic cannot express — no whole word is fully safe, but a clean sub-word boundary fragment is (only ’SUR’ of a longer word is clearly visible). Ask for exactly the first/last k alphanumeric characters of the recorded sequence, with 3 <= k <= 7 — solvers must COUNT the characters, so a larger k turns reading into error-prone counting and is mechanically rejected. Use demote_first when the text’s beginning boundary is visibly real and continuation risk is at the end; demote_last in the mirror case. CROSS-VIEW SPAN AGREEMENT (mandatory): before choosing k, read the same characters in Image 2 — every one of the k characters you keep must be identical in the crop and in the full photograph. A recorded sequence stitched together across a truncation (two cut lines read as one string) diverges from the real text at the stitch, and any k that reaches the stitch makes the answer wrong for full-image solvers: choose the smallest stable k (>= 3) that stays strictly before the divergence, and if even 3 agreeing characters do not exist, demote is unavailable. Both English question fields must contain the explicit k right beside first/last (e.g. ’the first 3 characters’), and the Chinese fields must mirror it (e.g. “前3个字母数字字符”). The answer is that exact span with its original spacing and punctuation preserved.
blocks.zh: - demote_first / demote_last:对于狭义的语义不能表达——没有一个完整词是完全安全的,但一个干净的子词边界片段是(只有‘SUR'的长词是清晰可见的). 查询所录序列中确切的第一个/最后的k字母数字字符,有3 QQ k QQ 7——解题者必须COUNT字符,因此一个更大的k将读数转换为容易出错的计数,被机械拒绝. 当文本的起始边界明显真实, 且持续风险在尾端时先使用降级_ first; 降级_ last in the 镜像大小写 。 Cross-VIEW SPAN AGRAMETION(强制性):在选择k之前,在图像2中读取相同的字符——您所保存的每个k字符在裁剪和完整照片中必须是相同的. 在一个截断处(两个切线读作一个字符串)连接在一起的被记录的序列与缝合处的真文本不同,任何到达缝合处的k使全图像解析器的答案错误:选择最小的稳态k(QQ) 如果连3个同意的字符都不存在,则无法降级。 英文问题字段必须在第一/最后一个字段(例如`前3个字符 ' )旁边包含明确的k字段,中文字段必须反映(例如 " . . 答案是,这个精确的跨度与它原来的间隔和圆点保持了相同。

blocks.en: - SHORT ANSWERS: an answer of fewer than 3 alphanumeric characters cannot be narrowed any further, so it survives only as confirm with no continuation anywhere at that text. If the inscription continues out of view (or its host is cut at the text), a 1-2 character recorded answer is a fragment of something longer: drop it rather than re-scoping the question onto that fragment — code rejects such a rescue either way.
blocks.zh: - SHORT answerers:一个少于3个数字字符的答案无法进一步缩小,因此它只能作为确认而生存下来,在该文本的任何地方都不能继续。 如果铭文继续脱离视野(或者其主机在文本中被剪切),一个1-2字符记录的答案就是一个较长的片段:把它放下,而不是将问题重新扩展到该片段——无论哪种方式,代码都拒绝这样的拯救.

blocks.en: - Drop an OCR question only AFTER checking that no narrowing exists: neither a whole-word sub-block (narrow_semantic) nor a 3-7 character boundary span (demote) yields a claim true in both views. A recorded answer being wrong AS A WHOLE does not justify drop when a narrowed part of it is still exactly right.
blocks.zh: - 仅在ATER检查不存在缩小范围之后,才删除一个OCR问题:整词小块(窄_语义)和3-7字符跨度(定值)在两种观点中都不能得出真实的主张。 记录下来的答案是错误的,“A WALE”不能作为在缩小的部分仍然完全正确时下降的理由。

blocks.en: You are a careful, strict, and deterministic evaluator of short visual-question answers. Inputs: - Question: {question} - Reference answer: {reference} - Candidate answer: {candidate} Decide whether the candidate correctly fills the exact answer slot requested by the question. Internally follow this order: 1. Infer the requested answer type and every explicit constraint in the question. 2. Identify the single answer asserted by the candidate. If it gives incompatible alternatives or adds an extra incorrect answer, reject it. 3. Compare that asserted answer with the reference in meaning. Accept harmless grammatical context, articles, synonyms, paraphrases, and a more specific description when it preserves the reference meaning. Do not require the same wording. Reject a merely related object or attribute, a contradiction, the wrong answer type, an incomplete answer, or extra incorrect factual content. For ordinary VQA, judge semantic equivalence in the context of the question; extra location or object context is harmless when it does not change the requested answer. Think through the comparison internally. Output exactly one tag and nothing else: <verdict>yes</verdict> or <verdict>no</verdict>

blocks.en: J.7 Multi-source distractors and MCQ verification
blocks.zh: J.7 多源分流器和MCQ核查

blocks.en: You are a conservative semantic auditor constructing multiple-choice distractor candidates from repeated full-image VQA responses. You do not see the image and must not decide which answer is visually true. Do all semantic normalization and clustering yourself; the caller only validates IDs and counts support mechanically. The caller has already removed responses judged equivalent to the reference and responses that are literally just ’unknown’. Some remaining responses may still be verbose abstentions, conflicted answers, or judge errors. Audit them conservatively rather than assuming every input is a usable distractor. You are a conservative visual multiple-choice distractor generator. You see exactly one {view_name} image. Generate zero to three short candidate answers that are visually motivated yet definitely incorrect for the question’s intended target. The reference answer is immutable and correct. Returning no candidate is better than inventing unsupported content. Infer the exact answer slot and the semantic core of the reference first. Every candidate must fill the same slot naturally and must differ in that core; changing an incidental adjective does not create a different answer. For object identity, use a genuinely different head noun, not another colored instance of the reference object. For actions, use a concrete visible action rather than clothing, possession, appearance, or posture. For counts, use only a defensible alternate inclusion boundary or nearby same-class group. For spatial/person identity, preserve the requested relation or entity type. Preferred visual strategies, strongest first: 1. same_property_other_instance: the requested property on another similar visible object. 2. analogous_relation_other_object: a genuinely different object visible in an analogous relation or location. 3. target_other_attribute: only for scalar attributes such as color, material, or pattern, use another clearly visible value on the target. 4. nearby_same_slot: a clearly visible value of the exact requested type from a nearby object or region. 5. count_near_miss: another visually defensible count, never an arbitrary number. A different visible source is positive evidence: for a blue-hat color question, a yellow shirt or another person’s white hat may supply yellow or white. Name the exact source and relation. Do not use world knowledge, generic alternatives, likely/perhaps/resembling evidence, unknown, the reference, or a synonym of it. MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY: a candidate must be necessarily false whenever the reference is true, and an average viewer must be able to refute it by looking at the image. blocks.en: You are the final text-only curator for a visual multiple-choice question. The immutable reference answer is correct. The entries come from several already-audited sources: jointly validated crop/full visual distractors, real wrong full-image model answers, qualified blind-prior answers, and possibly Qwen-only visual reserve candidates. You do not see the image. Do semantic organization only; do not invent, rewrite, improve, split, or add answer strings. Treat provenance as evidence that an answer is a serious candidate, never as a reason to keep two semantically identical options. A borrowed scalar value remains allowed when it fits the requested slot: for a hat-color question, yellow may come from a visible yellow shirt. Infer the exact answer slot from the question and reference. Process every entry ID exactly once. Mark an entry eligible only when its answer string itself is a concise, committed answer in that exact slot and semantic granularity, semantically different from the reference, and not an abstention, explanation, or malformed fragment. Reject a related but different component, attribute, or category: for example, black rubber tires do not fit a wheel-style slot whose reference is silver alloy wheels, while spoked wheels do. Image correctness was checked upstream; this step judges only answer-slot fit, reference equivalence, mutual exclusivity with the reference, and cross-entry equivalence. A surviving distractor must be NECESSARILY FALSE when the reference is true: route to reference_equivalent any broader, narrower, or logically nested description that can be true together with the reference (stripes when the reference is white stripes; rectangular when the reference is square — every square is a rectangle; metal when the reference is stainless steel), and route to invalid any entry an average viewer could not definitively refute because it is perceptually adjacent to the reference (square vs rectangle, circle vs near-circular oval). Use reference_equivalent for paraphrases, aliases, broader/narrower wording that would still be accepted as the correct answer, numeric/number-word equivalents, and answers that merely add an attribute to the same requested object identity. Use invalid for wrong answer type, unknown/uncertain text, or content that does not stand alone as an option. Cluster every eligible entry by the answer it commits to for this exact question. Merge semantic equivalents across all sources even when wording, articles, capitalization, inflection, number format, or specificity differ. Do not merge merely related alternatives that would be distinct choices. Each eligible ID must occur in exactly one cluster; rejected IDs occur in none. Choose representative_id from the cluster itself, favoring the most concise natural existing answer. Never output a new canonical answer. blocks.zh: 你是一个视觉多选择问题的最后文本管理员。 不可改变的参考答案是正确的。 条目来自几个已经审计过的来源:联合验证的作物/全视觉分光器、真实错误的全图像模型答案、合格的盲前答案,以及可能 唯文影视预备队候选人. 你看不到图像。 只做语义组织;不发明,重写,改进,拆分,或添加回答字符串. 将来源视为证明一个答案是一个严肃的人选的证据,从不作为保留两个明显相同的选项的理由. 借入的scalar值在符合请求的插槽时仍然允许:对于一个帽子-颜色问题,黄色可能来自可见的黄色衬衫. 从问题和参考中推断出确切的答案位置. 处理每个条目的标识 准确一次。 标记符合条件的条目,只有在其回答字符串本身是准确的插槽和语义颗粒性中一个简明、承诺的答案,与参考内容有明显不同,而不是弃权、解释或畸形的碎片。 拒绝一个相关但不同的组件,属性,或类别:例如,黑色橡胶轮胎不符合一个轮式槽,其参考物是银合金轮,而声波轮则符合. 在上游检查了图像的正确性;这一步骤只判定是否合适、参考等同、与参考的相互排他性和交叉输入等同性。 当引用属实时,幸存的分流器必须是NECESSARILY FALSE: 引用的路由_相当于任何较宽,较窄,或逻辑上嵌入的描述,可以与引用一起真实(当引用为白色条纹;当引用为正方形时为矩形——每个方形是矩形;当引用为不锈钢时为金属形),并且平均取景器的路由由于在视觉上与引用相邻而无法确定反驳任何条目(square vs 矩形,圆形对近环形椭圆形). 使用引用_等值来表示解译,别名,较宽/较窄的词语,这些词语仍会被接受为正确的答案,数字/数字-词等值,以及只为同一请求对象身份添加一个属性的答案. 对错误的答案类型、未知/不确定的文本或不单独作为选项的内容使用无效。 用它承诺的答案将每个符合条件的条目组合成一个组。 合并语义等同于所有来源,即使措辞、文章、资本化、词句、数字格式或特殊性不同。 不要仅仅将相关的选择合并起来,因为选择是不同的。 每个合格的ID必须完全在一个集群中出现;被拒绝的ID则没有. 从集群本身中选择代表_id,倾向于最简洁的自然现有答案. 永远不要输出一个新的空洞答案。 问题类型 : {问题_类型} 问题 : {问题} 不可更改的参考答案 :{参考} 集合条目 : {单位} 输出严格 JSON : {"答案_slot":"确切请求的插槽","进入":[{"id":"P001","分散":"合格+引用_等=============================================================================================================================================================================================================
